raw.title: Staff Field Engineer | US | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Field Engineering team works closely with our Presales Solution Engineering team, as well as Product and Marketing, to ensure the SE's have the tools, collateral, enablement and experts they need to close business. If you've ever served in a Technical Presales role for a software company, you know just how much knowledge you are expected to have, demos you need to show, workshops you need to execute on, etc. The Field Engineering team maintains the backend systems, content creation and deep subject matter expertise that enables the Solution Engineering team to scale and focus on direct customer selling, community building, learning, and other adoption and revenue-focused activities. As a Staff Field Engineer, you are viewed by Sales and FE leadership as being in the top 20% of the field team, operating with little to no supervision on the company's most strategic engagements and serving as a mentor to Senior Field Engineers and Solution Engineers.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Advise on and support some of Grafana's most strategic deals and customer engagements, collaborating with Solution Engineers and Observability Architects on the company's most complex technical challenges with no supervision.
  • Serve as a company-recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) in one area of the Grafana Platform, and deep knowledge across multiple Grafana technologies, building new reference architectures from scratch and overcoming competitive objections in the field
  • Proven ability to craft and deliver compelling value based stories to help the sales team technically close deals.
  • Own end-to-end creation and curation of technical training content (workshops, how-to guides, demo scripts) for one or more product areas, and establish a repeatable content review cadence in partnership with Enablement and Product Management to keep materials aligned with the product roadmap
  • Architect, engineer, and maintain a live production environment that supports demo, workshop, and POV infrastructure at scale, ensuring reliability, security, and uptime.
  • Act as a key influencer in product direction, helping key customers adopt newer technologies, and represent Field Engineering in Product planning cycles to surface enablement gaps and shape investment priorities
  • Serve as a presenter for Strategic Marketing events (presentations, panels, webinars, conferences, blogs) as an ambassador for Grafana
  • Provide technical guidance for a specific product area to Solution Engineers, Observability Architects and customers, and present best practices to customers
  • Help update and improve product documentation, and contribute back to the organization through white papers, blogs, and product direction input
  • Mentor Senior and Staff Solution Engineers and Field Engineers

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Minimum of 8+ years of related technical experience, including 2+ years in a Senior Field Engineer role (or equivalent), serving as a SRE, Developer, Architect and/or successful presales Solution Architect. OSS development experience is a plus.
  • Excellent understanding of Grafana and associated technologies, with recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) depth in at least one area of the Grafana Platform; deep working knowledge across multiple technologies in the Observability space (e.g. Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, etc.)
  • Expert-level knowledge in at least one adjacent domain (e.g. IoT, AI/ML) beyond the core observability stack, and demonstrated domain knowledge across the broader Grafana Ecosystem
  • Has created and maintained at least one product training asset (workshop, guide, or structured content) that has been adopted by the broader technical field organization
  • Demonstrated experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering to produce and maintain field-facing enablement content and influence roadmap priorities
  • Comfortable with at least one modern programming language, and a strong understanding of the modern software development lifecycle, including debugging and investigation
  • Working familiarity with Linux, including common tools
  • Practical experience using AI tools to generate and review code and to accelerate day-to-day tasks, while retaining full ownership of final decisions and quality criteria for the resulting work
  • Able to architect a modern application on one of the primary cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP), including IaC tools such as Terraform, understanding the tradeoffs between build vs. buy, and the technologies that make up that architecture such as Kubernetes, Docker, Serverless, Microservices and more
  • Proven track record building and delivering strategic technical content (workshops, demos, decks, webinars, videos) for technical audiences, including complex POVs and content that overcomes competitive objections
  • Deep understanding of the sales process, with the ability to anticipate and proactively address challenges in complex, strategic sales cycles

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Job Description – Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Remote – Working EST (US Eastern Time Zone)

Contract Duration: 12 Months (Dedicated, Full-Time Role)

Experience: 15+ Years

Role Purpose

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure, enterprise infrastructure and Microsoft technologies.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing and optimising complex cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments. This is a senior, hands-on technical role requiring strong solution architecture capabilities, advanced troubleshooting skills and the ability to deliver secure, scalable and high-performing infrastructure solutions.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic solution design and architecture expertise with hands-on engineering experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain enterprise Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop scalable, secure and highly available cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions.
  • Lead technical solution design, architecture and infrastructure modernisation initiatives.
  • Configure, deploy and manage Microsoft technologies, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and related services.
  • Manage Azure networking, virtual machines, storage, identity and security configurations.
  • Support cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades and optimisation projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cloud and system performance issues.
  • Implement best practices for disaster recovery, backup, security and business continuity.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, architects and business stakeholders to deliver infrastructure solutions.
  • Produce technical documentation, architecture designs and implementation plans.
  • Provide advanced technical support and guidance across cloud and infrastructure environments.

Minimum Requirements

  • 15+ years of extensive experience in IT infrastructure, cloud engineering and enterprise technology environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft technologies and enterprise infrastructure solutions.
  • Proven experience in solution design, architecture and technical implementation.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity management, security and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience with infrastructure migrations, deployments and optimisation
  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
  • Must be available to work US Eastern Time Zone (EST/EDT) business hours.

Preferred Technical Skills & Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate
  • Azure Virtual Machines, Networking, Storage and Entra ID
  • Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Active Directory
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates or Bicep)
  • PowerShell scripting and automation
  • Azure Backup, Site Recovery and disaster recovery solutions

Key Competencies

  • Advanced cloud infrastructure engineering
  • Enterprise solution architecture and design
  • Strong hands-on technical delivery
  • Analytical thinking and complex troubleshooting
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities
  • Strong documentation and technical leadership skills
  • Adaptability in complex enterprise environments

raw.description:
What You’ll Do

As a Country SME within Avalara's International Compliance Operations team, you'll help ensure accurate, scalable VAT compliance delivery across multiple European jurisdictions while supporting the future of automated compliance solutions. This role combines deep VAT expertise with operational leadership, helping customers navigate complex compliance requirements while partnering with Product, Engineering, and Tax Technology teams to improve automation and digital filing capabilities. You'll play a key role in managing compliance risk, strengthening audit readiness, and improving how compliance services are delivered at scale.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Be a subject matter expert for VAT compliance across one or more EU jurisdictions
  • Manage complex VAT cases, including audits, disputes, and escalations
  • Lead communication with tax authorities, including registrations, filings, enquiries, and penalty challenges
  • Represent Avalara in interactions with tax authorities, including audit participation (remote or in person across European jurisdictions)
  • Support delivery teams in resolving complex VAT compliance issues
  • Provide expert guidance on VAT legislation, rulings, and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Tax Technology teams on automation and compliance solutions
  • Supporting development of automated VAT return submission processes via APIs and other digital channels
  • Contribute to development of scalable compliance models, including self-service approaches
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce risk
  • Support the creation and maintenance of SOPs and compliance documentation
  • Keep up to date with legislative changes and sharing insights across teams
  • Mentor team members and raising technical capability across the organisation

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of relevant VAT compliance experience within EU jurisdictions
  • Proven experience managing complex VAT cases, audits, and tax authority interactions
  • Strong knowledge of EU VAT legislation and compliance processes
  • Experience working with tax authorities across one or more EU jurisdictions
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex tax regulations
  • Experience engaging with tax authorities and clients
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven Eexperience using AI or automation tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, or decision-making in compliance or operational workflows
  • Additional European languages would be highly beneficial.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

raw.excerpt: Build the engineering foundations that thousands of developers rely on every day.
raw.description:
Build the engineering foundations that thousands of developers rely on every day. Shape a modern platform with strong automation, resilience, and measurable reliability, leveraging your expertise in infrastructure and distributed systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Chief Technology Office team, you will design, build, and operate enterprise Source Code Management services, such as GitLab. You will create secure, scalable platform capabilities that reduce manual effort through automation and self-service. You will own service health end-to-end, from architecture and implementation to safe change, resilience, and continuous improvement. You will partner across engineering, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver dependable developer experiences, with a focus on building for resiliency and operating at scale.

Job responsibilities

  • Lead architecture and implementation of Source Code Management platform capabilities, translating developer and service needs into durable software and infrastructure solutions
  • Build and maintain automation, APIs, deployment tooling, and self-service workflows for provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, recovery, and decommissioning
  • Write and review production-quality code in Python, Java, or Go, applying secure coding, testing, and maintainability practices
  • Design Amazon Web Services architectures across compute, networking, identity, databases, storage, and encryption using services and patterns appropriate to each environment
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and establish repeatable, reviewable, and compliant platform changes
  • Define and use service-level indicators and objectives for availability, latency, errors, capacity, and recovery, and build actionable observability with metrics, logs, traces, and alerts
  • Plan capacity and performance using workload evidence, scaling characteristics, dependency limits, and headroom, and run load and resilience tests in non-production environments
  • Design and validate high-availability and disaster-recovery capabilities, including backup and restore, regional recovery, failover and failback, and documented recovery objectives
  • Lead incident response for supported services, drive technical diagnosis and mitigation, and deliver blameless reviews with tracked engineering actions that reduce recurrence
  • Engineer for resiliency and scale, architecting solutions that operate reliably under high load and complex conditions
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Hands on experience in designing, building, and operating production services or developer platforms
  • Proficiency in at least one of Python, Java, or Go with experience building automation and service code supported in production
  • Experience designing distributed systems and cloud platforms for availability, resilience, performance, and controlled failure
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services services across compute, networking, identity and access management, databases, object storage, and key management
  • Experience with relational databases, including PostgreSQL, covering performance, replication, schema migrations, backup and restore, and capacity planning
  • Experience with container platforms, including Kubernetes and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service or Amazon Elastic Container Service with AWS Fargate
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
  • Practical experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, review practices, and deployment pipelines
  • Experience defining or operating monitoring, alerting, capacity signals, and recovery measures using service-level indicators and service-level objectives
  • Specialization in infrastructure areas such as distributed storage, databases, or operating at scale, with exposure to technologies from startups or large enterprises

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience with enterprise Git platforms and workflows, including GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket
  • Experience operating stateful platforms using PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora, Redis, object storage, replication, and data recovery
  • Experience designing or operating multi-Availability Zone or multi-region architectures, including regional failover and recovery exercises
  • Familiarity with observability platforms and practices such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, or Splunk

Job Description

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Commitment: Pay-per- task-based, variable/flexible hours (~15hrs/wk)

Project duration: ~ 4 weeks to 3 months

About the opportunity

We are looking for experienced Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) professionals with expertise in SysML v1 and exposure to SysML v2, or demonstrated hands-on experience with SysML v2 modeling, to support a customer project focused on AI training and evaluation.

In this role, you'll apply your systems engineering knowledge to develop reference models, assess AI-generated SysML v2 outputs, and establish clear standards for technical accuracy and model quality.

Candidates may use suitable SysML modeling tools to create and evaluate system models. Experience with graphical or textual modeling approaches is welcome.

Your expertise will help evaluate how effectively AI systems interpret engineering requirements, represent complex system architectures, and produce consistent, traceable models.

Required Skills

  • Sysml v2

  • Systems engineering

  • Requirements engineering

  • System architecture

  • Model traceability

  • Interface control documents (icds)

  • Conops

  • Technical writing

  • Model assessment

  • Rubric creation

  • Model review

  • Asynchronous communication

  • Remote collaboration

  • Ai/ml familiarity

  • Aerospace/defense/automotive industry background

What you’ll do

  • Interpret and translate engineering requirements into accurate SysML v2 models, emphasizing model fidelity and traceability.

  • Develop reference solutions and exemplar system architectures using SysML v2 to serve as benchmarks for AI evaluation tasks.

  • Use appropriate systems modeling tools to create, review, and validate SysML v2 models.

  • Create, refine, and document evaluation rubrics to assess the quality and correctness of AI-generated SysML v2 models.

  • Review, assess, and provide structured feedback on SysML v2 models, ensuring technical accuracy and adherence to modeling best practices.

  • Analyze requirements, Concepts of Operations (ConOps), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and architectural specifications to inform modeling efforts.

  • Collaborate asynchronously through written and verbal communication to clarify project deliverables and resolve technical ambiguities.

Required qualifications

  • Professional experience in systems engineering, with hands-on expertise in SysML v1 and some exposure to SysML v2, or demonstrated experience with SysML v2 modeling.

  • Ability to interpret engineering requirements and translate them into technically accurate system models.

  • Understanding of model-based systems engineering principles, requirements traceability, and system architecture.

  • Experience working with systems modeling tools and applying MBSE methodologies to engineering projects.

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, system architecture, interface control, and model traceability.

  • Experience using MBSE modeling tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, or other compatible systems modeling applications.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 modeling environments, including graphical or textual approaches.

  • Experience working with ConOps, ICDs, and other foundational systems engineering documentation.

  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, particularly in remote or asynchronous environments.

  • Experience in complex engineering domains such as aerospace, space, defense, automotive, maritime, or communications.

  • Familiarity with model verification, technical review, evaluation rubric development, or model quality assessment.

  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, or data-driven engineering projects.

Engagement details

Contract type: Contractor engagement.

Location: Remote.

Work structure: Project or task-based, with variable hours depending on project needs.

Duration: Initial pilot expected to last approximately 4 weeks to 3 months.

Application process

  • Candidates will complete an AI interview as part of the application process.

raw.description:
Director of Enterprise Customer Success

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes' 2025 "Next Billion-Dollar Startups" list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation. AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

The Director of Enterprise Customer Success will lead Customer Success Managers (CSMs) focused on the Enterprise Segment ($5M-1B) accounts. In this role, you will lead a team of 7+ CSMs responsible for owning renewals, generating adoption, and driving customer satisfaction.

Team Mission

We are building a best-in-class Commercial Team and establishing a repeatable go-to-market motion. We are hiring a team of high-caliber Enterprise SaaS and Medical Device customer success professionals to thoughtfully engage VPs, General Managers, and other corporate decision makers and end-users across the Medical Device Industry. Our Customer Success team takes a proactive, consultative, and high-touch approach when working with customers, by engaging directly with end-users to generate platform adoption and running Executive Business Reviews to align with strategic initiatives and quantify and communicate ROI. This team builds documented, customer-confirmed value evidence — use cases, workflows, and outcomes — and turns it into ROI-backed expansion, with AI fluency, both the team's and our customers', as a core part of how that value gets built and proven.

Responsibilities

  • Drive customer retention and expansion by leading a team of CSMs focused on the Enterprise segment ($100M-$1B in revenue)
  • Directly manage the Enterprise Customer Success team, providing ongoing enablement, coaching, and development, including sharing and shaping Customer Success process, best practices, and strategies as well as hiring and developing CSMs for AI fluency within AcuityAI and internal workflows
  • Grow AcuityAI adoption across the book by enabling CSMs to turn platform usage into meaningful AI usage, which is a core retention and expansion lever.
  • Build team capability in reviewing AI quality signals and feeding them back to Product.
  • Own GRR forecast accuracy and CRM/pipeline hygiene, run renewal pipeline calls, and own renewal reporting to executive leadership.
  • Regularly monitor account health and user adoption across a large portfolio of accounts and report on key performance indicators to Customer Success and broader Commercial team leadership.
  • Engage directly with key customers through EBRs, events, kickoffs, SteerCos, escalations, and other workflows to communicate value, navigate risk, and support in the management of the commercial process as needed.
  • Provide support for CSMs in at-risk accounts.
  • Partner closely with sales, product, and services teams to advance AcuityMD's mission and approach to customer engagement.
  • Engage proactively, creatively, and constructively as a member of the CX leadership team.

Your Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management Enterprise SaaS
  • 3+ years of experience leading high performing teams as a Senior Manager or Director
  • Is AI-first in daily workflows and champions AI adoption and automation
  • Proven ability to enable AI fluency and lead by example using AI in their own workflows
  • Comfortable running pipeline and renewal reviews, owning GRR and the renewal forecast, and applies a commercial mindset to renewal management
  • Comfortable leading through change, stays calm under pressure, and communicates clearly even in ambiguity
  • Displays strong independent judgment
  • Operates as a true peer on the CX leadership team by helping shape strategy, challenging constructively, and supporting decisions made across the team
  • Curious by nature — asks good questions and isn't satisfied with surface-level answers
  • Has led a team through significant change, including an AI-led product evolution
  • Has stepped into an established team and earned trust while coaching to a clear, high bar
  • Proven ability to manage large 100+ logo portfolio
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in venture-backed, growth stage companies
  • Medical Device or Life Sciences experience
  • Experience using CRM, ideally Hubspot

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $160,000- $200,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA or Canada to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

  4. Practical proficiency with Python or other coding languages.
  5. Practical proficiency with coding agents.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees strategic transformation programmes involving digital innovation, business process reengineering, operating model redesign, technology modernization, organizational restructuring, regulatory compliance, and cultural change.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, business unit heads, technology teams, and external partners to translate corporate strategy into actionable transformation initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes, sustainable change adoption, and improved organizational performance.

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.

B. Business Process & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead business process reengineering initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead digital transformation initiatives involving automation, cloud adoption, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise technology modernization.
  • Oversee the implementation of digital platforms, business applications, and technology-enabled operating models.

D. Programme & Portfolio Leadership

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio and major change programmes.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.

  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to measure the financial and operational impact of transformation initiatives.

F. Organizational Change & Culture Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management strategies to support transformation adoption.

G. Stakeholder, Risk & Regulatory Management

raw.description:
Job Description

At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you’re ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?


About the Role

FIS’ Capital Markets business provides mission-critical software and services to financial institutions. As a Pricing Analyst, Lead, you will own pricing and commercial workstreams for new business and renewals across the Capital Markets portfolio. You will shape deal economics, guide negotiations and contracting, and apply pricing governance while working with day-to-day autonomy. Success means protecting value, improving commercial outcomes, and enabling consistent, scalable deal execution.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead pricing workstreams from early deal shaping through negotiation, approval, and contracting across opportunities of varying complexity.
  • Develop pricing models and scenarios across software, services, and managed services to evaluate economics and challenge assumptions.
  • Structure deals balancing growth, margin, revenue quality, client value, and commercial risk.
  • Apply pricing guardrails, approval requirements, and governance while escalating material exceptions and trade-offs with clear recommendations.
  • Partner with Sales and Legal on negotiation strategies, counterproposals, discounts, ramps, payment terms, renewals, and services assumptions.
  • Prepare deal scorecards and decision summaries that clearly communicate recommendations, risks, trade-offs, and alternatives to senior stakeholders.
  • Influence Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Services, and Delivery stakeholders to resolve competing priorities and drive commercial decisions.
  • Analyze deal benchmarks, discounting, exceptions, margin trends, and comparable transactions to identify value leakage and improvement opportunities.
  • Improve pricing processes, intake, approvals, standardization, automation, and sales self-service while measuring cycle-time and quality improvements.
  • Maintain pricing benchmarks and supporting data while tracking throughput, service levels, rework, first-pass accuracy, discounts, exceptions, and margin quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in pricing, deal desk, commercial finance, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Advanced financial modeling, pricing analysis, scenario modeling, and quantitative decision-making skills.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise deal economics, including discounts, ramps, payment terms, renewals, services pricing, margin, and revenue quality.
  • Ability to independently own complex pricing workstreams while balancing multiple deals, renewals, deadlines, and stakeholder priorities.
  • Strong commercial judgment, negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional, global teams without direct authority and constructively challenge commercial assumptions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including applying financial models and analytical methods to commercial decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant skills and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in capital markets, financial technology, enterprise software, software-as-a-service, or technology-enabled services.
  • Experience with pricing strategy, price benchmarking, pricing analytics, pricing models, and commercial operations.
  • Experience with quote-to-cash processes, pricing tools, customer relationship management data, or enterprise sales workflows.
  • Experience using Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and data-visualization tools to translate pricing data into actionable insights.
  • Experience developing dashboards, pricing datasets, benchmarks, and performance measures that drive measurable commercial or operational improvements.

What We Offer you

At FIS, you can grow your career as far as you want to take it. Here’s what else we offer:

Opportunities to make an impact in fintech

Personal and professional learning

Inclusive, diverse work environment

Resources to give back to your community

FIS is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive compensation. The pay range for this full-time position is $121,800.00 - $207,060.00 and reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this position based on the posted role, level, and location. Within the range, actual individual starting pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Any changes in work location will also impact actual individual starting pay. Please consult with your recruiter about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Privacy Statement

Le candidat retenu devra faire preuve de souplesse pour soutenir les fonctions corporatives et les postes liés à la stratégie de mise sur le marché (GTM) dans le cadre d’un contrat à distance de six mois, avec possibilité de prolongation. Ce poste est essentiel pour mener à bien notre stratégie d’acquisition de talents et nous assurer d’attirer les meilleurs ingénieurs. Le candidat idéal possédera une solide expérience en gestion des clients et de l’organisation, ainsi qu’une compréhension approfondie des dernières tendances en matière de recrutement en ingénierie, combinée à une maîtrise de l’environnement dynamique actuel pour le recrutement de talents destinés à des postes clés au sein de l’organisation.

  • Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les intervenants internes et les gestionnaires d’embauche. Comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions de recrutement sur mesure
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de recrutement efficaces, alignées sur les objectifs et la culture de l’organisation. Assurer une expérience candidat fluide et positive
  • Se concentrer sur la recherche, la présélection et la sélection de candidats en ingénierie de haut calibre pour des postes de niveau supérieur. Utiliser des techniques de recherche innovantes, notamment les médias sociaux, les sites d’offres d’emploi et les événements de réseautage, afin d’attirer les meilleurs talents en ingénierie. Mener des entrevues techniques et des évaluations pour s’assurer que les candidats possèdent les compétences techniques requises et s’intègrent bien à la culture d’entreprise

raw.title: [LDP] Android Developer
raw.excerpt: Project – the aim you’ll have Industry: Logistics & Supply Chain (mission-critical systems powering real-world delivery operations).
raw.description:
Project – the aim you’ll have

Industry: Logistics & Supply Chain (mission-critical systems powering real-world delivery operations).

Type of project:Evolution and modernization of a mature mobile ecosystem. This is a 9-year success story that is currently entering a high-growth phase focused on architectural excellence and modern UI standards.

Team: A collaborative team of 7 Android Developers working closely with Product, UX, and Backend specialists in an Agile environment.

Modernization, not just Maintenance:We are moving away from legacy patterns. You will join at the perfect time to help introduce Jetpack Compose and streamline our architecture.

Kotlin-First Environment: The codebase is already primarily Kotlin. We’ve done the heavy lifting of moving away from Java; now we are focused on using the full power of Kotlin’s modern features.

Impact on Infrastructure: This isn't a "code monkey" role. You will have a direct say in how we clean up our MVVM structure and set the engineering standards for the next few years.

Position – how you’ll contribute

  • Standardizing and refining our existing MVVM architecture to improve predictability and scalability.
  • Leading the implementation of the first Jetpack Compose modules, setting the blueprint for a full UI migration.
  • Developing new features for our logistics engine, including real-time tracking, offline data synchronization, and hardware integration.
  • Identifying and systematically addressing technical debt to transform "chaotic" modules into clean, maintainable code.
  • Collaborating with the 4 other Android peers to establish best practices and unified coding standards.
  • Ensuring high-quality output through meaningful Code Reviews and a proactive approach to automated testing.

Expectations – the experience you need

  • At least 3–5 years of commercial experience in Android development.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Kotlin (we value idiomatic, clean code).
  • Solid understanding of MVVM and the ability to distinguish between "good" and "chaotic" implementations.
  • Hands-on experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for asynchronous programming.
  • Proficiency with Android Jetpack libraries (Navigation, Room, ViewModel, etc.).
  • A "refactoring mindset" – you enjoy bringing order to complex systems and see technical debt as an opportunity to build better.

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Early-adopter experience with Jetpack Compose (commercial or significant side projects).
  • Previous experience in Logistics, GIS, or Fleet Management apps.
  • Knowledge of modularization strategies in large Android projects.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and static analysis tools (e.g., Detekt, SonarQube).

What we offer:

  • Flexible and remote cooperation options
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • Travels related to international projects
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Access* to language classes
  • Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Access* to private healthcare and life insurance
  • Access* to multisport card

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines cooperation with enjoyment.

$47,000.00 - $79,900.00

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Working closely with our art director and creative teams, you'll use generative AI tools and node-based workflows to produce high-quality visual content, combining a strong artistic eye with a methodical, iterative approach to achieving consistent, believable results.

This is a 6–8 week freelance opportunity, working remotely. We'd ideally like someone based in the UK, but we're open to working with artists elsewhere who can maintain a good overlap with UK working hours

What you'll do

  • Generate and refine high-quality image and video content using our internal node-based AI tooling.
  • Build staged workflows that develop complex outputs step by step.
  • Explore and develop new ways to enhance and extend existing media content and footage.
  • Ensure consistent likeness and visual consistency across generated content.
  • Establish efficient workflows using a wide range of established AI models.
  • Troubleshoot prompts and node-graphs where needed.
  • Share learnings and help develop best practices across the team.

What will help you succeed in this role

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating cinematic, photorealistic image and/or video content created using generative AI.
  • A strong artistic eye for composition, lighting, framing and photorealism.
  • Experience building and working with node-based generative AI workflows, using tools such as ComfyUI or similar.
  • A layered, structured approach to building complex results.
  • Experience across multiple AI models and platforms.
  • Patience, persistence and lateral thinking.
  • Professional experience in VFX, compositing, concept art, film/TV, games or immersive experiences.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working to an evolving brief.

Even better if you also have

  • A background in 2D compositing or VFX.
  • Experience with Premiere, After Effects or Photoshop.
  • Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine.
  • An interest in integrating AI into production pipelines.

raw.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote, US and EMEA preferred but not required

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to own how Fingerprint looks, feels, and works on the web. You’ll design and build fingerprint.com, communicating our vision of a fraud-free internet and showcasing Fingerprint’s device intelligence platform through clear, compelling experiences for developers and the teams evaluating our product.

We’ve formed a dedicated website engineering pod to raise the website to the level of the best product sites on the internet, and you’ll join it as the person who owns the overall look and feel. You’ll work alongside the pod’s design engineers and engineers, plus partners across Design, Marketing, and Growth, taking projects from early concepts through production. You’ll move between design tools like Figma and the browser, explore new visual directions, and build interactions that help people understand what Fingerprint can do.

This role leans toward design. We’re looking for exceptional taste and craft, paired with the engineering skills to implement your own designs directly in the browser with speed and attention to detail. You care about typography and layout as much as clean code and a performant, accessible experience. You’re naturally curious, you start things without waiting for a ticket, and you’re excited to use AI to explore designs rapidly. You’ll be given near-unlimited tokens to go crazy. You’ll help shape the website’s design system, propose improvements, and see your work through to launch and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the look and feel of fingerprint.com, designing and building core website experiences, including our homepage, product pages, pricing, and navigation, from initial exploration through responsive implementation and launch.
  • Turn technical product concepts into clear visual explanations and interactive demos that help developers understand and evaluate Fingerprint.
  • Refine typography, composition, motion, and interaction details to make the website feel distinctive and cohesive across devices.
  • Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and page patterns that connect our visual language to production code and help the team ship faster.
  • Build accessible, mobile-friendly, performant experiences that follow web best practices, working with the website pod on maintainable code, page speed, and consistent behavior across browsers.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Growth on product launches and website experiments, turning clear objectives into design concepts and production code.
  • Carry work through review, testing, and release, then use feedback and website data to improve usability and conversion.
  • Take initiative: contribute ideas proactively, share prototypes early, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between creative ambition, implementation effort, and delivery.
  • Find creative ways to use AI to ship high-quality work at speeds not possible with human-only input, such as machine-readable design specs, skills or internal tools, and evolve those workflows as the tools change.

Qualifications:

  • 6–10 years of related working experience designing and building for the web, with a track record of owning projects end to end as a hands-on individual contributor.
  • An active portfolio website and/or GitHub/social profile showing websites or interactive experiences that demonstrate exceptional design taste and production frontend development. We want to understand what you personally designed and built.
  • Strong visual and interaction design fundamentals, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and responsive layouts.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript skills, with experience building production websites using React and modern web frameworks like Astro.
  • Hands-on experience with canvas animations and shaders, and comfort prototyping motion and interactions directly in the browser.
  • Fluency in Figma and a habit of exploring ideas both in Figma and in code, using AI coding tools to iterate.
  • A practical understanding of web performance, accessibility, and browser behavior, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues in your own work.
  • Experience turning an open-ended brief into a finished experience, explaining design and technical decisions, and incorporating feedback from different disciplines.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate clearly in a distributed team, with care for both the quality of the result and the pace of delivery.
  • Experience using AI-first workflows to accelerate parts of the design process and enable other teammates to ship high-quality assets.
  • Preferred experience with , WebGL, motion.dev, and Blender or 3D animation
  • Technical B2B product experience highly preferred
  • Astro, interactive data visualization is a plus
  • Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom.

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and EMEA region and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $103,000 - $180,000 USD.

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

New York City: $150,000 - $180,000 USD

Chicago: $126,000 - $145,000 USD

United Kingdom/Ireland: $103,000 - $119,000 USD

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Role

Serve as the on-duty commander for Alpaca's most critical incidents, directing cross-functional response to restore service quickly, keeping the right people engaged and informed, and making sure every incident leaves behind something the organisation can act on.

You do not fix the outage. You make the response reliable: correct severity, the right engineers in the room, mitigation that does not stall, leaders informed in time, and follow-up work that survives the call.

Things You Get To Do

  • Command incidents end to end. Take command from declaration to mitigation, keeping responders focused on stopping customer and partner impact as fast as possible. Run the bridge, keep observers out of the responders' way, and name a stall out loud when you see one.
  • Classify and hold the line on severity. Set severity at declaration and re-check it as facts arrive. Risk advises on financial and regulatory materiality; the call is yours.
  • Engage the right people, fast. Identify the owning team by service, symptom and blast radius, page them, and expand the responder set the moment the first team is wrong or not enough. When a page goes unanswered, escalate - and escalate the escalation. Bring in the leaders who must make business calls: feature flags, traffic shedding, failover, freeze-or-ship.
  • Hold the bridge, and protect the people fixing it. Keep engineering and technical support uninterrupted - questions from stakeholders, partners and executives come to you. Be the single source of truth to the partner communications team on impact, severity and timing: you decide when a status page update or partner contact is needed, they write and send it, and chasing a late or stale update is yours.
  • Run follow-the-sun handoffs. Deliver warm, high-fidelity handoffs across regions: current impact and severity, mitigation path and next actions, who is in the room, outstanding decisions, and what must not be dropped. The incoming commander confirms ownership before you step away - command never goes dark at a region boundary.
  • Close the loop, on the clock. Maintain the timeline of facts as the incident runs rather than reconstructing it afterwards - in a regulated business that record has to hold up long after the call ends. Once mitigated, make sure a blameless retrospective is scheduled with a named owner and a timebox, and record where the cause sits - that choice sets which follow-up items are mandatory. Every action item needs a real ticket, one named accountable, a priority and a category, delivered inside the agreed service level. If a postmortem produces nothing but low-priority items, treat that as a signal the analysis stopped early and escalate to SRE rather than passing it on.
  • Automate the coordination away. Coordination is the part of this job that should eventually belong to a machine. Every manual prompt you send - the update that is due, the question nobody answered, the partner nobody contacted - is a candidate for automation, and the direction we are heading is AI handling the routine so commanders can spend their attention on judgement. You get us there by working to the decision trees, saying where they are wrong, and being honest about which of your instincts are actually rules.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 4+ years commanding or co-commanding high-severity incidents in a production engineering, SRE or technical operations environment.
  • You direct technical responders under pressure without being the person writing the fix.
  • You make and defend crisp severity and escalation decisions, and you take charge without waiting to be asked. Command means waking senior people at 03:00, interrupting an executive, and telling an experienced engineer to stop what they are doing - with an audience watching. It is a visible, directive role and it needs to be instinctive.
  • You can read a dashboard and judge for yourself whether impact has actually stopped.
  • You communicate clearly with engineers, executives and partner-facing stakeholders - and you know the difference between briefing the comms function and speaking for the company.
  • You are comfortable holding other teams to account in the moment, across a reporting line that is not yours, without turning it into friction.
  • You thrive in a follow-the-sun model with clean cross-region handoffs.
  • You understand FinTech concepts and the trust stakes of API-driven financial platforms.
  • You use AI tools and agentic automation to reduce manual toil and speed up response.
  • You will work a regional coverage window as part of a global 24x7 Incident Commander roster.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Formal incident command training - ITIL, Major Incident Management or crisis management.
  • Experience with modern incident management and on-call platforms.
  • You have written severity rubrics, decision trees, escalation matrices, runbooks or incident playbooks.
  • You have commanded in game days, tabletop exercises or incident simulations, not only in production.
  • You have partnered with problem management or reliability programme functions to roadmap incident follow-ups.
  • Online securities trading or capital markets experience, or another regulated, market-hours-sensitive domain.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Overview / About us

Lumanity is dedicated to improving health outcomes by accelerating and optimizing access to life-changing medicines. As a global strategic partner that brings together strategy, evidence, engagement, and technology, we were designed to engineer breakthrough value to tackle our clients’ toughest challenges by revolutionizing how value is generated, demonstrated, and communicated.

Responsibilities / Position overview

Lumanity’s Patient-Centered Outcomes (PCO) team is seeking an experience patient-centered outcomes research professional to serve as our Senior Director of Patient-Centered Outcomes.

As Senior Director, you will be responsible for providing strategic and scientific guidance to internal stakeholders and clients on various projects related to clinical outcome assessments (COAs), including but not limited to literature reviews, gap analyses, COA development, embedded interviews, natural history survey research, and regulatory and endpoint strategy. Working closely with all project team members, you will also supervise more junior staff.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Apply research to meet clients’ needs, including providing clients with strategic guidance on COA strategy in the context of drug development
  • Review project deliverables (e.g., study protocols, study reports, client presentations) to ensure quality
  • Support business development efforts by building relationships with new and existing clients, bringing in new leads, and writing proposals for PCO projects
  • Manage projects as needed, including developing plans to accomplish all activities within project scope and timelines, delegating project tasks to project teams and leading client meetings
  • Contribute to training and mentoring of more junior staff

You will also be expected to present at scientific conferences and/or publish in peer-reviewed journals to further the patient preference research field and demonstrate Lumanity’s capabilities. The individual in this role will also be responsible for an annual business development target.

Qualifications

Requirements include:

  • An undergraduate degree in health-related field required (master’s or doctorate degree in a health-related field preferred)
  • At least 8 years previous relevant work experience with increasing levels of responsibility in the field of patient-centered outcomes
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the drug development process and regulatory guidelines pertaining to patient-centered outcomes
  • Excellent English oral and written communication skills and comfort liaising with technical and non-technical clients (both internally and externally)
  • Experience in consulting
  • Published work in peer-reviewed journals and/or presented at conferences

Preferred (but not essential) skills and experience include:

  • Experience with economic evaluations and HTA submissions, including but not limited to literature reviews, gap analyses, documenting the humanistic burden of disease, utility elicitation, patient preference studies and global value dossier development
  • Mastery of technical skills in at least some of the following areas: expert elicitation, conjoint analysis, contingent valuation, discreet choice experiments, best-worst scaling, time trade-off and standard gamble methods

EMCD is a leading technology company in the crypto industry, best known as the largest mining pool in Eastern Europe. We are expanding globally and building a comprehensive ecosystem of crypto services, including payment infrastructure, custody, mining solutions and enterprise-grade tools for businesses and institutions.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Go Developer to own the blockchain rails that move user funds across our ecosystem. This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of every deposit and withdrawal: connecting new networks, keeping the ledger accurate to the last unit, and resolving incidents before they turn into losses. It suits someone who enjoys untangling complex systems and treats reliability with real money as a craft.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain blockchain rail services: deposits, withdrawals, address management and node interaction.
  • Integrate new networks and coins end to end, from analysis to production, covering nodes, address derivation, precision, fees and confirmations.
  • Own the ledger layer: entries, balances, holds, and reconciliation between on-chain data and internal accounting.
  • Take full ownership of the deposit and withdrawal rails, including incidents such as uncredited deposits, stuck or duplicate withdrawals and refunds: investigate them using production and on-chain data, then fix the root causes.
  • Contribute to design sessions, write HLDs and ADRs, and break work down into clear tasks.
  • Review code, mentor teammates and take part in the team's on-call rotation.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of commercial Go development in production.
  • Hands-on experience with blockchains, covering both the UTXO model (BTC and its forks) and the account model (EVM, TRON): node RPC, confirmations, reorgs, fees and mempool.
  • Solid understanding of keys and addresses: HD derivation (BIP32/44), address formats and transaction signing.
  • Experience with ledger and double-entry accounting: entries, holds (authorize capture/void), balance invariants and reconciliation.
  • Strong grasp of reliability when handling money: idempotency, double-spend protection, the outbox pattern, at-least-once delivery with deduplication, and eventual consistency.
  • PostgreSQL expertise: transactions, locking and isolation levels.
  • Distributed systems experience with gRPC and RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and the monitoring stack (Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Practical use of AI tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to speed up onboarding and development.
  • Ability to write clear HLDs and ADRs and well-structured Jira tasks rather than one-liners.

  • Real impact and ownership in fintech and crypto projects.

As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You'll Love This Role

Cribl Search powers high-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots.

Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in.

Cribl is looking for a backend-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote-first, diverse, inclusive, cross-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale.

On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …

  • Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products
  • Own high-impact changes to large-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI-driven agentic workloads
  • ​​Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions
  • Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability
  • Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities
  • Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap
  • Lead projects end-to-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience
  • Share on-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership
  • Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody’s feedback helps shape our process
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – this position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties


If You've Got - We Want It

  • Strong experience designing and operating multiple-petabyte-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage
  • Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data
  • Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch)
  • Experience working on high-performance, data-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter
  • Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals
  • Polyglot engineer – C++ experience is highly desirable
  • Ability to problem-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team
  • Experience with C++, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$205,000—$240,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
