description: About the Opportunity The Commercial & Industrial Team facilitates the management of our non-residential demand response programs, where businesses such as factories, offices and retail sites reduce their energy use when the grid needs it.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer, C&I
raw.excerpt: About the Opportunity The Commercial & Industrial Team facilitates the management of our non-residential demand response programs, where businesses such as factories, offices and retail sites reduce their energy use when the grid needs it.
raw.description:
About the Opportunity

The Commercial & Industrial Team facilitates the management of our non-residential demand response programs, where businesses such as factories, offices and retail sites reduce their energy use when the grid needs it. These programs cover some of our largest customers and programs by flexible grid capacity. Our team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a first class platform for our clients. This is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future.

Main Responsibilities: What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of large, loosely scoped data engineering projects on the C&I measurement and verification (M&V) platform. That pipeline takes raw meter data through baselines, event performance and payments to the reports our operations teams and partners rely on
  • Break complex, ambiguous problems into well-scoped tracks of work that your teammates can pick up. Roadmap them with reliable estimates of time, effort and risk
  • Help tackle tech debt and collaborate to drive the technical direction for the team’s Snowflake and dbt codebase: layering and model design, incremental processing, Python in the warehouse, and the orchestration and CI that support them
  • Own the health of our production pipelines. Strengthen data tests, monitoring and alerting, troubleshoot and resolve incidents (including on-call support), and cut tech debt and build times along the way
  • Make sure payment and performance outputs are accurate and explainable, working closely with product, operations and customer-facing teams to turn program rules into correct, maintainable logic
  • Make the team better through thoughtful code review, documentation and pairing. Teach what you know, learn from teammates at every level, and help the team’s practices improve
  • Tech stack: Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, AWS (S3), MongoDB, GitHub Actions
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Skills and Experience: What you need

  • First and foremost, you sincerely love data and all the things it can enable and empower
  • Professional experience designing, building and operating production data pipelines, with a track record of leading projects from ambiguous idea to successful release
  • Advanced SQL, with strong dbt experience in a layered (staging, intermediate, marts) project. That includes incremental models that stay correct when data arrives late, changes or is deleted, and backfills you can run with confidence
  • A track record of making slow or expensive pipelines faster and cheaper on Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse, by reading query profiles, choosing the right materializations
  • Strong data modeling: choosing the right grain, keeping the history of data and configuration that change over time, and producing results that can be reproduced and explained months later
  • Strong Python for data work, including pandas and numpy
  • Experience with time-series or event-based data, such as meter or sensor readings, and with the data quality issues that come with it (gaps, duplicates, late arrivals, time zones)
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing (for example dbt unit and data tests, pytest), CI/CD, and monitoring and alerting for pipeline health. You use them to change existing pipelines in small, safe steps and show that outputs only changed where you meant them to
  • Experience choosing among architectural approaches and tradeoffs, with strong, well-founded opinions you hold with an open mind
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you document larger initiatives, explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, and give and receive feedback with empathy
  • A history of taking ownership of problems that have no clear owner. You enjoy pairing, and you teach and learn from teammates at every level
  • Warmth and welcome for your collaborators and colleagues, with an urge to help them succeed

Preferred Skills and Experience: Nice-to-haves

  • Snowflake depth beyond SQL: Python UDTFs and stored procedures, streams and tasks, clustering, warehouse sizing and cost management
  • dbt beyond the basics: custom macros and materializations, cross-project refs and jobs-as-code
  • Experience with semi-structured sources such as MongoDB and file formats like CSV, JSON and Parquet
  • Background in energy, demand response, utilities or other settings where data drives billing or payments
  • Experience leading a migration, or a long-running initiative that spans teams

Why work for EnergyHub?

  • Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
  • Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
  • Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
  • Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.
  • Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate.

About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

To learn more, visit energyhub.com.

Company Benefits

EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.

EnergyHub is an Equal Opportunity Employer

EOE, Including Disability/Vets. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact .

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

Notice To Third Party Agencies:

EnergyHub understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you.

The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

Base Salary Range
$130,000—$170,000 USD

raw.title: Fractional Head of Growth
raw.excerpt: About LBC Mortgage LBC Mortgage is an established, Los Angeles-based mortgage brokerage with over 20 years of industry experience.
raw.description:
About LBC Mortgage

LBC Mortgage is an established, Los Angeles-based mortgage brokerage with over 20 years of industry experience. We operate across 11 states and work with more than 100 lending partners, helping clients find mortgage solutions tailored to their needs.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Fractional Head of Growth to take ownership of our marketing growth strategy, strengthen lead generation, and help scale the company's business.

We already have an established marketing infrastructure, including SEO specialists, a Marketing Project Manager, CRM automation, content production, and existing lead-generation initiatives.

We are not looking for someone who simply provides marketing ideas or high-level recommendations. We need a growth leader who can evaluate our current performance, identify opportunities, lead the execution, and translate marketing efforts into measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

1. Growth Strategy & Lead Generation

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive growth strategy focused on increasing qualified mortgage leads.
  • Evaluate existing acquisition channels and identify opportunities to improve performance.
  • Establish clear KPIs and prioritize initiatives based on lead quality, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and funded loan volume.
  • Identify new and scalable opportunities for customer acquisition.

2. SEO Strategy & Organic Growth Recovery

  • Audit the existing SEO strategy and investigate the significant decline in organic traffic.
  • Work closely with our current SEO specialists to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Establish measurable recovery milestones, timelines, and accountability.
  • Develop a strategy to work toward restoring approximately 300 high-intent organic leads per month.
  • Oversee SEO performance, technical improvements, content strategy, and organic lead generation.

3. Paid Acquisition (Google Ads / PPC)

  • Evaluate our current paid acquisition opportunities and develop a structured PPC strategy.
  • Help identify, recruit, and manage experienced mortgage PPC specialists or agencies.
  • Design and oversee controlled-budget campaign testing.
  • Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and acquisition economics.
  • Identify successful campaigns and develop a strategy for scaling them.

4. Conversion Optimization & Marketing Funnel

  • Analyze the complete customer journey, from the initial website visit to a funded mortgage.
  • Identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities to improve performance.
  • Optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, appointment booking, and follow-up processes.
  • Collaborate with our CRM and automation team to improve lead management and attribution.
  • Ensure marketing performance is measured through applications, closed loans, and revenue, not just clicks and impressions.

5. Marketing Team Leadership & Execution

  • Provide strategic direction to our existing Marketing Project Manager, SEO specialists, and external marketing partners.
  • Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance expectations.
  • Lead structured weekly marketing performance meetings.
  • Ensure projects move from planning to execution and are continuously evaluated.
  • Build a culture of accountability, testing, and data-driven decision-making.

6. Growth Experiments & New Opportunities

  • Explore additional growth channels, including educational content, webinars, referral programs, strategic partnerships, and employer partnerships.
  • Develop structured experiments with defined budgets, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Identify repeatable and scalable customer acquisition opportunities.
  • Continuously test new approaches and discontinue initiatives that fail to deliver results.

Requirements & Qualifications

Strongly Preferred:

  • Proven experience generating qualified mortgage leads in the U.S. market.
  • Previous experience working with mortgage brokers, lenders, or financial services companies.
  • Strong understanding of SEO, Google Ads, PPC, conversion rate optimization, and performance marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience managing marketing teams, specialists, and external agencies.
  • Ability to connect marketing performance with actual business outcomes, including applications, funded loans, and revenue.
  • Experience developing and executing growth strategies for businesses with longer sales cycles.
  • Understanding of U.S. mortgage advertising regulations and lead-generation challenges.

Also Open To:

Exceptional growth leaders from insurance, lending, or other financial services industries who have a proven track record of generating high-intent leads and managing complex customer acquisition funnels.

Who Would Not Be a Good Fit?

  • Generalist social media marketers without measurable lead-generation experience.
  • PPC specialists who can manage campaigns but lack broader growth strategy and leadership capabilities.
  • Consultants who provide recommendations without taking responsibility for execution.
  • Candidates who focus primarily on impressions, clicks, and inexpensive leads rather than qualified opportunities and business outcomes.
  • Individuals who require a fully established strategy and detailed instructions rather than taking initiative and ownership.

Application Requirements

Please include the following information in your application:

  1. Industry Experience: Briefly describe your experience in U.S. mortgage or financial services lead generation.
  2. Proven Results: Provide two examples of businesses where you successfully improved qualified lead generation. Include actual performance metrics, such as lead volume, conversion rates, cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, or revenue growth.
  3. Team Management: Describe your experience managing SEO specialists, PPC teams, or external marketing agencies.
  4. SEO Recovery: How would you approach a mortgage brokerage whose organic traffic has declined by approximately 70–80%? What would your first 60–90 days look like?
  5. Availability & Compensation: Please indicate your location, availability, preferred working arrangement, and expected monthly compensation.

What We Expect From This Role

We are looking for someone who can think strategically, challenge existing assumptions, independently identify growth opportunities, and lead execution.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of the company's marketing performance, work effectively with our existing team, and help transform our marketing infrastructure into a predictable and scalable source of qualified mortgage business.

We value measurable results, initiative, accountability, and the ability to turn strategy into execution.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Expérience dans la coordination d’équipes multidisciplinaires et la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets.
  • Flexibilité permettant de s’adapter aux horaires de clients situés dans différents fuseaux horaires.

Qualifications souhaitées et exigences particulières

  • Certification PMP (Project Management Professional) ou capacité à l’obtenir dans les douze (12) mois suivant l’embauche.
  • Certification PRINCE2.
  • Expérience avec des solutions TI en santé, particulièrement dans les domaines de la radiologie ou de la cardiologie.
  • Expérience antérieure dans un environnement de Services professionnels ou dans des rôles d’implantation auprès de clients.

Exigences relatives aux déplacements

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

Role Title: Game Developer

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • Gameplay implementation

  • Test design

  • Game engine expertise

  • Engine fluency

  • Game development expertise

Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  • Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.

  • Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.

  • Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.

  • Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.

  • Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.

  • Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.

  • Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.

  • A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.

  • Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.

  • Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.

  • Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.

  • Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Works with Revenue Cycle leadership to ensure ongoing development, testing, implementation, maintenance and operational optimization of Epic’s Revenue Guardian module and/or other related claim editing software. Monitors trends in billing edits to identify needs for retraining and optimization of the build of editing tools to minimize manual intervention and maximize compliance. 1. Manages payor and claim CCI, OCE, MUE, LCD and NCD edits in a timely, accurate and compliant manner.

4. Provides assistance to departments regarding compliance with government regulations, when requested as it relates to claim edits.

5. Works with revenue cycle leadership, chargemaster committee, and clinical departments (when required) to ensure optimal charge capture for services provided.

6. Maintains up to date knowledge of payer policies and government regulations to ensure compliant and accurate billing processes. Communicates relevant information to revenue cycle leadership.

7. Performs root-cause analysis for high volume edits to reduce the incidence of non-billable charges. Works with technical Epic team to correct any technical error causing incorrect charge routing and clinical departments and/or HIM on missed charges.

8. Reports on the volume of claim edits to leadership with the goal of reducing the volume of edits occurring over time and to quickly identify any new claim errors that begin with updated policies.

10. Provides support and assistance to Revenue cycle Leadership as needed.

Job Purpose The Physician Advisor performs case reviews of all case types in a knowledgeable and conscientious manner to achieve the highest degree of compliance. The Physician Advisor works closely with the Client’s medical staff leadership, the entire medical staff, including resident physician house staff, all areas of resource management, case management, social services, discharge planning, and utilization management to recommend methods to optimize use of hospital services for all patients. This includes identifying opportunities to optimize length of hospital stay and efficient management of resources, ensuring patients are in the appropriate level of care, supporting documentation, coding improvements and compliance, and monitoring the appropriate use of diagnostic and therapeutic modalities.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responds to requests for assistance on clinical reviews for medical necessity or any other reason, by any member of the Case Management department in a timely fashion
  • Provides consultation to attendings, nurses, and case management staff regarding complex clinical issues and advises on justification required for continued stay, medical necessity and utilization management
  • Obtains familiarity and working knowledge of standard published criteria such as MCG/InterQual and applies professional judgment and patient specific variables as may be necessary or justifiable
  • Maintains accountability for achieving case management outcomes and fulfills the obligations and responsibilities of the role to support the medical staff in the clinical progression of patient care
  • Describes ways to provide improved health record documentation that specifically affect ICD code assignment capture of severity, acuity, risk of mortality, and DRG assignment
  • Participates in ongoing training and education related to the Physician Advisor role and responsibilities including topics related to Utilization Management, Care Management and other related areas as requested
  • Meets productivity and quality standards within established time requirements. Work product and performance meets or exceeds quality standards.
  • Achieve performance goals as outlined in employment agreement
  • Maintains confidentiality of patient care and business matters
  • Demonstrates behavior that supports the organization’s mission. Participates in required orientation and training related to the Physician Advisor role
  • Demonstrates commitment to meeting/exceeding strategic initiatives of organization
  • Upholds the organization’s values of teamwork and professionalism and applies Code of Conduct standards to all members of the healthcare team
  • Facilitate, mentor, and educate other physicians regarding payer requirements
  • Attends all meetings as requested by PAOC leadership
  • Participate in the peer review process as may be necessary or requested
  • Maintain medical licensure and board certification in good standing
  • During scheduled work hours, commits full attention to Physician Advisory and execution of outlined tasks
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Use, protect and disclose patients’ protected health information (PHI) only in accordance with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) standards
  • Understand and comply with Information Security and HIPAA policies and procedures at all times
  • Limit viewing of PHI to the absolute minimum as necessary to perform assigned duties

Qualifications

  • Board Certified and licensed to practice medicine in the US or 3+ years active clinical experience in the US
  • 3+ years working as a Physician Advisor performing Level of care reviews as well as Peer to Peer Reviews
  • Basic technical skills with Hospital EMRs a must
  • Hold and maintain an unrestricted medical license and Board Certification
  • Possess or acquires a solid foundation, knowledge, and/or experience in the areas of utilization management, quality improvement, and patient safety
  • Possess a working knowledge of (Hospital) organization & case management operations and administrative standards and policies
  • Familiarity with MCG/InterQual placement status criteria is preferred

  • Able to effectively present information, both formal and informal
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to communicate well at all levels of the organization
  • Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions based on accurate and timely analyses
  • High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results oriented
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills required

raw.excerpt: Why Join GEICO?  At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.
raw.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Overview:

The Business Intelligence Analyst III / IV is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and visual analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role transforms complex data into meaningful reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support operational and strategic business outcomes.

The associate partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data engineering partners to deliver scalable visual reporting solutions, establish semantic modeling standards, and translate advanced analyses into clear recommendations. Microsoft Power BI is the primary business intelligence platform for this role; however, the associate is expected to remain agile and use Apache Superset or other visualization tools when they are better suited to the business need.

As a member of an agile team, the incumbent contributes to solution design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, production support, report certification, and modernization of enterprise reporting assets. The role focuses on business intelligence and visual analytics rather than primary ownership of source-data engineering or Power BI tenant administration.


Level Expectations :


Business Intelligence Analyst III: Designs end-to-end BI solutions, including semantic and metric layers, data models, reports, and dashboards. Applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to move reporting from descriptive insight toward diagnostic analysis of performance drivers and customer behavior, while introducing predictive approaches where appropriate. Works independently with minimal guidance, leads solution components, partners with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, and provides technical guidance to peers.

Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Leads the design of complex, reusable BI solutions and serves as a technical lead for reporting and analytics initiatives. Balances regular delivery responsibilities with leadership of cross-functional projects, establishes semantic modeling and reporting standards, reviews technical designs, influences BI architecture and tooling decisions, and mentors analysts and developers across levels.


Responsibilities:


  • Design end-to-end business intelligence solutions, including semantic and metric layers, dimensional data models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visual analytics products.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using DAX, Power Query, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, performance drivers, customer behaviors, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Translate descriptive reporting into diagnostic insight and introduce predictive approaches where appropriate to the business question and available data.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, evaluate findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, compelling recommendations.
  • Establish, document, and promote semantic modeling standards, reusable design patterns, visualization standards, and reporting best practices.
  • Support report certification by validating solution quality, consistency, usability, maintainability, performance, documentation, and adherence to established standards.
  • Publish and support Power BI solutions through Power BI Service, including Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Optimize report and semantic model performance, refresh reliability, storage-mode selection, and overall user experience across BI platforms.
  • Assess the downstream impact of design choices involving Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Row-Level Security, refresh strategies, and available Power BI capacity.
  • Evaluate visualization technologies and select Power BI, Apache Superset, or other appropriate tools based on business need, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Use Snowflake and other approved enterprise data sources to deliver reliable, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and technology partners to ensure source data is available, reliable, understandable, and usable for reporting.
  • Document report definitions, calculations, assumptions, semantic models, technical designs, and support procedures.
  • Lead improvements to reporting processes, including automation of recurring outputs and reduction of manual effort.
  • Support report migration and modernization initiatives, including conversion of legacy reporting solutions to modern BI platforms and reusable semantic model architectures.
  • Perform testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and post-implementation support.
  • Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, status reporting, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members through design, DAX, query, and solution reviews.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Serve as technical lead for complex reporting and analytics initiatives, lead cross-team projects, review technical designs, and mentor analysts and developers across levels.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, Power Query, data visualization, and enterprise BI architecture.
  • Experience publishing and supporting Power BI solutions through Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries used in reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable solutions with minimal guidance.
  • Must have the following experience:
  • Business Intelligence Analyst III: 4-7 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: 7-10 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, semantic models, and visual analytics solutions.
  • Experience partnering with stakeholders to define business questions, gather requirements, assess findings, and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with enterprise data platforms and large-scale datasets.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Microsoft Power BI administration certification or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of Power BI administration concepts.
  • Strongly preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric features such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, and related capabilities.
  • Strongly preferred experience using Snowflake as a primary enterprise data source for reporting and analytics.

Position Overview


We are seeking an operationally focused Collaboration Systems Engineer to join the Autodesk Collaboration Experience team.


In this role, you will run, support, and continuously improve key collaboration platforms, including Slack and other enterprise SaaS platforms that support business operations and engineering productivity.


You will apply standard procedures to administer, monitor, troubleshoot, and automate day-to-day platform operations, and build practical integrations and workflows that keep these systems reliable, secure, and well governed. We are looking for people who are curious, have an aptitude to learn quickly, who thrive on solving problems and can think outside the box.

  • Monitor platform health and triage, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, automation failures, and performance issues using standard procedures and runbooks
  • Build, maintain, and support Slack apps, bots, workflows, and integrations (Events API, Block Kit, slash commands, webhooks) that improve collaboration and operational efficiency

About Kensington Grey

Kensington Grey is a leading influencer management firm specializing in representing diverse talent across various platforms and amplifying underrepresented voices. We work with top-tier talent to develop their brand, negotiate partnerships, and maximize their impact in the digital space. Our mission is to foster diversity, equity, and inclusion within the influencer landscape, amplifying underrepresented voices and driving meaningful change in the media and entertainment industry.

Position Overview:

This role is for a highly organized Contract Administrator with experience in entertainment, media, or creator economy environments to support our legal and business affairs operations.

This role will work closely with our Contract Specialists and Talent Management teams to manage contracts, legal documentation, compliance processes, and administrative legal workflows across creator partnerships, brand deals, and talent agreements.

The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of experience in entertainment, media, or influencer/creator-focused organizations, understands contract structures and legal terminology, and thrives in a fast-moving, high volume deal-driven environment.

This role is designed for professionals who enjoy working in legal operations and contract administration. While there are opportunities to expand responsibilities over time, this position is intended as a specialized operational role supporting legal and business affairs, rather than a legal counsel or attorney track.

This role is fully remote, with strong preference for candidates located in New York state.

Responsibilities

  • Support throughout the lifecycle of contracts, including intake, tracking, revisions comparison, signatures, and storage.
  • Maintain and organize talent agreements, brand partnership contracts, NDAs, licensing agreements, and amendments.
  • Track contract milestones, and deliverables across 4-5 Contract Specialists and their respective Talent Mangers
  • Coordinate signature workflows using digital signature platforms (DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, etc.).
  • Maintain Lumi, the company’s legal contract repository and documentation systems.
  • Support the development and maintenance of contract templates and standardized legal documentation.
  • Assist with redlining agreements and implementing revisions based
  • Ensure proper version control and documentation of all contract revisions.
  • Coordinate with external counsel on contractual issues, legal review, and compliance questions.
  • Serve as a liaison between talent management, brand partnerships, finance, and Business & Legal Affairs as required
  • Identify opportunities to improve legal workflows, documentation systems, and contract management processes.
  • Conduct legal research to support as needed
  • General administrative support and special projects when assigned
  • Help develop scalable processes to support high-volume creator and brand partnerships.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in a legal administrative, contract administration, or business affairs role.
  • Experience working in entertainment, media, talent agencies, production companies, or creator economy environments.
  • Strong understanding of contract structures, legal terminology, and contract law basics.
  • Experience managing multiple agreements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional organizational and documentation skills
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and discretion
  • Experience with the following is preferred: DocuSign / electronic signature platforms, Google Workspace

At Kensington Grey, we believe in fostering a dynamic and rewarding work environment where talent thrives.

As a valued member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

✅ Competitive Compensation – We recognize your expertise with a salary and bonus structure that reflects your impact.

✅ Exciting Brand Collaborations – Work with top-tier talent, global brands, and high-profile campaigns that shape the entertainment and digital landscape.

✅ Innovative & Collaborative Culture – Join a passionate team that values creativity, fresh ideas, and a hands-on approach to success.

✅ Comprehensive Benefits Package – Enjoy health insurance, retirement plans, and additional perks that make a difference.

✅ Networking & Industry Access – Gain exclusive access to industry events, brand partnerships, and top-tier connections that fuel your professional growth.

Be part of a company that values your contributions and empowers you to make an impact.

Ready to grow with us?

Only applicants selected for interview will be contacted.

Thank you!

raw.description:
We are seeking a results-driven and strategic Regional Marketing Manager to join our team and make an immediate impact on our revenue growth. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced marketing leader with a proven track record of designing and executing high-impact, data-driven marketing programs that support and accelerate the sales pipeline.

In this role, you will be responsible for partnering closely with sales leadership to craft a go-to-market (GTM) strategy that drives measurable results. The ideal candidate will excel at planning and executing events—ranging from large trade shows to intimate regional engagements—while using a data-centric approach to optimize performance and ensure alignment with key business objectives.

This role is the regional “full-stack” marketer for Cybersecurity & Risk. You will activate and adapt field-ready programs from Integrated Marketing’s Solution Marketing team and build market-specific programs for local opportunity. You will orchestrate the full mix, from inbound digital and nurture through to events, rather than lead with any single channel. Events are one part of an integrated approach and you will own the pipeline outcomes across all of it. You will work with central digital, performance media and AI-powered capabilities and apply them in market with local judgment.

As the primary marketing lead, you will focus on demand generation throughout the sales funnel, ensuring that programs are optimized to increase both lead volume and quality. This includes planning, executing, and measuring the success of high-visibility events and customer engagement activities to build and accelerate the pipeline, ultimately driving pipeline conversion to revenue.

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re passionate about data-driven marketing, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering measurable business impact. Strong communication skills and the ability to align marketing efforts with business goals are critical, as you'll be closely collaborating with sales, product, and technical teams to ensure seamless execution of field programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and Execute Regional Marketing Programs: Partner with sales leadership to design and execute marketing initiatives that generate and accelerate pipeline at every stage of the funnel, with a strong emphasis on top-of-funnel activities.
  • Event Planning and Execution: Lead the planning, execution, and follow-up of regional events, trade shows, customer engagement initiatives, and other local marketing activities aimed at building and accelerating the sales pipeline.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, account management, and the technical SE team to ensure alignment of field marketing efforts with overall business objectives. Act as the bridge between marketing and sales to ensure the success of pipeline-driving activities.
  • Content Development: Leverage corporate messaging, product positioning, and industry insights to develop compelling content and communications that resonate with target audiences, including technical and executive stakeholders (CIOs, CISOs, DevOps, Security Architects, etc.).
  • Performance Measurement and Optimization: Provide closed-loop reporting on the effectiveness of field marketing programs. Analyze campaign performance, track key metrics, and recommend actionable optimizations to continually improve ROI.
  • Effective Communication: Maintain transparent and frequent communication with key stakeholders, including the marketing leadership team, sales, and executive leadership. Ensure alignment on goals, progress, and outcomes of field marketing initiatives.

  • Integrated, Full-Funnel Programs: Plan and run integrated programs across digital, ABX and in-person channels. These cover paid and owned digital, email and nurture, webinars, and executive and customer engagement. Match the mix to audience, account and buying group.

  • Digital and ABX Orchestration: Work with central digital, performance media and marketing operations to localize campaigns, set audience and account targeting, and optimize conversion from inbound to pipeline.

  • Solution Marketing Interface: Adapt global Cybersecurity & Risk programs to the region, and feed regional insight and proven local programs back to Solution Marketing.

  • Buying Group Engagement: Identify security buying groups (CISOs, security architects, IT and risk leaders) and design account-based journeys with sales.

  • Specialist Partner Marketing: Work alongside specialist partner marketers to align field programs with partner activity, while keeping ownership of the field-led pipeline outcome.

  • Measurement and Optimization: Own closed-loop reporting from engagement to pipeline and revenue. Use insights to reallocate investment and test new approaches.

  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Apply AI tools in planning, content localization, audience insight and campaign optimization. Share what works with peers.

  • Skills and competencies

  • Digital and Omni-Channel Marketing: Hands-on understanding of digital channels (search, social, display, content syndication, email, webinars) and how they combine with events and ABM across the buyer journey.

  • Marketing Technology and Analytics: Working proficiency with marketing automation, CRM and campaign dashboards, with an ability to turn data into decisions.

  • Orchestration and Influence: Ability to deliver outcomes through central teams, agencies and partners without direct control of every resource.

  • AI Fluency: Practical experience embedding AI in marketing workflows, insight and personalization.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B Field Marketing, ideally within a security or enterprise software environment.
  • Proven ability to plan, execute, and optimize marketing programs that target technical and executive audiences (CIOs, CISOs, DevOps, Security Architects, etc.).
  • Experience managing integrated programs across digital, ABX and events with a data-driven mindset, ensuring clear metrics for success and continuous improvement.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, start-up environment, with experience building and scaling marketing programs from the ground up.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a track record of successful collaboration with cross-functional teams across sales, marketing, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work seamlessly in a decentralized, cross-cultural team environment, fostering strong relationships and driving alignment toward common goals.

  • Demonstrated experience running digital and ABM programs alongside in-person activity, with measurable impact on pipeline conversion.

  • Experience working in a global-regional matrix with central or agency-led digital capability.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Make a Direct Impact: Your efforts will have a direct influence on pipeline development and revenue growth, making you a key player in the company’s success.
  • Collaborative and Innovative Environment: Work with a talented and diverse team in a fast-growing company where your ideas will be heard and valued.
  • Grow with Us: Opportunities to expand your leadership and marketing skills as part of a high-performing, data-driven marketing organization.

Job Description

At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

This is a great opportunity for CRA's currently working within the life science sector for pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies or CRO's to work with a world-leading CRO across multiple sponsors, various protocols and therapy areas.

These roles can be performed remotely for CRA's based close to our clinical 'hubs': Milan, Bologna, Florence, Rome and Naples. Travel requirement will be national across Italy.

Essential Functions:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
  • Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
  • Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
  • Documents observations in reports and letters according to timelines using approved business writing standards.
  • Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follows all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
  • Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites.
  • Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience:

  • University degree in a science related field
  • CRA Qualified as per the Ministerial Decree dated 15/11/2011 and at least 1 year of independent monitoring experience in clinical development phases II-IV
  • Understanding of ICH-GCP, EU and FDA requirements
  • Fluency in English and in Italian
  • Valid Driver's License

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Proven clinical monitoring skills
  • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
  • Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
  • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
  • Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
  • Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
  • Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • Effective interpersonal skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as require
  • Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software

As well as being rewarded a competitive salary, we have an extensive benefits package based around the health and well-being of our employees. We have a flexible working culture, where PPD truly value a work-life balance. We’ve grown sustainably year on year but continue to offer a collaborative environment, with teams of colleagues eager to share expertise and have fun together. We are a global organization but with a local feel.

Our 4i Values:

Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement

If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you

raw.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.
The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.
This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
  • Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
  • Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
  • Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
  • Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
  • Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
  • Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
  • Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
  • Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
  • Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
  • Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
  • Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
  • Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
  • Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

    Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
  • Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
  • Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
  • Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
  • Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
  • High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
  • Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

PREFERRED COMPETENCIES

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field
  • At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
  • Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
  • Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
  • Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.
Recruitment Agency Notice:
We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.
As a Certified B Corporation and one of Denver’s “Best Places to Work”, we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.
At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:
·Impact – We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
·Balance – Put family first; work hard/have fun
·Determination – Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
·Professionalism – Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
·Honesty – Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally
·Kindness – Create an environment where kindness, empathy, and vulnerability are embraced

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT

At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot.
Pivot invests in company-wide trainings, assessments, and programs to advance internal inclusion and equity practices, such as employee allyship building, cross-cultural communications, and equitable hiring and management protocols to increasingly recognize bias and ensure mutual respect and belonging.

EEO STATEMENT

Pivot Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to increasing the diversity of its workforce. We actively work to cultivate an inclusive culture that welcomes, empowers, and enables equitable career growth for employees regardless of background.

What You'll Do

Principal Marketing Operations, AI & Agent Systems

About the Function

Avalara is seeking a highly technical, hands-on leader to build, govern, and scale the shared AI agent fleet that powers every team across Revenue Marketing. This role sits within Revenue Marketing Programs and is the single owner of agent quality and performance org-wide spanning Market & Audience Intelligence, Planning & Optimization, and Campaign Execution.

This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management position. You will operate at Director-level scope and influence, but your primary value is technical: designing, building, and orchestrating agents that let our GTM function scale output, efficiency, and business impact. You will partner closely with and Segment and Product GTM teams, Events, Product, Growth, and Partner Marketing teams to embed agents into their workflows, while defining the standards, guardrails, and roadmap that keep the fleet reliable and impactful.

This role reports into our Director of Revenue Programs and is central to Avalara's agentic-first operating model where humans strategize and orchestrate, and agents execute at scale.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Agent Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the roadmap and prioritization for the shared agent fleet across our core pillars of: Market & Audience Intelligence, Planning & Optimization, and Campaign Execution

  • Prioritize agent investment based on impact and scale rather than first-in, first-out; resource the highest-return use cases first

  • Partner with Revenue Programs and Revenue Marketing leadership to align the agent roadmap to enterprise pipeline and GTM priorities

Agent Development & Deployment

  • Build, test, and deploy agents across the fleet including Competitive Monitoring, Review Monitoring, Audience Sizing, Product Usage Insights, Path-to-Plan Planning, Channel Optimization, Campaign Performance, Brief Development & Deployment, Messaging Testing & Dev, Content & Creative, Campaign Ops & Activation, and Sequence Builder

  • Work with our IT teams to own the technical architecture for agent orchestration, including integrations with core marketing systems (Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense, Power BI, ON24)

  • Establish QA, monitoring, and guardrails to ensure agents operate reliably and safely at production scale

Governance & Quality

  • Serve as the single owner of agent quality and performance standards across Revenue Marketing

  • Define and enforce standards for agent accuracy, reliability, and responsible operation

  • Manage the full agent lifecycle — build, iterate, retire — based on performance data and evolving business need

Cross-Functional Enablement

  • Partner with Enterprise, SMB, Product-Led GTM, Events, Product, Growth, and Partner Marketing teams to embed the right agents into each pod's workflow

  • Enable and train teams on how to use, prompt, and interpret agent outputs; act as the technical point of contact for agent-related questions

  • Translate team-specific needs into shared, reusable agent capabilities rather than one-off builds

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track adoption, utilization, and ROI of the agent fleet across every Revenue Marketing team

  • Continuously optimize existing agents based on usage data, performance signals, and stakeholder feedback

  • Monitor market and competitive signals to proactively evolve the fleet ahead of demand, rather than reacting to results

Key Metrics & KPIs

  • Agent adoption and utilization across Revenue Marketing teams and pillars

  • Agent reliability and accuracy against defined quality standards

  • Efficiency gains (speed-to-market, capacity created) enabled by the agent fleet without added headcount

  • Contribution to campaign velocity, pipeline performance, and funnel conversion across teams using the fleet

Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption rate across pods (Enterprise, SMB, Product-Led GTM, Events, Partner Marketing)

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing technology, marketing operations, or AI/automation engineering, with a track record of designing and scaling automated or AI-driven systems

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-powered workflows, including prompt engineering, orchestration frameworks, and API integrations

  • Strong fluency with core B2B marketing platforms (Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense, Power BI, ON24) and how agents plug into them

  • Proven ability to operate as a senior individual contributor and technical subject-matter expert — influencing and enabling teams without formal authority over headcount

  • Solid grounding in full-funnel B2B revenue marketing (demand generation, campaign lifecycle, funnel metrics) to ensure agents solve real GTM problems

  • Experience owning technical roadmaps and governance frameworks in a matrixed organization

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; able to translate technical capability into business impact for non-technical audiences

  • Comfortable operating managing agents vs humans; show a bias toward building and orchestrating rather than managing human headcount

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
