About DMI

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com

About the Opportunity

DMI, LLC is seeking an IT Project Manager to support the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Application Management Support Services (AMSS) program. The successful candidate will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic IT initiatives supporting mission-critical applications, enterprise systems, and infrastructure services within a federal environment. This position requires a proven project manager with experience leading IT projects, overseeing application transition and modernization efforts, and supporting contract transition activities in accordance with federal acquisition and operational requirements. The Project Manager will collaborate with government stakeholders, technical teams, subcontractors, and corporate leadership to ensure successful service delivery and continuous operational excellence.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Project Leadership & Delivery
    • Lead the successful execution of multiple IT projects supporting SEC mission and business operations.
    • Develop and manage project schedules, resource plans, budgets, risk registers, and performance metrics.
    • Monitor project progress and ensure delivery of contract requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), and program objectives.
    • Facilitate status meetings, executive briefings, and stakeholder reviews.
    • Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, systems engineers, cybersecurity professionals, cloud engineers, and operations staff.
    • Support Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Application Transition & Modernization
    • Plan and execute application onboarding, migration, modernization, and operational transition activities.
    • Lead discovery efforts, application assessments, and transition readiness reviews.
    • Develop transition plans, knowledge transfer strategies, transition schedules, and operational runbooks.
    • Coordinate data migration, environment validation, testing, and production cutover activities.
    • Ensure continuity of operations and minimize disruption during transition events.
    • Track and report application transition milestones, risks, and dependencies.
  • Contract Transition Management
    • Support contract phase-in and transition activities for newly awarded federal programs and task orders.
    • Develop and execute contract transition plans in collaboration with government customers and corporate leadership.
    • Manage staffing transitions, onboarding activities, knowledge transfer sessions, and operational handoffs.
    • Coordinate transition activities with incumbent contractors, subcontractors, and agency stakeholders.
    • Identify and mitigate transition-related risks to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
    • Establish and monitor transition success criteria and performance measures.
  • Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for government program managers and technical leadership.
    • Prepare and deliver project status reports, executive summaries, and performance dashboards.
    • Build productive relationships with client stakeholders and internal leadership teams.
    • Support governance processes, change control boards, and program management reviews.
  • Risk, Compliance & Quality Management
    • Identify, document, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
    • Ensure compliance with federal security, privacy, and operational requirements.
    • Support audits, contract deliverables, quality assurance reviews, and corrective action initiatives.
    • Maintain project documentation in accordance with PMO, agency, and contractual standards.

Qualifications

Education and Years of Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of IT project management experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years supporting federal government IT programs or contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting application transition, migration, modernization, or onboarding efforts.
  • Experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, and subcontractor performance.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies, Agile practices, and IT service management principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience briefing senior government officials and executives.

Required Skills:

  • Federal Project Management
  • Stakeholder Relationship Management
  • Risk and Issue Resolution
  • Resource and Financial Management
  • Strategic Planning and Execution
  • Process Improvement and Operational Excellence
  • Team Leadership and Mentorship

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience supporting the SEC or other federal civilian agencies.
  • Experience working in regulated or financial industry environments.
  • Experience with cloud migration, DevSecOps, application modernization, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing geographically dispersed technical teams.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.

Preferred Certifications:

One or more of the following certifications is highly desirable:

  • Project Management Professional (PMP)
  • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
  • SAFe Agilist (SA)
  • ITIL Foundation or higher

Clearance Requirements: Must possess or be eligible to obtain and complete a Public Trust security clearance.

Citizenship Status Required: Must be a U.S. Citizen. Cannot have dual citizenship.

Physical Requirements: None required for this position.

Location: Remote, US

Minimum Salary Rate

$84,774

Median Salary Rate

$105,968

Working at DMI

DMI is a diverse, prosperous, and rewarding place to work. Our culture is shaped by five core values that guide how we work, grow, and succeed together:

  • Do What’s Right – We lead with honesty and integrity.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility and deliver.
  • Deliver for Our Customers – We are relentless about delivering value.
  • Think Bold, Act Smart – We innovate with purpose.
  • Win Together – We collaborate and celebrate our success.

These values aren’t just ideals—they show up in how we support every part of your well-being:

  • Convenience/Concierge – Virtual health visits, commuter perks, pet insurance, and entertainment discounts that make life easier.
  • Development – Annual performance reviews, tuition assistance, and internal career growth opportunities to help you thrive.
  • Financial – Generous 401(k) matches, life and disability insurance, and financial wellness tools to support your future.
  • Recognition – Annual awards, service anniversaries, referral bonuses, and peer-to-peer shoutouts that spotlight your achievements.
  • Wellness – Healthcare coverage, wellness programs, flu shots, and biometric screenings to support your health.

DMI values employees for their talents and contributions, and we take pride in helping our customers achieve their goals. Because when we live our values, we all win together.

***************** No Agencies Please *****************

raw.excerpt: About Us InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it.
raw.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the shared technology platform that powers how InStride delivers care. This role sits at the intersection of our platform and the teams using it every day: turning real business and clinical needs into scalable capabilities that can be reused across the company. You will work closely with forward-deployed engineers and business leaders to decide what gets built and why. That includes helping teams solve immediate problems while also recognizing the patterns that should inform the broader platform roadmap. Over time, your work will help us move away from one-off builds and third-party tools toward reusable capabilities.

This is a highly hands-on role for a technically fluent product leader. You will use AI to prototype and explore ideas, test concepts before committing engineering resources, and step into engineering-adjacent work when it helps the team move faster. You will also help determine when a business need should become a reusable platform investment and when a one-off solution is the better answer. You will help define the problems we solve, the outcomes we’re aiming for, and the priorities and tradeoffs that shape the work. You will iterate with speed and flexibility while maintaining the quality, privacy, and clinical standards our patients and families depend on. Most importantly, you will help shape how Product works at InStride and how our shared platform evolves to meet the needs of a growing, increasingly complex business.

This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, prioritize, and drive delivery of shared platform capabilities that solve business and clinical needs and align with the broader product vision.
  • Turn ambiguous business and clinical problems into clear product opportunities, including the problem to solve, desired outcomes, requirements, success metrics, and key tradeoffs.
  • Partner with engineers and business owners to decide when a need should become a reusable platform capability and when a one-off solution is the better fit, and identify patterns that point to the next capability worth building.
  • Work closely with Engineering and Design to shape and ship solutions, with enough technical depth to understand systems, integrations, dependencies, and constraints.
  • Use AI tools to test ideas quickly and step into engineering-adjacent work, such as specs, configuration, or data analysis, when it helps the team move faster.
  • Build business cases for capabilities that reduce manual engineering work and reliance on third-party vendors, applying clear cost-benefit thinking to build, buy, and configure decisions.
  • Learn from the solutions business teams and forward-deployed engineers are building together, identify recurring needs that should influence the shared platform, and partner with the Group Product Manager and platform engineering leads to prioritize those investments.
  • Define KPIs, measure adoption and impact, and use data and user insight to prioritize what to improve next.
  • Identify where AI-enabled workflows can become scalable platform capabilities and partner with Engineering on how those solutions should be designed.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • 6+ years of software product management experience, including ownership of complex products, platforms, internal tools, or technical workflows from discovery through adoption, with a track record of moving meaningful business or organizational KPIs.
  • Strong technical fluency and credibility with Engineering, including comfort going deep on architecture, data models, APIs, system configuration, and tradeoffs such as tech debt versus features or build versus buy.
  • Hands-on AI fluency: you use AI regularly to prototype, analyze, automate, and accelerate your own work, and have experience building AI-enabled products, automations, or agentic workflows. You see AI as an accelerator, not a substitute for strong product judgment and critical thinking.
  • Experience designing configurable, reusable capabilities and recognizing when patterns across one-off needs should become shared platform solutions.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to structure ambiguous, cross-functional problems, set priorities, make clear tradeoffs, and operate independently with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Data fluency, including comfort using BI tools and usage data to answer product questions, validate assumptions, define and measure impact, and guide decisions.
  • A bias toward fast validation, using lightweight research, experimentation, and prototyping to de-risk investments before committing to a build.
  • Strong collaboration and influence skills, with the ability to partner closely with engineers and business leaders and shape priorities you do not directly own.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party products and determining when to configure, buy, or replace vendor tools with in-house capabilities.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare services, behavioral health, digital health, workflow software, vertical SaaS, or another operationally complex or regulated environment.
  • Experience working with forward-deployed, solutions, or embedded engineers building on a shared platform.
  • Experience in a scaling startup or familiarity with data science workflows.

Salary

The expected annual salary for this role is between $135,000 and $150,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, etc.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

About the Role

Labviva is seeking a highly detail-oriented Supplier Implementation Associate to manage the onboarding of new suppliers onto our B2B procurement marketplace. You will review, transform, and validate product catalog data so customers can purchase products for R&D, Life Sciences, Maintenance & Repair and more. You will work directly and consultatively with suppliers, guiding them through our onboarding process, explaining technical and data requirements, and following structured technical processes to get catalogs and integrations live, working closely with the software engineering team.

You will collaborate closely with the broader Supplier team and other internal teams to ensure timely and accurate catalog uploads, resolve discrepancies, and maintain clear documentation throughout the process. You will also support technical integration projects for suppliers, such as punchout, aiming to improve customer experience and efficiency. This role is a strong fit for someone with a background in client onboarding, software implementation, or technology consulting who enjoys working with large datasets.

Please note: this is not a logistics, freight, warehouse, or customer support role. The core of the work is catalog data, systems, and supplier facing implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier onboarding from kickoff to go live, keeping supplier launches aligned to customer go live dates.
  • Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of supplier product catalogs and supplier company data. Follow and implement structured processes for efficient catalog onboarding and data management.
  • Clean, transform, and validate large catalog datasets, including pricing, units of measure, and manufacturer data.
  • Communicate clearly and consultatively with suppliers to explain onboarding and technical requirements, provide feedback, and recommend the best path to go live.
  • Diligently and frequently follow up with suppliers for deliverables that impact customer launches on Labviva and procurement goals for existing customers.
  • Gather and document integration requirements (punchout, catalog feeds, pricing files) and collaborate with Product Data and Engineering to prepare, validate, test, and submit catalog data for upload.
  • Investigate and escalate issues proactively, identify root causes, and provide solutions to resolve data inconsistencies or gaps.
  • Track progress, maintain organized documentation, and follow up promptly on supplier inquiries using Jira, HubSpot, and Google Workspace.
  • Use AI tools and automation to improve repeatable processes such as catalog QC and ticketing.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree required.

  • 2 to 3 years in a client facing role such as supplier or client onboarding, software implementation, or technology consulting, with experience managing product, catalog, or other large datasets.
  • Intermediate or Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills with a proven track record of working with complex spreadsheets and large datasets.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort leading calls with suppliers and managing expectations.
  • Basic technical acumen to understand specifications and requirements supporting supplier and customer integrations.
  • Experience with Google Suite, Jira, and CRM systems such as HubSpot.

• Basic SQL is preferred.

  • Bonus: exposure to eProcurement or ERP platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer), punchout (cXML or OCI), or the life science industry.

About Labviva

Labviva is on a mission to accelerate the pace of life science research. We connect researchers with suppliers of reagents, chemicals and instrumentation in an intuitive, user friendly platform that supports the priorities of scientists while staying compliant with purchasing rules.

We are a venture funded startup that acknowledges that the unique contributions of each team member drive our success. We commit to creating a diverse and inclusive workspace where people can make a positive impact. At Labviva, we invest in our employees and strongly believe that a culture of respect and support drives success for all involved.

We are an equal opportunity employer and building a diverse team is our top priority. At Labviva, we celebrate all. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform the life sciences industry. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

raw.description:
Director, Data Plane Engineering - Grid

About Quvia

Quvia is the first AI-powered quality of experience (QoE) management platform for things that move, like ships and planes, transforming connectivity and digital experiences even in the most remote and hard-to-reach places.
The Quvia platform uses AI and machine learning to seamlessly blend any combination of connectivity, regardless of provider, orbit or network, into one, vendor-neutral environment. It then delivers comprehensive, end-to-end analytics and dynamic network orchestration that optimizes for the best possible QoE for applications and end-users.
Quvia works with world-leading, Fortune 500 companies in aviation, cruise, shipping & energy.

Why Quvia?

Founded in 2019, Quvia is a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about redefining global connectivity. Our solutions are already addressing significant challenges in the aviation and cruise industries and we’re just getting started. With headquarters in the greater Miami region and offices in the UK and India, our remote-first culture empowers talented individuals around the world to make a lasting impact. Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm with over $5 billion in fund commitments.

Position Overview

Reporting to the SVP, Engineering, you will lead a team of Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers and Architects building Quvia Grid, the network software behind our connectivity platform. You will turn business and product goals into clear engineering priorities, run a disciplined weekly delivery cadence and surface risks early, providing direction, context and accountability without micromanaging senior engineers who own their technical decisions.

Eligibility: In order to be considered, candidates can be remotely based in the U.S. or Canada.

What You'll Do

Planning and Delivery

  • Turn company and product objectives into a prioritized plan with clear owners, dependencies and milestones.
  • Own the weekly execution cadence: track progress against commitments, remove blockers and adjust as priorities change.
  • Balance roadmap work with architecture, technical debt and production issues, and make trade-offs and capacity constraints visible to leadership.
  • Report status, milestone confidence and risks clearly, using practical delivery-health and quality measures.

People Leadership

  • Manage and coach Staff and Principal Engineers and Architects, preserving their autonomy while holding the team accountable for shared outcomes.
  • Give direct feedback, resolve technical disagreements and make sure decisions end in clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Partner with the SVP, Engineering on hiring, organization design and team development.

Technical Direction and Quality

  • Guide the design of high-performance, reliable network software in C/C++, Python and Linux, with enough depth to challenge proposals and weigh trade-offs.
  • Join design reviews and complex debugging selectively to speed up decisions, without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Work with Product, QA and DevOps on scope, release readiness, test automation and performance validation.
  • Lead the response to critical defects and production issues, with clear ownership, root-cause analysis and corrective action.

What You'll Bring

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 5-7 years of experience leading software teams that deliver complex, production-quality systems, including directly managing Staff or Principal Engineers or Architects.
  • Experience turning broad goals into executable plans across multiple concurrent workstreams and explaining trade-offs to executives and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Substantial hands-on experience in networking, embedded or Linux infrastructure software, with strong C/C++ and working knowledge of Python.
  • Solid networking fundamentals: Ethernet, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, VLANs, routing, switching and the TCP/IP stack.
  • Linux systems programming (sockets, multithreading, performance-sensitive code) and virtual networking (VMs, bridges, TAP/TUN, virtual switches).
  • The ability to guide debugging with packet captures, logs and crash dumps, and a strong grounding in CI/CD, automated testing and release management.

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Software for satellite, terrestrial, hybrid, maritime, aviation or other connectivity-constrained environments.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams.
  • High-performance packet processing (DPDK, VPP) and SDN/NFV or software-defined connectivity platforms.
  • KVM, libvirt and Open vSwitch; network management and telemetry (SNMP, REST, NETCONF/YANG, OpenConfig, gRPC); Docker, Kubernetes and Jenkins.

How You Lead

  • You make priorities and ownership explicit, follow through without creating a culture of blame, and lead experienced engineers through context and trust rather than task-level control. You make timely decisions, think in systems, adapt to changing priorities and put team outcomes ahead of personal ownership.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineers know the top priorities, what they own and how their work connects to broader commitments.
  • Weekly planning produces realistic commitments and surfaces risks and dependencies before they become delivery surprises.
  • Senior engineers keep meaningful autonomy while working as one coordinated team.
  • Leadership gets clear, timely information on delivery confidence, quality and trade-offs, without added overhead.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Equity options
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities
  • Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
  • Life Insurance
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • 401(k) plan

Qualifications

raw.excerpt: Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST Employment Type: Full-time, Remote Job Overview We are seeking an experienced Background Screening & Fulfillment Specialist with hands-on experience working for a US-based background screening or background check company.
raw.description:
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
Employment Type: Full-time, Remote

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Background Screening & Fulfillment Specialist with hands-on experience working for a US-based background screening or background check company.

The ideal candidate must have a strong understanding of US background screening operations, including processing and fulfilling screening orders, conducting record searches, verifying information, reviewing results, and preparing accurate screening reports.

This role requires someone who understands the end-to-end background screening fulfillment process, has practical knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and can confidently support US-based clients and business operations.

Beyond fulfillment responsibilities, the individual will also assist with client account management, administrative activities, and sales and marketing support during slower business periods.

Candidates with direct experience working for US background screening companies or Consumer Reporting Agencies (CRAs) are strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Background Screening & Order Fulfillment

  • Process and fulfill background screening orders for US-based clients.
  • Conduct background research and searches using relevant databases, court records, and other authorized resources.
  • Perform criminal record searches and other applicable background screening verifications.
  • Review, verify, and assess information obtained from various sources for accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential issues requiring further investigation.
  • Prepare, compile, and deliver accurate background screening reports within established turnaround times.
  • Maintain proper documentation and update order statuses throughout the fulfillment process.
  • Ensure all screening activities are handled in accordance with applicable FCRA requirements and company procedures.

Client Account Management & Communication

  • Communicate professionally with US-based clients regarding order progress, results, and outstanding requirements.
  • Respond to client inquiries and provide timely updates.
  • Manage routine client requests and escalate complex issues when necessary.
  • Maintain strong client relationships through clear, proactive, and professional communication.

Administrative & Business Support

  • Handle administrative tasks related to order processing, documentation, and account management.
  • Maintain organized records and ensure information is accurately updated.
  • Support sales and marketing activities during slower fulfillment periods.
  • Assist with other operational activities that contribute to business growth and efficiency.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential Requirements

  • Previous hands-on experience working for a US-based background screening company, background check provider, or Consumer Reporting Agency (CRA).
  • Demonstrable experience processing and fulfilling background screening orders for the US market.
  • Strong understanding of US background screening processes, including criminal record searches, record verification, research, and report preparation.
  • Practical knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and its application to background screening operations.
  • Experience using background screening platforms, databases, or order management systems.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with US-based clients.
  • Strong critical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and handle unexpected situations without relying heavily on scripts or supervision.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple orders and meet turnaround time expectations.

Additional Advantages

  • Previous experience in client account management or customer-facing roles within the background screening industry.
  • Familiarity with employment, education, professional license, and reference verification processes.
  • Experience supporting sales, marketing, or business development activities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who understands the US background screening industry from practical experience, not someone who has only conducted general online research or worked in a general administrative position.

The ideal candidate:

  • Has previously worked for a US background check company or CRA.
  • Understands how screening orders are received, researched, processed, reviewed, and completed.
  • Is familiar with FCRA compliance requirements.
  • Communicates fluently and naturally in English.
  • Demonstrates good judgment, initiative, and the ability to think independently.
  • Can represent the business professionally when interacting with US-based clients.

Important: Applicants without direct US background screening and order fulfillment experience may not be considered.

raw.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
raw.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for an Accountant that is excited about the below Mission and Outcomes.

Mission: As an Accountant in our Australia team, your mission is to deliver accurate BAS lodgements, maintain clean financial records, and provide clients with clear, actionable financial insights. We’re looking for an excellent communicator who thrives on being the go-to person for clients’ accounting needs, offering support, clarity, and confidence every step of the way.

Outcomes:

    • Prepare and lodge accurate Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS), ensuring GST and payroll liabilities are reconciled and compliant with ATO regulations.
    • Maintain accurate financial records and full sets of accounts across a portfolio of clients, using cloud systems like Xero and Dext, including fixed asset management, journals, and reporting.
    • Oversee accounts payable and receivable processes, ensuring timely invoicing, collections, payments, and reconciliation of supplier/client accounts.
    • Collaborate with bookkeeping and tax teams to ensure accuracy of transaction recording, ledger integrity, and smooth financial operations.
    • Assist in preparing monthly management accounts and financial reports, offering clients clear insights to support decision-making.
    • Provide payroll support and maintain strong communication with clients, acting as their go-to advisor for day-to-day accounting needs and ensuring adherence to Australian regulatory standards.

To do this, you will have a minimum of 3 years experience as an Accountant within Australian Accounting and you will be located in the PHILIPPINES.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

Tech + services savvy: We are a tech-enabled services business, automating traditional, manual processes and delighting customers while doing so. You will thrive as someone who understands and is excited by the challenges and opportunities of utilising software to scale a business.

Problem Solving: You’ll need to be able to think on your feet as this role requires you to identify, diagnose, and resolve production issues quickly, reducing downtime. You will leverage your strong infrastructure and development skills in post-incident reviews to find the underlying cause of failures and prevent future incidents.

Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

Analytical Mindset: You have a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to dissecting problems. You excel at analysing complex systems and processes to identify weaknesses and inefficiencies, and your ability to evaluate multiple scenarios enables you to devise the best testing strategies. You apply data-driven decisions to enhance testing coverage and performance metrics, ensuring the highest standards of software quality.

Collaboration-Driven: You thrive in a cross-functional team environment, working closely with developers, product managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment on requirements and testing goals. You communicate effectively, advocate for quality throughout the development process, and proactively address potential issues before they arise, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for delivering exceptional software.

AI-ready and curious: Sleekbooks already utilises AI capabilities, but there are many more applications to be found and incorporated. We want the candidate to be able to identify additional AI-led applications and be able to ascertain the practicalities of those solutions

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One Way Video Interview / TA Screen

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a ~30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail.

Case study

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager, where they will give you some real-life challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.

Soft-skills assessment

A ~60 minute chat with a member of the HR or leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

- Your education

- Any criminal history

- Any political exposure

  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

    • We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

    By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

    Benefits

    Some other great things about working at Sleek…

    Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

    Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

    Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

    Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

    Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. We’re empowering organizations to secure their software–no matter how the code is written!

About the role

    The Channel Manager, North America Midwest is an integral role in building, developing and maintaining SCW's partner relationships while driving partner sourced and influenced revenue, working with the SCW direct sales teams and the partner sales and business development teams. In addition to the West region, this role also manages SCW's APAC partners, excluding OEM partners.


    SCW continues to grow and expand its partner ecosystem, and we are building partner loyalty through a partner program, positioning SCW to drive a balance of trade and joint incremental revenue. Partnerships in scope include Value Added Reseller (excluding GuidePoint Security), referral and ISV technical alliance partners.

Key responsibilities

  • Exceed quarterly and annual quota attainment targets for partner sourced and influenced revenue.

  • Co-develop business development plans with the appropriate partners.

  • Ensure the appropriate contracts are in place to support new partner relationships.

  • Manage partner business plan creation, administration and execution.

  • Develop positive, regular working relationships with preferred partners in the designated region.

  • Work with partners' sales teams to build and execute pipeline.

  • Ensure partners' compliance with the SCW partner program.

  • Oversee and host quarterly business reviews with partners to drive accountability and report on success metrics.

  • Report on success metrics on a regular cadence with direct leadership, and identify gaps and plans to close them.

  • Hold weekly or regular operating conversations with designated partner managers that drive pipeline creation and opportunity close.

  • Work hand in hand with Secure Code Warrior's sales leadership and inside sales team.

  • Assist in partner marketing activities such as trade shows, campaigns and other promotional activities.

  • Identify and recruit new strategic partners to drive revenue growth.

  • Manage SCW's APAC partner portfolio, excluding OEM partners. Own relationships with APAC resellers, distributors, technical alliance, referral and ISV partners, run regular pipeline and deal registration reviews with them, and coordinate with APAC sales leadership on partner engagement, conflict and enablement.

How success is measured

    Measures apply to both North America Midwest and LATAM, tracked separately for each region.

    Measure

    What it tracks

    Cadence

    Quota attainment

    Partner sourced vs influenced revenue against target

    Quarterly and annual

    Deal registrations

    Registrations submitted, approved and declined

    Quarterly

    Partner enablement

    Enablement sessions delivered to partners

    Quarterly and annual

    Partner meetings

    Partner meetings held

    Quarterly and annual

    Joint marketing

    Joint partner marketing events

    Quarterly and annual

Previous experience

  • 5 to 10 years of channel-related experience.

  • 3 to 5 years of channel experience in the cybersecurity market.

  • Experience working within the cyber partner community: VARs, OEMs, technical alliances and ISVs.

  • Experience managing partners across time zones, with familiarity with the APAC partner landscape preferred.

  • Demonstrable examples of leading partner incremental revenue growth in sourced and influenced ARR.

  • Strong business acumen.

  • Experience leading value and outcome based messaging.

  • Strong communication skills, a creative and thoughtful approach to assessing business metrics and plans to close gaps, a sense of urgency in developing channel led pipeline and supporting the close process, and a passion for the channel.

Competencies

  • Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

  • Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

  • Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with urgency, high energy and enthusiasm.

  • Applying knowledge of the business and marketplace to advance the organization's goals.

  • Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

  • Making sense of complex, high volume and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

  • Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

  • Building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and you’re a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

raw.description:
Enterprise Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Enterprise Transformation Director is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy to improve business performance, operational efficiency, financial sustainability, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role drives large-scale transformation initiatives across business operations, technology, organizational structures, digital capabilities, governance, and customer-facing services.

The incumbent translates corporate strategy into an integrated transformation roadmap, oversees strategic programmes and transformation portfolios, and ensures initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role works closely with the CEO, executive leadership, business unit heads, and external partners to drive sustainable organizational change and achieve strategic objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy, vision, and execution roadmap.
  • Translate corporate strategy into transformation priorities, strategic initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, organizational improvement, operational modernization, and sustainable growth.
  • Align transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide operating model redesign and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing business structures, processes, capabilities, and operating models to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive business process reengineering, simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Oversee transformation of insurance operations, investment services, distribution channels, and customer service functions.
  • Improve organizational agility, productivity, cost efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Oversee enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and digital business solutions.
  • Lead modernization and integration of enterprise applications, core insurance systems, investment platforms, and customer management technologies.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership to ensure digital investments support business strategy.
  • Promote innovation, data-driven decision-making, and technology-enabled business growth.

D. Transformation Portfolio & Programme Governance

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio, programmes, and major initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise transformation governance frameworks, performance controls, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor transformation milestones, budgets, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate transformation directors, programme managers, project leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital and resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial performance, and expected return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to track financial and non-financial outcomes.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Cultural Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management and organizational development strategies.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to drive workforce transformation, leadership alignment, and cultural change.
  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

G. Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee transformation-related strategic, operational, financial, technology, and compliance risks.
  • Collaborate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen governance and controls.
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational resilience, data governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure transformation programmes maintain appropriate oversight, accountability, and auditability.

H. Executive Stakeholder & Board Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, board members, executive committees, and business unit leaders.
  • Present transformation strategies, performance reports, financial outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead enterprise transformation steering committees and executive review meetings.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, strategic partners, technology providers, and regulators.
  • Ensure executive alignment and accountability for transformation outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or executive programme leadership.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior director-level or enterprise transformation leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong expertise in operating model redesign, business process reengineering, digital transformation, and organizational change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large transformation portfolios, budgets, executive stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong financial management, strategic planning, governance, and benefits realization capabilities.
  • Certifications such as PgMP, PMP, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation strategy and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation programmes delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost savings, revenue growth, and productivity improvements.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.
  • Digital adoption and technology modernization success rates.
  • Employee engagement, organizational readiness, and change adoption.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Executive and board-level stakeholder satisfaction.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed.

Who You Are

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically adept SharePoint and Communications Specialist with a background in intranet management or digital workplace roles and strong experience with SharePoint Online, Power Platform, M365 tools, and communications within large organizations to build, run, and improve our clients’ internal communications sites, automations, apps, and reports. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, the ability to learn quickly, proficiency with Microsoft tools, and great communication skills. The ideal candidate will handle daily publishing and support requests quickly and accurately while also creating, managing, and improving automated workflows, apps, and reports that drive operational excellence.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. The working hours for this role are 8 a.m.–5 p.m. PST. No third-party agencies, please.

The Role and Responsibilities

Site Management and publishing
  • Monitor a shared support inbox daily; resolve access requests, process publishing requests from content owners, and troubleshoot or escalate technical issues.
  • Publish content to SharePoint communication sites and related channels (Teams, Viva Engage, Outlook, and employee advocacy tools), including content uploads, new sites and pages, and web part updates.
  • Manage site settings, layout, navigation, and permissions, including security and distribution groups in Entra ID and Microsoft 365 groups; run periodic access audits.
  • Make sure sites meet accessibility standards using tools such as Accessibility Insights for Web and respond to accessibility issues.
  • Provide light editorial and formatting support, and advise content owners on layout, formatting, and graphics.
  • Prioritize work by business urgency and meet defined service levels, including same-day turnaround for standard requests and publishing urgent executive announcements within minutes of receiving content.
Automation, apps, and reporting
  • Build and maintain Power Automate flows (scheduled, automated, and instant), including approvals, email digests, and data syncs that support publishing, intake, and site operations.
  • Develop and support Power Apps (primarily canvas apps) for teams, designed to meet accessibility standards.
  • Build, secure, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that connect multiple data sources and meet compliance and accessibility audit requirements.
  • Produce weekly and monthly site analytics reports, run ad-hoc reports, and recommend actions to improve content visibility and engagement.
  • Connect solutions to Microsoft 365 data sources such as SharePoint lists, Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
  • Manage access and permissions across Power Platform environments, Dataverse, and service accounts.
  • Troubleshoot failed flows, fix errors quickly, and keep documentation current.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience as an intranet manager, digital workplace specialist, or in a similar role using SharePoint Online and Power Platform, including building and managing internal communication sites and pages, web parts, lists, libraries, and permissions, and building solutions in Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI.
  • Strong skills with expressions, conditions, loops, and HTML-formatted email output in Power Automate.
  • Experience building Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query and connecting multiple data sources.
  • Experience connecting to Microsoft 365 services and using connectors.
  • Experience publishing and managing content across Microsoft 365 communication channels, such as Teams, Viva Engage, and Outlook.
  • A strong eye for page design and layout, plus experience with intranet information architecture, navigation, and content governance.
  • Ability to share examples of intranet sites or pages you have built or managed.
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards and how to apply them to sites, apps, and reports.
  • Proven ability to learn new tools and processes quickly and apply them effectively.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Able to work independently, manage your own task list, and balance time-sensitive requests with longer-term development work.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to clearly and concisely communicate with clients via email, Teams chat, and video calls.
Additional or preferred qualifications
  • AI experience, such as writing and refining reusable prompts, building Copilot or SharePoint agents, and turning slow, manual prompt-based processes (such as SharePoint page and link audits) into repeatable, scalable automations.
  • CardioLog Analytics experience, including producing recurring usage reports and setting up, migrating, and maintaining CardioLog Analytics Power BI reports and workspaces.
  • Experience managing identity and access groups in Entra ID or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting internal communications or marketing teams in a large enterprise.
  • Microsoft certifications (for example, PL-900, MS-900, or PL-400/AB-400).
  • Experience at a consulting or professional services firm.
Additional Details
  • The offered pay range for this position is $80,000 – 100,000 per year, depending on experience.

We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. über das arbeiten bei envelio

Zu einfach ist langweilig! Gemeinsam haben wir die Mission, die Energiewende voranzutreiben. Wir lieben, was wir tun und dabei ist uns kein Thema zu groß. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Arbeit und wachsen an jeder neuen Aufgabe. Kurz gesagt: Own it, love it, grow with it.

Wir sind ein bodenständiges Team aus Kaffee- und Mate-Liebhaber:innen. Unser Geek-Humor resultiert in einer rituellen Nutzung von Emojis und der enzyklopädischen Herausarbeitung von unnützem Wissen. deine rolle

Als Partner Enablement Manager (all genders) unterstützt du unsere internationalem Implementierungspartner dabei, die Intelligent Grid Platform (IGP) vor Ort bei Netzbetreibern erfolgreich einzuführen. Du befähigst sie, dies eigenständig und auf hohem Qualitätsniveau zu tun. Du unterstützt Partner, prüfst gemeinsam mit ihnen Projekte und entwickelst Formate, Prozesse und Materialien, die zu ihrem Markt, ihrer Sprache und ihrem Erfahrungsstand passen. Dein Ziel ist es, Partner in die Lage zu versetzen, ihre Netzbetreiber-Kunden mit unserer Software in deren konkreten Anwendungsfällen erfolgreich zu machen.

Als eine der ersten Personen in diesem Bereich arbeitest du eng mit dem International Strategic Partner Manager im Vertrieb zusammen, der sich auf die kommerzielle Seite unserer Partnerschaften konzentriert, sowie mit dem Implementation Architect, der die technische Umsetzung unterstützt. Zudem bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Partner und leitest deren Feedback an die Projektteams, Customer Success und das Produktteam weiter.

wie du etwas bewirkst

  • Du entwickelst ein Enablement-Programm für internationale Implementierungspartner, inklusive Schulungen, Materialien und Zertifizierungspfaden, die über einzelne Partner und Märkte hinaus funktionieren.

  • Du stimmst dich mit dem Strategic Partner Manager und dem Implementation Architect zu Partnerübergaben und dem Partnerprozess ab und klärst die Zuständigkeiten an jeder Schnittstelle.
  • Du bringst das Partner-Feedback in die Produktentwicklung, die Dokumentation und die Enablement-Methodik ein.

dein profil

Perfektion ist ein Mythos! Vielmehr interessiert uns der Mensch hinter dem Bildschirm. Diese Kriterien sind also eher als Orientierungshilfe für dich gedacht. Wir sind gespannt, wie deine individuellen Fähigkeiten zu uns passen.

Meet the Team
Join Splunk’s Frameworks & Runtime Services team, where we’re building the next generation of internal developer platforms that power Splunk Cloud. Our team focuses on making it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and manage services across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, spanning public clouds and on-premises infrastructure.

As Splunk continues to modernize its platform and expand Kubernetes-based deployments, our work plays a critical role in improving developer productivity, simplifying service onboarding, and accelerating the delivery of new capabilities to customers. Our tooling and frameworks have already helped enable the deployment of many services on cloud reducing manual effort and operational complexity.

We’re a collaborative team that values technical ownership, knowledge sharing, and practical problem-solving. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges, influence platform architecture, and build solutions adopted by teams across Splunk. If you enjoy creating tools and platforms that make other engineers more productive, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Impact
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader, you’ll design and develop the foundational tools, frameworks, and services that enable Splunk engineering teams to build and deploy applications efficiently at scale. You’ll work on distributed systems and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, helping simplify how services are developed, deployed, and operated across cloud and on-premises environments. Your contributions will directly influence developer productivity, platform reliability, and the speed at which Splunk delivers new capabilities.

  • Design and build scalable developer platforms: Develop backend services, APIs, tools, and frameworks using Go and Python to simplify service development, onboarding, and deployment across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.
  • Advance cloud-native infrastructure: Build and enhance platform capabilities that support workloads across AWS, GCP, Azure, and on-premises environments, improving deployment automation, consistency, and scalability.
  • Improve developer productivity: Collaborate with engineering teams to identify common development and deployment challenges, create reusable solutions, and reduce the time and effort required to bring new services into production.
  • Drive technical excellence and reliability: Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design documents, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. Participate in a scheduled, compensated on-call rotation to support platform reliability and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate and influence engineering practices: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams, contribute to technical roadmaps, mentor fellow engineers, and explore AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years, Master’s with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
  • 4+ years of experience developing production services or infrastructure tooling using Go (Golang) or Python.
  • Experience mentoring engineering members and leading technical initiatives to support team growth
  • Experience deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting containerized applications using Kubernetes on a public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience developing or maintaining distributed systems, internal developer platforms, or shared infrastructure tooling used by multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and ability to break down ambiguous requirements, build a vision for the platform, and execute that vision.
  • Experience leading the end-to-end design and delivery of large-scale platform projects that improved developer productivity or system scalability.
  • Experience developing backend applications, automation, or infrastructure tooling using Python.
  • Experience building reusable developer frameworks, self-service tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure automation to improve developer productivity and service onboarding.
  • Experience with networking concepts, service-to-service communication, databases, or storage technologies in distributed and cloud-native environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or automation to support software development, testing, troubleshooting, or other stages of the software development lifecycle.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $151,600.00 to $222,400.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

  • Bilingual Support: Confidently conduct participant outreach, answer inbound queries, and deliver empathetic support in both English and Spanish.

What We Are Looking ForThis role requires a unique mix of clinical trial expertise, language skills, technical agility, and deep empathy. To be successful, you must bring:

  • Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of relevant Clinical Research experience.
  • Certifications: Current GCP certification and a strong working knowledge of HIPAA regulations. (Mental Health First Aid certification is a strong plus).
  • Tech Savviness: High comfort level navigating various communication pathways (web chat, email, phone lines) and helpdesk ticketing software. Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office is required.
  • The Contractor Mindset: Self-motivated, highly organized, comfortable with independent remote work, and capable of switching gears quickly between talking to a patient and collaborating with a clinical site.

  • Flexibility First: You will always be asked about your availability before being assigned to a specific study or service.

  • Travel: While this is primarily a remote role, if project-related travel to sites or outreach locations is required, full reimbursement is provided in line with company policy.
Ready to Navigate the Future of Clinical Trials?If you are looking for a flexible, patient-centric contract role where you can use your bilingual skills to make a difference at your own cadence, we want to hear from you.
