raw.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Functional Designer with deep, hands-on expertise in the Finance modules.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Functional Designer with deep, hands-on expertise in the Finance modules. You will lead the functional design, configuration, and optimization of financial processes in Dynamics 365 Finance: General ledger, Cash and bank management, Tax, Intercompany accounting, and Project management and accounting.

This is a functional finance role, not a development role. The right candidate understands

accounting and how Dynamics 365 Finance posts it. They have personally configured the finance modules, run the end-to-end process flows, and can explain how any transaction reaches the ledger. X++ or integration development experience is welcome, but it does not replace functional finance experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery and analysis of financial processes with client finance teams (controllers, accountants, treasury, project accounting).
  • Design and configure the chart of accounts, account structures, financial dimensions, and ledger setup for single and multi-entity organizations.
  • Define and configure posting profiles and ledger posting setup across General ledger, Accounts payable, Accounts receivable, Cash and bank management, and Project management and accounting.
  • Design sales tax setup, including tax codes, tax groups, settlement periods, and tax reporting.
  • Design and configure bank management and bank reconciliation, including statement import and matching rules.
  • Design intercompany accounting and intercompany transaction flows, including eliminations and consolidation.
  • Design the full project accounting lifecycle: project setup, contracts and funding, cost and revenue posting, invoicing, revenue recognition, and project closing.
  • Design and optimize record-to-report, and the financial side of procure-to-pay and order-to-cash.
  • Translate financial requirements into clear functional design documents that the development team can build from, and validate the delivered solution against them.
  • Support period-end and year-end close design, financial reporting, master data, and finance data migration.
  • Resolve complex functional issues and lead root cause analysis on posting, reconciliation, and reporting discrepancies.
  • Evaluate alternatives and clearly communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Lead solution validations, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and go-live readiness for
  • finance.
  • Guide less experienced consultants and support knowledge transfer across the team.
  • Manage assigned responsibilities while proactively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a functional consultant on the Finance modules of Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX 2012). Experience that is mainly development or technical does not meet his requirement.
  • At least two full-cycle implementations in which you personally owned the finance design and configuration, from discovery through go-live.
  • Solid accounting knowledge: double-entry bookkeeping, subledger-to-ledger reconciliation, period and year-end close, multi-currency, and multi-entity accounting.
  • Hands-on configuration experience in every area listed under Required Finance Module Expertisebelow.
  • Proven ability to write functional design documents and to work with developers on extensions and integrations.
  • Solid experience working with complex production environments.
  • B2 English proficiency, with the ability to understand functional and technical documentation and communicate effectively in a professional environment.

Required Finance Module Expertise

Candidates must be able to explain the setup, the process flow, and the resulting ledger postings ineach of these areas.

  • General ledger and account configuration>Chart of accounts design, main accounts, account structures and advanced rules, ledger setup, fiscal calendars, journals, period and year-end close.
  • Financial dimensions>Dimension design, dimension sets, default and derived dimensions, balancing dimensions, and their effect on posting and reporting.
  • Posting profiles >Customer, vendor, inventory, and project posting setup; how subledger transactions reach the general ledger; tracing a voucher back to its setup.
  • Sales tax >Tax codes, tax groups and item tax groups, ledger posting groups, settlement periods, tax settlement and reporting, withholding tax.
  • Cash and bank management>Bank account setup, advanced bank reconciliation, electronic statement import, matching rules, payment methods and formats.
  • Intercompany transactions >Intercompany accounting setup, intercompany journals, due-to and due-from accounts, intercompany trade, eliminations, consolidation.
  • Project management and accounting >Project types and groups, contracts and funding sources, categories, cost and sales prices, project ledger posting, work in progress, invoicing, revenue recognition, and project closing and finalization.
  • Accounts payable and receivable>Invoice and payment flows, payment proposals, settlement, and reconciliation to the ledger.
  • Financial reporting>Trial balance, financial statements, and reconciliation reports.

Key Areas of Expertise

Dynamics 365 Finance | General Ledger | Chart of Accounts | Financial Dimensions | Posting Profiles |Sales Tax | Cash and Bank Management | Bank Reconciliation | Intercompany | Project Management and Accounting | Record-to-Report | Financial Reporting | Functional Design

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

As a Strategic Account Executive (Apex Team), you will lead the identification, development, and execution of Granicus' most significant state government transformation opportunities. APEX is Granicus' elite, AI-enabled strategic pursuits organization, focused on unlocking large-scale modernization initiatives that help government agencies improve service delivery, increase operational effectiveness, and create better outcomes for the communities they serve. Senior level role designed for proven enterprise sales leaders who excel at creating opportunities where none previously existed, shaping executive buying agendas, and orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits. Unlike traditional territory-based sales roles, you will operate without geographic or account constraints, focusing exclusively on the company's highest-value strategic opportunities across federal, state, and local government. Supported by specialized AI-powered insights, dedicated pursuit resources, and the full breadth of the Granicus portfolio, you will serve as both a transformational seller and a strategic leader within the organization. You will influence pursuit strategy, executive engagement approaches, and best practices while helping establish APEX as a scalable growth engine for the future.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • ​​Create Strategic Opportunities
  • ​Identify, evaluate, and prioritize transformative government opportunities using AI-generated market signals, funding intelligence, modernization initiatives, legislative priorities, and emerging agency needs
  • ​Conduct in-depth market, agency, and stakeholder research to convert early indicators into qualified strategic pursuits
  • ​Develop executive access strategies that connect Granicus with agency leaders, CIO organizations, program executives, procurement stakeholders, and influential decision makers
  • ​Build and mobilize multi-threaded buying coalitions capable of sponsoring and advancing large-scale transformation initiatives
  • ​Create opportunities across both existing and net-new customers without traditional territory limitations
  • ​Lead Mission-Based Enterprise Selling
  • ​Own the full strategic pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, executive engagement, discovery, value engineering, solution development, procurement strategy, negotiation, and close
  • ​Develop executive-level business cases that quantify mission impact, citizen outcomes, operational efficiencies, service improvements, risk reduction, and return on investment
  • ​Align Granicus software, AI capabilities, digital services, and implementation expertise with customer priorities and funded modernization initiatives
  • ​Lead complex six-, seven-, and eight-figure opportunities through successful closure
  • ​Position Granicus as a trusted transformation partner and strategic advisor to government leaders
  • ​Lead Cross-Functional Pursuit Teams
  • ​Serve as the strategic leader of dedicated pursuit pods consisting of Pursuit Managers, GXG Experience Advisors, AI Advisors, Solutions Consultants, Customer Success partners, and executive sponsors
  • ​Direct opportunity strategy, stakeholder engagement planning, competitive positioning, value realization approaches, and pursuit execution
  • ​Coordinate contributions from internal subject matter experts, industry specialists, implementation teams, and executive stakeholders
  • ​Leverage strategic partners, systems integrators, and ecosystem relationships to strengthen competitive positioning and customer outcomes
  • ​Operate as the executive quarterback for complex pursuits, ensuring alignment, accountability, and execution excellence
  • ​Shape Strategic Pursuit Excellence
  • ​Help define and continuously improve strategic pursuit methodologies, executive engagement practices, qualification frameworks, and opportunity governance standards
  • ​Capture and institutionalize lessons learned, best practices, and successful pursuit patterns across the APEX organization
  • ​Provide market intelligence and customer insights that influence product strategy, AI investments, service offerings, and organizational priorities
  • ​Contribute to the evolution of the APEX operating model through thought leadership and practical field experience
  • ​Serve as a recognized expert in executive selling, government transformation, and strategic pursuit execution
  • ​Influence Across the Organization
  • ​Partner closely with Account Executives to align account strategy, customer engagement, and successful transition of APEX-led opportunities
  • ​Mentor and guide sales teams on executive engagement, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, and opportunity strategy
  • ​Influence organizational priorities through customer insights, market dynamics, and strategic opportunity intelligence
  • ​Collaborate closely with Sales Leadership, Product, AI, GXG, Marketing, Customer Success, and Services teams to improve win rates and customer outcomes
  • ​Drive alignment and decision-making across complex, matrixed teams without direct management authority
  • ​Drive Business Performance and Strategic Impact
  • ​Maintain accountability for strategic pipeline generation, opportunity advancement, executive engagement, forecast accuracy, bookings, and revenue attainment
  • ​Build and manage a focused portfolio of high-value pursuits supported by rigorous qualification, stakeholder mapping, mutual action plans, and deal inspection practices
  • ​Develop pursuit strategies for complex public-sector acquisition environments, including partner participation and competitive differentiation
  • ​Deliver measurable results in pipeline creation, pursuit conversion, deal size, bookings, win rate, and customer impact
  • ​Communicate performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership​

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • ​​12+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, AI, cloud, technology, digital services, or complex solutions sales experience
  • ​Demonstrated success originating opportunities and leading strategic pursuits resulting in significant revenue outcomes
  • ​Proven track record of personally closing seven-figure opportunities; experience with eight-figure pursuits strongly preferred
  • ​Experience selling to executive stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, agency executives, CIO organizations, and senior program leaders
  • ​Demonstrated ability to build executive relationships, shape buying agendas, and develop multi-stakeholder buying coalitions
  • ​Proven success leading enterprise sales opportunities through long, complex procurement and decision-making cycles
  • ​Experience influencing sales methodology, pursuit strategy, operating models, or organizational capability beyond individual opportunity ownership
  • ​Strong business acumen and ability to connect technology investments with measurable mission, operational, and financial outcomes
  • ​Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive alignment without formal people-management responsibility
  • ​Exceptional executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • ​Experience navigating government procurement environments or similarly complex regulated industries
  • ​Experience working with systems integrators, strategic partners, and multi-party pursuit teams preferred
  • ​Experience with government modernization initiatives, citizen experience solutions, AI-enabled platforms, workflow automation, digital services, or enterprise transformation programs preferred
  • ​Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • ​Ability to travel as business needs require

Pay Range

USD $400,000.00 - USD $500,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

The Culture

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.

Health & Wellness

Family & Future
  • Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
  • Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
  • Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Who we are:

EverTrue is the leading advancement intelligence and donor engagement platform, empowering educational institutions and non-profit organizations to build stronger relationships and achieve outstanding fundraising results. Our platform continuously evolves, integrating innovative solutions to help advancement professionals effectively identify, prioritize, and manage prospects, engage supporters, and track progress. Thousands of organizations rely on EverTrue to grow giving. We are a fun, smart, mission-driven team passionate about the work we do.

What truly drives us? It's our mission: to equip fundraising teams with the insights and tools to turn every donor interaction into a lasting relationship—leading to stronger connections and greater giving. And our vision? It's to create a world where every fundraiser has the tools to engage, retain, and grow generosity at every level, ensuring no donor is overlooked. When you join EverTrue, you're not just taking a job; you're becoming part of a movement to empower fundraisers and make a real difference in the world.

We believe in your potential. We know that no candidate perfectly matches every qualification. If you're excited about this role and meet most of our requirements, please apply! We're eager to support your growth and development within our team.

EverTrue is an equal opportunity employer. We're deeply committed to building a workplace that celebrates diversity, equity, and inclusion for all, ensuring every applicant and employee is treated fairly. We embrace DEI because we know it enhances engagement, satisfaction, and partnerships, making us all stronger together.

About the role:

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer to be the technical lead for our channel partners. You'll work with partner engineering and product teams to design, build, and support integrations that deliver EverTrue data and solutions, starting with DonorSearch and AIdentified DaaS, to their customers. You'll partner closely with the Partner Development Managers who are landing and growing reseller relationships, and you'll bring technical credibility to partner conversations, from first call through go-live.

Your integrations will span APIs, data feeds, AWS S3, and Snowflake, working with partners such as fundraising CRMs, giving and peer-to-peer platforms, data cloud providers, and AI companies.

Who you are:

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, integration engineering, or technical product roles—ideally within B2B SaaS or data-intensive products
  • Deep experience designing, scoping, and supporting REST API integrations (authentication, rate limiting, webhooks, and versioning)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS S3 and cloud-based data delivery, including IAM/access controls, encryption, and secure transfer workflows
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake (data sharing, ingestion, and data modeling), alongside practical experience with data feeds, ETL/ELT, and data pipelines
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (such as Python) for data validation, prototyping, and troubleshooting
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures for both external engineers and non-technical business stakeholders
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Enablement—with the organizational rigor to manage multiple partner integrations in parallel

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with channel partners, resellers, or ISV ecosystems
  • Familiarity with data licensing and Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) delivery models
  • Domain familiarity with nonprofit, higher education, or healthcare fundraising technology

What you’ll do:

  • Lead technical discovery. Join partner sales conversations to understand the partner's architecture, data needs, and integration requirements, and recommend the right approach.
  • Support the sales cycle. Run technical demos and workshops, answer security and architecture questions, and help scope integration effort as part of deals.
  • Design integration architectures. Define solutions using REST APIs, batch and scheduled data feeds, AWS S3 delivery, and Snowflake (including secure data sharing) that are secure, scalable, and repeatable.
  • Guide implementation. Serve as the technical point of contact for partner engineering teams during build, testing, and launch—troubleshooting issues and keeping integrations on schedule.
  • Champion data security and compliance. Make sure integrations meet EverTrue's data governance, privacy, and security standards, including partnering on security reviews.
  • Shape the product. Work with Product and Engineering to capture partner feedback, prioritize API and data delivery improvements, and influence the roadmap.
  • Build repeatable assets. Create reference architectures, integration patterns, API documentation, sample code, and onboarding guides that make each new partner faster to launch.
  • Enable the team. Partner with Product Marketing and Revenue Enablement to train Partner Development Managers and partner technical teams.

Why You’ll Love to Join Our Team:

We offer a comprehensive package designed to support your success, growth, and well-being.

  • Compensation and Core Benefits:
    • A base salary range of $105K - $115K.
    • A 2.5% bonus plan based on company performance.
  • We also provide robust benefits to keep you healthy and secure:
    • We cover 80% of your premium for medical, dental, and vision insurance.
    • We offer a 401k match of up to 3% to support your financial future.

Happiness & Well-Being:

Our comprehensive employee benefits and perks program provides:

  • A remote-first environment for flexible work.
  • Generous paid time off throughout the year.
  • Investment in your professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities to connect with colleagues both in-person and virtually.
  • The unique chance to contribute to the non-profits and educational institutions you care about, aligning your work with your passions.

Change Management Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Change Management Director is responsible for developing and leading the organization's change management strategy to ensure successful adoption of business transformation, organizational restructuring, digital initiatives, process improvements, and strategic transformation programmes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide change initiatives involving operating model redesign, technology implementation, regulatory changes, organizational culture, workforce transformation, and business process modernization.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to minimize resistance to change, strengthen organizational readiness, engage stakeholders, and ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate organizational transformation objectives into structured change management plans.
  • Lead change management activities across strategic programmes, projects, and business units.
  • Establish change governance structures, standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Advise executive leadership on organizational readiness, change impacts, and adoption strategies.

B. Organizational Transformation & Change Implementation

  • Lead organizational change initiatives involving restructuring, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
  • Assess the impact of strategic changes on employees, processes, systems, and organizational structures.
  • Develop change implementation roadmaps, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate change activities across business functions to ensure consistent implementation.
  • Ensure new processes, systems, and organizational structures are effectively embedded into daily operations.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Work closely with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners to build commitment to change.
  • Lead executive communication, employee engagement, and organizational awareness initiatives.
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage resistance to organizational changes.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to monitor employee sentiment and change readiness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Management

  • Lead change management activities associated with digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and new business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT and technology teams to assess the organizational impact of system implementations.
  • Develop training programmes, user adoption strategies, and technology transition plans.
  • Monitor technology adoption and ensure employees effectively transition to new digital working practices.

    • Participate in deal development, solution design, and customer planning activities specific to clinical resource inclusion.
    • Help identify opportunities to expand value-added services and strengthen long-term customer partnerships.
  • Clinical Applications & Customer Success Alignment
    • Develop integrated engagement models that create a seamless customer experience across TSSPs, CAS teams, and Imaging Advocates.
    • Identify and address gaps in customer adoption, workflow optimization, and clinical performance.
    • Serve as a voice of the customer to influence future service offerings and capability development.

  • Knowledge of change management, operational excellence, and process improvement methodologies.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational development, business transformation, or programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or organizational transformation leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide or business-unit change initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of change management frameworks, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and organizational readiness.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, technology adoption, business process redesign, and organizational restructuring.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of the organization's change management strategy.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Effectiveness of stakeholder communication and engagement.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and management feedback.
  • Compliance with change management governance and reporting standards.

raw.description:
Шукаємо Administrator / DevOps IT Support, який долучиться до команди та допомагатиме підтримувати стабільну роботу IT-інфраструктури компанії. Це можливість розвивати свої технічні навички, працювати з Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD та поступово поглиблювати знання в адмініструванні й автоматизації інфраструктури.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech – українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв'язку.
Наша місія – змінювати життя в Україні та в світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.
Понад 700 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та веб-рішення, а також проектування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.
Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен з нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове

Що ти будеш робити

  • Траблшутити та усувати помилки
  • Налаштовувати моніторинг за участю та підтримки колег із відділу моніторингу
  • Налаштовувати інцидент-менеджмент за участю та підтримки колег із відділу моніторингу
  • Розробляти та реалізовувати плани бекапування
  • Розробляти та реалізовувати автоматизоване розгортання
  • Розробляти IaC-рішення
  • Писати технічну документацію
  • Опрацьовувати інциденти
  • Налагоджувати комунікацію між відділами для побудови автоматизованого моніторингу Core-сервісів компанії
  • Проводити рев'ю та аналіз коректності даних реалізованих дашбордів у Grafana
    • Адмініструвати інфраструктуру VMware (VCF):
  • Тестувати нові впровадження від вендорів
  • Вдосконалювати існуючі рішення

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • Linux (Oracle Linux / Red Hat): базові навички адміністрування, робота з командним рядком, службами, процесами, правами доступу та логами.
  • Docker: практичний досвід роботи з контейнерами, створення Docker-образів та налаштування їхнього запуску.
  • Kubernetes: розуміння основних компонентів, робота з kubectl та базова діагностика проблем.
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI): розуміння принципів роботи пайплайнів, навички їх читання, редагування та пошуку помилок.
  • Ansible: базовий досвід роботи з playbook, inventory та автоматизацією конфігурацій.
  • Git: впевнена робота з гілками, комітами, merge request та вирішенням конфліктів.
  • Моніторинг (Grafana, Elastic Stack): базові навички роботи з дашбордами та логами.
  • Бази даних (MariaDB, Oracle, PostgreSQL): базові знання SQL та принципів роботи реляційних баз даних.
  • Bash: навички написання та редагування простих скриптів.
  • Особисті якості: аналітичне мислення, уважність, готовність навчатися, працювати в команді та дотримуватися технічних процедур.
  • Англійська: на рівні читання та розуміння технічної документації.

Плюсом стане

  • Linux: досвід системного моніторингу та діагностики продуктивності.
  • Docker: робота з Docker Compose та приватними реєстрами образів.
  • Kubernetes: досвід розгортання застосунків за допомогою Helm.
  • CI/CD: досвід створення пайплайнів із нуля.
  • Ansible: робота з ролями та AWX.
  • Terraform: розуміння IaC, досвід роботи з конфігураціями та базовими командами.
  • Хмарні платформи (Azure, AWS): базове знайомство з основними хмарними сервісами.
  • VMware: досвід роботи з VMware vSphere та адміністрування віртуальних машин.
  • Бази даних: досвід резервного копіювання, відновлення та базового налаштування.
  • Python: базові навички написання скриптів.
  • AI-агенти: досвід використання AI-асистентів для автоматизації інфраструктурних завдань, перевірки скриптів і конфігурацій, розуміння ризиків їх використання.

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Офіс чи ремоут — вирішувати тобі
  • Ремоут онбординг
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
  • Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека
  • Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників
  • Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог
  • Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв'язок Київстар

Overview

Job Title: ServiceNow Experience Designer & Portal DeveloperLocation: Remote - US or Canada

Job Type: Independent Contract Start Date: ASAP

Pay Rate: $70-80/hr

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled ServiceNow Experience Designer and Portal Developer to design, develop, and optimize responsive, user-friendly enterprise portals and Employee Center experiences. Design intuitive employee and agent experiences on the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on Employee Center and Service Operations Workspace (SOW). You will work closely with UX designers, business stakeholders, and system architects to translate business requirements into intuitive self-service web interfaces using ServiceNow’s Service Portal framework, AngularJS, JavaScript, and modern web standards.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end employee and agent journeys: onboarding/offboarding, issue-to-resolution, request-to-fulfillment, and self-service search and knowledge (deflection).
  • Create UX artifacts such as personas, journey maps, empathy maps, and wireframes/prototypes.
  • Plan and run usability tests, and turn findings into design improvements.
  • Design and configure experiences in Employee Center, SOW, and UI Builder.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to deliver consistent, accessible, user-centered solutions.
  • Employee Center / CSM Configuration: Implement and configure Employee Center Core/Pro features, Unified Navigation, and content-driven portals.
  • Service Catalog Integration: Build and modify Service Catalog items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variable Sets, and Catalog Client Scripts.
  • Performance & Optimization: Analyze and resolve portal performance bottlenecks using Chrome DevTools, network profiling, and clean widget architecture.
  • Security & Governance: Configure Access Control Lists (ACLs), Data Policies, and contextual security for portal components.
  • Deployment & Lifecycle: Manage Update Sets, Scoped Applications, source control integration, and platform upgrade support.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 6+ years in ServiceNow Development, including 2+ years on ServiceNow Portal and UI builder development.
  • Scripting & APIs: Develop server-side and client-side scripts using GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideForm (g_form), and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • ServiceNow Core: Strong command of the ServiceNow platform, Flow Designer, Business Rules, and Script Includes.
  • UI Builder & Experience Framework: Building and configuring modern portal pages, record pages, and appshells.
  • UIB Components & Layouts: Creating and customising Now Components using @servicenow/ui-core.
  • Declarative Actions & Client State Parameters: Wiring UI interactions without custom scripts where possible.
  • Data Resources & REST API Bindings: Connecting UI elements to back-end data sources within UIB.
  • Contextual Sidepanel & Split-View Layouts: Designing context-aware, multi-panel user experiences.
  • Portal & Widget Development: Design, build, and customize responsive Service Portal widgets, pages, themes, and navigation menus using AngularJS 1.x, JavaScript, HTML5, SCSS, and Bootstrap.
  • Portal Stack: Deep experience with ServiceNow Service Portal, Page Designer, widget scripting (Client Controller, Server Script, HTML template), and CSS/SCSS.
  • Web Technologies: Proficiency in JavaScript (ES5/ES6), AngularJS 1.x, HTML5, Bootstrap, and REST/JSON integrations.

Certifications:

  • Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Required
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS-Service Portal / CIS-CSM) - Required
  • Employee Center Essentials badge - Preferred
  • Service Operations Workspace (SOW) Bootcamp badge- Preferred
  • UI Builder Fundamentals badge/certification- Preferred

Head of Strategy & Transformation – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Strategy & Transformation is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing the organization's strategic initiatives and business transformation programmes. The role translates corporate strategy into actionable plans, drives operational improvements, and ensures that transformation projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the position focuses on strengthening business performance, improving operational efficiency, supporting digital innovation, enhancing customer experience, and ensuring alignment with regulatory and market developments.

The role works closely with senior leadership and departmental heads to ensure that strategic priorities are implemented effectively across the organization.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Support the development and implementation of corporate strategy and long-term business plans.
  • Translate organizational objectives into strategic initiatives, departmental priorities, and measurable action plans.
  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, industry benchmarking, and strategic assessments.
  • Identify opportunities for business growth, market expansion, product development, and operational improvement.
  • Coordinate annual strategic planning and business performance reviews.

B. Business Transformation & Programme Management

  • Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across business functions.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, and performance measures.
  • Identify opportunities to redesign business processes, operating models, and organizational structures.
  • Monitor transformation projects to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Resolve implementation challenges and escalate strategic risks to senior management.

C. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate existing business processes and identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Implement process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish performance management frameworks to improve productivity and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with business units to standardize workflows and strengthen operational controls.

D. Digital Transformation & Innovation

raw.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
Are you interested in joining our Engineering team at Nava but there are no open roles or roles that match your expertise? Drop your resume here for our team to review for future opportunities!

What to Expect Next:

Complete the Application

To proceed with your application, please ensure that you complete the application fully by clicking the "Apply For This Job" button below. This includes submitting your updated resume and any additional required information.

Application Review

Once your application is complete, our Talent Acquisition team will review it against role qualifications and requirements. We will evaluate your experience and fit based on our standard hiring criteria.

Interview Process

If your profile matches a current opportunity, you will be invited to participate in our interview process. This process includes an initial conversation with a Talent Acquisition Partner, followed by interviews with hiring managers and other team members.

Final Decision & Offer

After you complete the interviews, we will assess your fit for the position and make a final decision. If selected, you will receive an offer detailing compensation, benefits, and the next steps to joining the Nava team.

Onboarding

Once you accept our offer, we will guide you through our onboarding process to ensure a smooth transition into your new role at Nava.
We appreciate your interest in Nava and are committed to making this process as clear and seamless as possible. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition team.

Important Note:

Please note that this is not a job opening, and submitting your resume does not guarantee employment or an interview. We will review your information based on our standard hiring criteria, and if you are a potential fit for a current or future opportunity, we may contact you. We appreciate your interest and look forward to learning more about your experience!

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
  • If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
Please contact the recruiting team at if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer III
raw.excerpt: What You'll Do You’ll join the HS Code Classification team, which helps businesses that ship goods across borders get the right tariff code for every product, and cuts down the manual work our classification experts do today.
raw.description:
What You'll Do

You’ll join the HS Code Classification team, which helps businesses that ship goods across borders get the right tariff code for every product, and cuts down the manual work our classification experts do today. Here you’ll own models from first experiment to production, work on a hard real-world problem with thousands of codes and messy product data, and see the results used directly by customers.

  • Build intelligent systems that classify, extract, validate, and reason over complex business data and multiple languages
  • Improve automation quality through applied ML, GenAI, retrieval, and evaluation-driven development
  • Integrate model improvements into production workflows and user-facing experiences
  • Support fast, reliable ML services that can operate in real-time and high-volume environments
  • Improve data quality detection so downstream AI systems operate on inputs that are complete and actionable

You’ll work on text classification, data quality checks, model evaluation, small language models, RAG, and faster inference. You’ll also build AI agents that can reason through multi-step tasks, build MCP to connect them to tools and data they need. The role needs hands-on ML skills, strong engineering, and the ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and domain teams.

This role is remote.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Build and improve ML systems for product classification, document understanding, data quality checks, and retrieval
  • Fine-tune, test, and deploy models, including transformers and small language models
  • Build AI agents that reason through multi-step tasks and use MCP to connect to tools and data
  • Write backend services, APIs, and pipelines that bring models into production
  • Set up evaluations to track accuracy, speed, reliability, and where models fail
  • Add GenAI features such as chat, retrieval, and clear explanations of results to the product
  • Keep systems production-ready with testing, monitoring, and documentation
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to turn ambiguous needs into working solutions
  • Take part in design reviews, code reviews, and experiments to keep improving our systems
  • Main tools: Python, transformer models, LLMs, MCP, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, AWS, GitLab, Postgres, and Prometheus, Hex Dashboards , CI/CD deployments

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, including building and deploying ML or LLM-based systems in production.
  • Strong Python skills, plus experience building backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. Familiarity with other languages is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, such as prompt engineering, tool and function calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and working with models via APIs or Bedrock.
  • Practical experience with agentic development, including multi-step agents, orchestration patterns, and agent frameworks.
  • Delivered production-ready ML improvements for one or more AI-powered workflows.
  • Improved model quality, latency, reliability, or user experience for a production ML system
  • Built or enhanced evaluation pipelines that make model performance easier to measure and improve
  • Integrated ML capabilities into backend services, APIs, or user-facing workflows
  • Contributed to data quality or input validation capabilities that improve downstream model performance
  • Demonstrated strong ownership of well-scoped technical workstreams with guidance from senior engineers
  • Improved engineering quality through reliable implementation, testing, documentation, and production support.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-functioning environment in order to meet deadlines while managing multiple high priority tasks which require great attention to detail

raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated AI Engineering Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. You will join our Data Science team and play a key role in designing and building foundational A.I. systems at Sezzle.

What You'll Do:

  • Design A.I. systems from the ground up
  • Generate reliable and accurate training data for our A.I. systems
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, data analysts, and business end users to build effective systems
  • Write accurate and efficient SQL queries

What We Look For:

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Solid understanding of data analysis and database structures
  • Currently enrolled in a postsecondary institution studying MIS, Business
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Analytics/Data Analytics, Computer

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Interview Process:

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • SQL and Python Questions (30 minutes)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. raw.description:
Responsibilities

As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet.

S&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT-1/VT-2 or similar).

The ideal candidate brings experience with LR/SLR application and implementation and an optional combination of nuclear engineering programs, field trade experience (e.g., operations or maintenance), work management/scheduling, NRC submittals and/or inspections, and can bridge between technical aging management requirements, work management systems, and field execution.

Key Responsibilities

License renewal & aging management implementation

  • Support LR/SLR implementation activities such as procedure changes, preventive maintenance (PM) basis and frequency development, work order (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates.
  • Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs.
  • Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements.

Work Management & Coordination Responsibilities

  • Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR opportunities in both online and outage scopes.
  • Screen and analyze large WO and PM lists (often thousands of line items) to identify high-value inspection opportunities based on system, component, material, and environment.
  • Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans.

Engineering basis, documentation & configuration control

  • Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications.
  • Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR-related documents and commitments.
  • Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation.

Stakeholder engagement & SME coordination

  • Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results.
  • Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and documentation expectations.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, technology-forward thinking, and cross-functional collaboration across engineering, planning, and implementation teams.

Regulatory awareness & operating experience

  • Maintain awareness of changes in LR/SLR and aging management regulations, guidance, and industry operating experience.
  • Incorporate relevant NUREGs, NEI guidance, and industry OE into program basis documents, implementation strategies, and inspection plans.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills

  • An associate’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10 or more years of experience in the design and analysis of nuclear, industrial, or DOE facilities.
  • Proven experience managing and/or participating in multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Experience in managing medium-to-large critical projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in providing guidance, mentoring, and training to staff engineers
  • Licensed Operator for a Utility
  • Experience delivering accurate, high-quality technical documentation in a highly regulated environment (nuclear, DOE, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear QA/QC protocols, and configuration management processes.
  • Strong systems thinking skills, with the ability to balance innovation with compliance, safety, and traceability.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with work management systems (e.g., work orders, PMs, planning tools) and to align technical requirements with implementable work packages and schedules.
  • Proven capability to collaborate with SMEs and field organizations, using drawings, histories, prior WOs, and data to converge on practical implementation solutions.

Preferred Experience

License renewal, SLR, and aging management

  • Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs, including development or implementation of AMPs, one-time inspections, or selective leaching programs.
  • Experience with NRC, INPO, or DOE regulations, and participation in NRC audits or inspections (e.g., Inspection Procedure 71003 or similar).
  • Familiarity with key nuclear industry LR/SLR documents such as NUREG‑1800, NUREG‑1801, NEI 95‑10, NUREG‑2191, NUREG‑2192, NUREG‑2221, NEI 17‑01, and/or NUREG‑1555.
  • Participation and/or familiarity with the Nuclear Energy Institute (NEI) License Renewal Task Force or similar industry working groups.

Background experience

  • Strong practical understanding of mechanical systems and components (pumps, valves, strainers, tanks, heat exchangers, piping) and how work is actually performed on them in the field.
  • Ability to connect materials and environments to aging mechanisms (e.g., loss of material, pitting, erosion, selective leaching, coating degradation) and to define what inspections need to observe and document.
  • Background in one or more of the following: mechanical maintenance/engineering, system engineering, NDE/inspection, chemistry/corrosion engineering, or field construction/trades (e.g., piping, welding, valve maintenance) that provides credibility with craft and insight into how design, procedures, and work orders translate into physical work.
  • Several years in a nuclear work management / outage or online planning, system engineering, or maintenance engineering role, preferably with exposure to LR/SLR implementation or aging management programs.
  • Prior hands-on or close-support experience with plant modification or maintenance on mechanical systems (e.g., as a maintenance engineer, system engineer, field engineer, NDE/inspection engineer, or craft/trades lead) in a nuclear or similarly regulated environment.
  • Experience working in cross-functional project teams (engineering, programs, planning, field, and external consultants) to deliver complex, multi-outage implementation scopes.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Health & WellnessFinancial BenefitsWork-Life Balance
  • Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • Disability Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Back-Up Daycare
  • FSA & HSA
  • 401(k)
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Account

  • Corporate Charitable Giving Program

  • Paid Vacation
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Paid Bereavement Leave
  • Flexible Work Arrangements

Compensation Range

$118,023 - $180,313

Transparency Statement

Sargent & Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus.

About This Business Unit

Join Sargent & Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon-free energy. Since 1954, we’ve been a trusted leader in nuclear engineering, design, and licensing, with expertise spanning small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactor technology (ART), and first-of-a-kind commercial reactor restart projects. Our work supports life extensions and digital modernization of existing nuclear plants, coal-to-nuclear conversion initiatives with the Department of State, and international nuclear new-build projects. With a commitment to safety, innovation, and sustainability, we provide cutting-edge solutions that power communities worldwide while reducing emissions. Shape the future of global energy with us!

Equal Opportunity

Sargent & Lundy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any protected status as defined by applicable law.

raw.description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details

Salary: £55,000 to £75,000

Location: Fully remote

Security: BPSS

About the role

The Strategic Workforce Planning Lead makes sure our projects have the right people at the right time. Day-to-day, that means working with Delivery and Service Managers to quickly fill project gaps, often with contract resources. Over the longer term, it means shaping how far ahead of confirmed demand we recruit permanent staff, to support growth and reduce delivery risk.

They will own fee-earning resourcing across TwinStream, from the demand forecast and resourcing plan through to the hiring requests that come from it. They will maintain a company-wide view of current and forecast demand, bringing together committed, likely and potential future work and translating it into clear resource requirements.

Working across Delivery, Commercial, People and Finance, they will give the Board the evidence it needs for decisions on permanent hiring, and coordinate recruitment and resource allocation across the company.

They will make the resourcing recommendations, with permanent headcount approved by the Board and contract hires by the Chief Operating Officer, while Delivery and Service Managers continue to lead their teams.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, own and maintain the company's 18-month resource planning model, shaping its structure and approach from their own experience, capturing committed, likely and potential demand from internal planning systems, Delivery Managers, Service Managers and Business Development, and keeping it accurate and refreshed on a regular cycle.
  • Work with Delivery and Service Managers to translate demand into requirements for roles, skills, experience, clearance, location and timing.
  • Compare demand with existing staff, recruitment pipelines and contractors to identify gaps.
  • Turn project-level shortfalls into contract requirements so gaps are filled quickly.
  • Produce prioritised, fully specified hiring requests for permanent and contract roles for the People team, and track the recruitment pipeline against required start dates.
  • Agree resource allocations with Delivery and Service Managers, so people are in place when projects need them.
  • Track utilisation, flag early where people are coming off assignments with nothing confirmed, and work with Delivery and Service Managers to line up their next assignment.
  • Prepare and scenario-test resource options, identifying risks and recommendations for Board review.
  • Identify where long-running contractor demand could be met by permanent staff.
  • Support Delivery and Service Managers in rotating permanent staff into more complex work, with contractors backfilling where appropriate.
  • Maintain concise reporting covering demand, capacity, vacancies, recruitment, contractors and people moving between assignments.

Key Skills

We are looking for someone with:

  • Strong analytical and organisational skills.
  • The resilience and confidence to work with senior stakeholders: to challenge, to broker agreement between competing demands from Delivery and Service Managers, and to escalate when needed.
  • A practical, can-do and facilitative approach, focused on finding workable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex information simply.
  • Good commercial awareness of the trade-offs between permanent staff and contractors, and between recruiting ahead of demand and recruiting against confirmed work.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, with experience maintaining planning or forecasting models that draw on several data sources.
  • Confidence in using AI tools to analyse and manage information, or willingness to learn them.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience in technology, consultancy, government or security-cleared environments.
  • Experience in resource, workforce, portfolio or capacity planning.
  • Experience of working with uncertain demand and turning it into practical plans.
  • Experience of working with recruitment or People teams.

What success looks like

Project gaps are filled quickly with the right people, permanent or contract. TwinStream has a reliable forward view of demand, makes deliberate decisions about how far ahead of demand to recruit, and starts recruitment early enough to support growth, with clear visibility of contractor reliance and of people moving between assignments.

There are many great reasons to join our team!

Pension Plan

Secure your future with our competitive pension plan that offers an 8% employer contribution.

Private Medical Healthcare

Your health and well-being are our top priorities. Enjoy comprehensive private medical healthcare, which includes dental and optical care for you and your family.

Learning and Development

Your career is in your hands. We empower you to take charge of your own development, giving you the autonomy to shape your growth.

Flexible Working

We understand the importance of balancing work and life. Flexibility is not just a policy for us; it is part of our culture. We are passionate about helping you seamlessly integrate work with your home life.

Electric Vehicle Scheme

Drive sustainability forward with our electric vehicle leasing scheme. You can take advantage of this initiative through a convenient salary sacrifice program.

Holidays

Enjoy annual leave of 28 days, plus bank holidays, allowing you to recharge and spend time on what matters most.

Team Events

We love celebrating our achievements! In addition to our quarterly meetings, you can look forward to our Christmas and summer parties—opportunities to relax, reflect, and have fun as a team.

Additional Benefits

We provide life assurance for your peace of mind and a cycle-to-work scheme to support your health and sustainability goals.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.
