raw.title: Internal Auditor - E4
raw.excerpt: Standard Job Description Join Lockheed Martin's Internal Audit (LMIA) team as a Finance & Compliance Auditor and play a key role in evaluating and improving the company's processes, controls, and compliance.
raw.description:
Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin's Internal Audit (LMIA) team as a Finance & Compliance Auditor and play a key role in evaluating and improving the company's processes, controls, and compliance. As a member of the finance and compliance focus group, you will have the opportunity to work with senior leadership, build relationships with key stakeholders, and contribute to the success of the company’s business and strategic objectives.

Responsibilities include:

• Conduct financial and compliance audits across Lockheed Martin, identifying and analyzing business risks, exposures, and key performance indicators

• Evaluate business practices and processes, including acquisitions and joint ventures, to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures

• Collaborate with executives to identify and address controls and reporting risks and opportunities for improvement

• Develop and present audit findings and recommendations to senior leadership

• Provide guidance and expertise in areas including:

• Auditing and accounting principles

• Balance sheet/income statement analysis

• Overhead rate and budget analysis

• Financial planning and cost estimating

• Regulatory and Compliance topics

• International Trade Controls

What’s in it for you:

• Opportunity to work with multiple business units and functions across the corporation

• Exposure to diverse processes and operations around the world

• Professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and expertise

• Competitive salary adjusted to reflect the geographic location of the selected employee

• Virtual work arrangement with no relocation required

Work Arrangement:

•This position is virtual to corporate headquarters, but requires the selected employee to be located at or near a U.S.-based Lockheed Martin business unit work location

•This position is virtual to Corporate headquarters and requires up to 30% travel

• Relocation is not required as individuals travel to the audit assignments

•Salary for this position will be adjusted to reflect the salary band for the geographic location of the selected employee

• Learn more about LMIA at

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in finance, accounting, or a related discipline

• Previous internal and/or external auditing experience.

• Ability to travel up to approximately 30%.

• Business Processes and Controls: Knowledge and experience with business operations (i.e., revenue, expenditures, payroll, treasury, budgeting, overhead & rate structures and cost allowability) with their typical functions, common accounting entries, relationship with financial reporting and controls.

• Corporate Governance: Knowledge and experience around the system of rules and practices the corporation has in place and operates under to provide assurance of the corporation’s oversight of management in the critical areas of corporate strategy, risk oversight, leadership development, evaluation, and succession planning, and performance against financial and nonfinancial objectives.

• Oral Communication: Conveys thoughts and expresses ideas effectively using speech in individual or group situations; tailors communication according to the level and style of the audience or listener; speaks confidently; actively listens to inform an appropriate response.

• Written Communication: Expresses ideas, thoughts, concepts, and problems clearly and succinctly in writing. Uses correct and appropriate grammar, word choice, and sentence structure.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving Skills: Effective analytical and problem solving skills and abilities for understanding business processes/procedures and their impact on overall company operations.

• Team Oriented: Demonstrates effective team orientation and able to work in virtual environment.

• Strategic Thinking: Applies intentional and rational thought process that focuses on the analysis of critical factors and variables that will influence the long-term success of a business, a team, or an individual.

• Root Cause Analysis: Analyzes the underlying reasons of issues identified in an audit. Determine cause- and-effect relationships (if...then...) of issues and can associate the causes with the business processes, procedures or behaviors that have generated and permitted the issues.

Desired Skills

• Master’s degree from an accredited college in finance, accounting, MBA, or a related discipline

• Domain certifications: CPA, CIA, CFE, CRMA, MBA.

• Preferred candidate would have experience in two or more of the following seven financial and compliance areas:

(1) Government Finance/DFARS Business Systems: Knowledge of government finance including CAS, FAR, DFARS, GAGAS, incurred cost claims, and contract and indirect rate closure processes. Understands concepts of allowability and allocability of cost to government contracts.

(2) International Accounting and Operations/IFRS: Knowledge of foreign financial reporting requirements and difference in US GAAP, currency exchange rates, financial reporting verification, taxes, transfer pricing, and currency / contract hedging.

(3) Merger/Acquisitions and Divestiture: Knowledge of business integration and disengagement activities, assumptions and expectations for due diligence, accounting for business combinations, joint ventures and equity method investments.

(4) SEC and FASB Reporting and Disclosures: Understanding of all reported financial statements and footnote disclosure requirements. Able to analyze and interpret data from financial statements.

(5) Budget and Planning: Knowledge and experience in planning, managing, and reporting cost, expenses; knowledgeable in spending, forecasting, and resource planning in order to achieve target budgets.

6) International Trade Controls: Internationals Trade Controls: Knowledge and experience with laws and regulations related to International Trace Controls (ITC) and Lockheed Martin’s policies and procedures. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage an effective ITC program.

(7) Anti-Corruption/Anti-Bribery: Knowledge and experience in laws and regulations related to the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) Anti Bribery and Anti - Corruption. The ability to develop, implement, manage and test an effective FCPA/Anti-Corruption program.

• Business Acumen: Appropriately applies knowledge and risks of the business and industry in work and decision-making through conceptualizing, applying, analyzing, and/or evaluating information gathered in order to execute a set of objectives or solve a business challenge or develop recommendations.

• Influence and Negotiation: Understands key influencers and decision-makers; develops and presents persuasive arguments and effective solutions to address concerns and/or resolve any conflicts (including workplace and clients) in a professional and fair manner; negotiates resistance and develops consensus without damaging relationships. Keeps the enterprise's best interest in consideration.

• Professional Judgement: Detects business problems, makes decisions, and forms opinions that take into consideration available facts, constraints, and anticipated consequences in allocating time, budget and resourcing.

• Identifying Need for Data and Analytics: Ability to identify specific and relevant business cases where data and analytics should be applied to inform audit work and audit activities (e.g., risk assessment, engagement planning, fieldwork, ongoing monitoring, non-engagement projects).

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $111400.00 - $206800.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $100200.00 - $186200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $89100.00 - $165500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $80200.00 - $149000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

The role requires deep expertise in Java and its ecosystem, as well as hands-on experience migrating Java applications to cloud environments. You will also help ensure compliance with development best practices, coding standards and security requirements.

What will you do?

  • Design, develop and maintain web applications, REST APIs, microservices and all SOA layers as a full stack developer;
  • Analyse legacy applications and support their migration to cloud environments;
  • Implement code using Vue JS, Java, JSF, Spring Boot, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes and Cloud technologies;
  • Maintain and troubleshoot the implemented code;
  • Deliver according to internal rules and best practices, including testing, CI/CD and application integration;

What are we looking for?

  • Technical Expert profile with between 8 and 15 years of experience in the environment of the service;
  • Experience in full stack development of web applications, REST APIs, microservices and SOA layers;
  • Experience in migrating Java applications to cloud environments;
  • Functional knowledge of the banking and/or financial areas;
  • Experience with Java frameworks (Hibernate, JUnit, Spring) and data structures;
  • Experience with SOA programming, SOAP web services, microservices and RESTful APIs;
  • Experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud;
  • Experience with web application development (JSF, PrimeFaces, Vue JS);
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud environments;
  • Experience with development tools such as JBoss EAP, JBoss, Maven, Jenkins, Nexus, GitLab and SonarQube;
  • Experience in analysing legacy applications;
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills;
  • Ability to share knowledge, influence others and inspire commitment within the team;
  • Experience working with Agile practices;
  • Fluent in Portuguese;
  • Good command of English.

What can you expect from us?

  • A permanent job contract for a long term project;
  • Tech equipment + SIM Card + personal smartphone;
  • Health and Life Insurance;
  • Social events and team buildings;
  • The commitment of letting you grow with us, and be rewarded accordingly;
  • A dynamic and young team that will be always there to support you;
  • Training in the latest technologies;
  • Coffee, fruits, snacks and a warm welcoming when you pass by the office.

Before reading the job post, we encourage you to watch this video about our company. It gives you an inside look at how we started, the team and culture that made us successful, and where we're going. It's easy to read a job post and apply, but people often wonder about the culture and whether they would fit in. If you want to call Harrow your home and genuinely want to be part of a family and something big, then we encourage you to click this link and get to know us.

Who is Harrow?

Harrow (Nasdaq: HROW) is a leading provider of ophthalmic disease management solutions in North America. Harrow is an incredible entrepreneurial company – where we celebrate the ability of every member of the Harrow Family to be the CEO of their job. Harrow’s values have driven interest over the past decade in attracting high-performing professionals in a variety of disciplines. Members of our Harrow Family often express their pride in being a part of our commitment to (1) innovation, (2) patient access to affordable medicines, and (3) our track record of having never turned down an ophthalmologist doing mission work around the world – providing free medicines in support of mission work aimed at giving or maintaining the gift of sight to those most in need. We encourage you to learn more about Harrow and its unique culture to see if you’re the right person to help contribute as we build a truly exceptional company, one we are all so proud of!

Harrow’s ophthalmic pharmaceutical portfolio is one of the most comprehensive in the industry, including:

  • An expandingRetina Portfolio including IHEEZO®, TRIESENCE®, BYOOVIZTM, and OPUVIZTM
  • Abroad Dry Eye Disease product line, led by VEVYE® and bolstered by well-known adjacent ocular surface disease products such as FLAREX® and FRESHKOTE®
  • A peri-operative Surgical product line, led by TRIESENCE®, and BYQLOVITM
  • A Rare and Specialty product line, which includes various high-need and utility products such as ILEVRO®, NATACYN®, and VERKAZIA®
  • A robust internal development pipeline with multiple late-stage candidates, including MELT-300, MELT-210, H-N08, and CR-01

Sr. Graphic Designer

Harrow | Reports to: Head, Marketing

Position Summary

Produces creative from one shared queue for all three franchises, corporate branding, and the marketing platforms, giving every brand the design capacity it needs to stay in market on schedule.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design field materials, digital assets, emails, social content, and congress and booth materials.
  • Adapt approved campaigns across formats while keeping Harrow brand standards.
  • Turn clinical data into clear visuals for HCPs and patients.
  • Manage submission of promotional assets in Veeva PromoMats and shepherd them through MLR/PRC review.
  • Make PRC revisions accurately and on time; prepare print- and production-ready files.
  • Maintain templates and the creative asset library.
  • Write creative briefs from brand direction and manage timing in project management tools.

  • Secure print estimates and guide print vendors on stock, proofs, and setup in the field ordering system.
  • Resize and adapt paid media assets, deliver final files to the media buying agency, and QA live placements.
  • Build, code, and test email campaigns in the Harrow martech stack.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and brand ambassador for Harrow’s visual identity and brand standards, internally and with agencies.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Degree in graphic design or visual communication, or equivalent portfolio.
  • 3–5 years of design experience, preferably in pharma, healthcare, or another regulated industry; prior agency experience a plus.
  • Expert in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop; strong typography and layout.
  • Portfolio experience required.
  • Experience creating HCP and DTC materials for FDA-approved products.
  • Proficiency with AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude, and with Slack.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with PRC/MLR review cycles, including Veeva PromoMats or similar systems and workflows.
  • Figma, motion graphics, and PowerPoint design.
  • Adobe XD, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.

raw.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:
As a Senior Product Designer in Airalo’s User Experience division, you will shape consumer product experiences across native mobile and web for millions of people around the world. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on leading design from problem framing through delivery, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the Airalo Product Design Guild - our community for craft, critique, design systems, research-led decision-making, accessibility, experimentation, AI, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead end-to-end product design for Airalo’s consumer mobile and web experiences, from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, Growth, and other designers to translate customer needs, insights, and strategy into high-quality product improvements.
  • Create user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, UX copy, and production-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and stakeholder conversations that create alignment and momentum.
  • Contribute to Airalo’s Design System, improving consistency, accessibility, quality, and efficiency across products.
  • Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, critique, and shared practice.
  • Help strengthen the Product Design Guild by raising the bar for craft, collaboration, research-led decision-making, and thoughtful use of AI.

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years or similar of dedicated experience in product design at a tech startup, scale-up, product-led company, or product-focused agency.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality UI, thoughtful interaction design, strong product thinking, and measurable impact.
  • Extensive experience designing, testing, and shipping native mobile and web applications for B2C products.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous design problems from discovery through delivery, balancing user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and product strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Figma and FigJam skills, with experience creating flows, prototypes, product specifications, and production-ready design assets.
  • Advanced experience working with design systems, native mobile guidelines, responsive design, accessibility, and product quality across mobile and web.
  • Advanced experience with motion, prototyping, or interaction details that bring product experiences to life.
  • Experience working in Lean and/or Agile product development environments, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Data, and Growth.
  • Able to facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Experience using AI and emerging tools to improve the design workflow beyond simple prototyping.

Good to have:

  • Experience in telecommunications, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or global consumer products.
  • Knowledge of eSIMs, GSMA-related technologies, or mobile connectivity services.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Research, Data, Growth, or Content Design teams.

You should apply if…

  • You lead through craft, clarity, and systems thinking. You can turn complex problems into simple, well-crafted experiences while considering journeys, patterns, accessibility, content, edge cases, and scale.
  • You can own ambiguous problems. You do not need every answer before you start. You ask good questions, define the path forward, make smart trade-offs, and keep momentum without waiting to be told what to do.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You use research, data, customer feedback, and product strategy to make decisions that improve the user experience and support business goals.
  • You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.
  • You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.
  • You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

This isn't for you if…

  • You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.
  • You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.
  • You avoid feedback or critique. Our design culture depends on sharing unfinished work, challenging ideas respectfully, and changing direction when the evidence points elsewhere.
  • You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.
  • You are not interested in customers or the community. Speaking to customers, learning from them, and contributing to the Product Design Guild are central to how we build better products.
If you are interested in this position, please apply to the ad.

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here:
We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

raw.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Location

Remote, but onsite as needed at D.C. office

Position summary

The IT Support Associate plays an integral role in maintaining the essential information technology infrastructure of Nava. The incumbent will be responsible for planning, managing and directing the technical onboarding of new hires and offboarding of departing employees, as well as making determinations to support existing employees' software license management, hardware issues, and audio-visual needs. Lastly, they will be responsible for large-scale asset and device management, in addition to collaborating with the IT Manager in emergency response incidents like lost hardware or account breaches.
All work will be done in support of Nava’s values: Be Active Stewards, Pursue the Root Cause, Think Long-Term, Build Together, Inclusion is Essential and Progress Takes Work.

What you'll do

IT End User Full Lifecycle Management

  • Responsible for planning, managing, and directing all aspects of equipment and software onboarding of new hires at all levels (e.g., account creation, hardware delivery, information security training, etc)
  • Independently evaluates employee capabilities and needs with respect to training, researches, and provides direct training and support to employees who are unfamiliar with our core tools, core infrastructure, and hardware
  • Manages all aspects of technical offboarding (e.g., account deletion, suspension, data transfer, release or return of Nava equipment) for departing employees
  • Researches and recommends technical and non-technical solutions for IT challenges
  • Interfaces directly with external vendors on an as-needed basis to evaluate and support the purchase of tools or licenses for tools
  • Acts as the designated backup to the IT Director on necessary tasks (e.g., vendor management, strategic planning and discussion, etc) when the IT Director is unavailable
  • Manage sensitive matters with a high level of confidentiality and discretion especially decisions directly impacting the global operations of the company
  • Evaluates and makes determinations in order to grant software licenses to new and existing employees
  • Maintains existing licenses and coordinates with Finance to procure and process invoices for software licenses
  • Evaluates and recommends actions for end user problems with hardware and software licenses

Device and Asset Management

  • Procures new computers and other hardware for new employees, as well as longer-term employees whose hardware has issues
  • Researches and recommends actions to address end user issues with hardware as they arise
  • Ensures an appropriate inventory of computers, A/V equipment, and other devices that belong to Nava
  • Coordinates with vendors to assist with malfunctioning devices
  • Takes necessary action to wipe and assess returned devices when returned by users

A/V Support

  • Provides onsite A/V support for Nava events

raw.title: Senior Consultant
raw.excerpt: What You'll Do Role Summary Avalara's implementation practice is the front line of customer value.
raw.description:
What You'll Do

Role Summary

Avalara's implementation practice is the front line of customer value. As our customer base grows in complexity and strategic importance, the demand for senior implementation expertise -- consultants who can own the most demanding engagements, guide enterprise customers through sophisticated configurations, and raise the capability of the team around them -- has never been higher.

The Senior Consultant brings deep tax automation expertise and the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy across Avalara's most complex ERP, POS, and eCommerce implementations. This role drives customer success outcomes, serves as a key escalation resource within the team, and contributes to the methodology and practices that make the broader implementation function stronger. Reporting to the Implementation Manager, this is a high-ownership role for a practitioner who takes pride in the quality and consistency of their work.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This role will:

  • Deliver consistently excellent outcomes for Avalara's most complex and high-priority customer implementations, raising the quality benchmark for the practice.

  • Strengthen team capability by coaching and mentoring junior specialists on advanced configurations, implementation methodology, and customer engagement best practices.

  • Reduce delivery risk by proactively identifying implementation risks, resolving escalated issues, and applying structured solutioning to complex customer scenarios.

  • Improve the broader practice by contributing to onboarding materials, training curricula, and standard operating procedures in partnership with the Implementation Manager and Learning and Development teams.

  • Advance Avalara's product quality by surfacing recurring implementation challenges and influencing product improvements through collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.

  • Support Avalara's AI-first strategy by leveraging AI tools to improve implementation efficiency, documentation quality, and customer time-to-value.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Responsibilities

    The successful candidate will:

    • Architect and deliver end-to-end implementations across the full suite of supported ERP and platform integrations, including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce Stripe Invoicing, NetSuite, and QuickBooks, encompassing technical discovery, advanced configuration, and customization guidance.

    • Own a portfolio of high-priority, high-complexity, or strategic customers, ensuring exceptional delivery quality and customer satisfaction.

    • Lead discovery sessions with enterprise customers to assess tax workflows, recommend optimal configurations, and develop tailored implementation plans aligned to nexus and compliance requirements.

    • Manage technical and tax aspects of customer implementations end-to-end, including task management, solutioning, risk identification and mitigation, and customer communication.

    • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex implementation and support scenarios, guiding junior specialists through advanced configurations and methodology application.

    • Partner with the Implementation Manager and Learning and Development teams to contribute to onboarding materials, training curricula, and standard operating procedures that strengthen the broader implementation practice.

    • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to surface recurring implementation challenges and drive product improvements that improve delivery consistency.

    • Apply AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, documentation, and implementation planning.

    12-Month Success Signals

    Within the first 12 months, this consultant will:

    • Successfully deliver a portfolio of high-priority and high-complexity customer implementations at or above established quality and satisfaction benchmarks.

    • Contribute at least one improvement to team onboarding materials, training curricula, or SOPs that is adopted by the broader implementation practice.

    • Demonstrate consistent, effective escalation handling with measurable reduction in unresolved issues within their portfolio.

    • Coach and develop at least one junior specialist, with observable improvement in their methodology application and configuration quality.

    • Surface at least one product or process improvement through cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, or Customer Success.

    • Demonstrate applied use of AI tools that improves speed, documentation quality, or delivery consistency in their implementation engagements.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline and 8+ years of experience in software implementation within the B2B sector, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-platform deployments.

  • Deep expertise in tax automation: proven ability to independently lead implementations of tax engines, returns, and exemption certificate systems for Avalara, TaxJar, Vertex, Sovos, Sabrix, or similar platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of US sales and use tax compliance, nexus rules, and multi-jurisdictional requirements.

  • Proven expertise across ERP and platform integrations including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, NetSuite, and QuickBooks.

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills; demonstrated ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders on both customer and internal sides.

  • Demonstrated mentorship and informal leadership capabilities; experience coaching junior team members on implementation methodology and ERP configurations.

  • Strategic thinker who translates customer pain points into scalable, repeatable implementation solutions.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve implementation speed, documentation quality, or delivery consistency.

AI Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, Senior Consultants are expected to be AI Bar Raisers, practitioners who improve how AI is applied to implementation work and who help elevate the AI capability of the team around them.

The successful candidate will:

  • Leverage approved AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, documentation, solution design, and implementation planning.

  • Identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort, improve configuration consistency, and improve customer time-to-value.

  • Apply AI responsibly and securely, ensuring AI-enabled approaches align with customer requirements and Avalara's governance standards.

  • Demonstrate measurable improvements in implementation quality, speed, or consistency through applied AI -- not occasional use.

  • Share AI approaches, reusable prompts, and implementation patterns that improve AI capability across the implementation team.

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, we hire Bar Raisers, practitioners who strengthen teams through high standards, deep expertise, and a consistent commitment to improving the people and systems around them. As a Senior Consultant, this role is expected to elevate the quality of customer implementations, strengthen junior team members, and leave the practice better than they found it.

The successful candidate will:

  • Hold themselves to high standards of delivery quality, technical accuracy, and customer engagement at every stage of implementation.

  • Coach and develop junior specialists, sharing expertise in methodology, ERP configuration, and customer communication in ways that raise team-wide capability.

  • Proactively identify risks, escalate with context, and resolve complex issues in ways that build repeatable solutions for the broader team.

  • Bring structured thinking to complex customer scenarios, translating requirements into implementation approaches that are scalable, not just case-specific.

  • Contribute to a higher-performing team by sharing knowledge, improving documentation, and raising the standard of what good implementation looks like.

  • Leave every customer engagement, team interaction, and piece of documentation stronger than they found it.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

**This position is based in Germany, UK or Bulgaria with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Marketing Programmes defines and coordinates Chaos’s global digital marketing campaigns across new customer acquisition, account-based marketing and customer marketing. The role decides which campaigns run, which channels and offers are used, and how each campaign supports the customer journey. Campaign execution sits with the Performance Marketing team, and this role ensures every campaign is planned, briefed and delivered accurately and on time across all contributing teams.

The role is highly cross-functional and relies heavily on project management. Working closely with Performance Marketing, Content, Web, Revenue Operations, Sales and Customer Success, the Team Lead manages a large number of dependencies and stakeholders, and is trusted to deliver high-profile campaigns such as Black Friday accurately from start to finish. This role requires a highly organised and resilient marketer with strong attention to detail and a clear understanding of how campaigns drive commercial outcomes.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define the campaign plan across new customer acquisition, ABM and customer marketing, including which campaigns run, which channels are used, which offers and discounts apply, and when.

  • Project-manage campaigns from brief through to launch, setting timelines, assigning owners and tracking dependencies across Performance Marketing, Content, Web, Revenue Operations, Sales and Customer Success.

  • Produce clear campaign briefs that give every contributing team a shared understanding of objectives, deliverables and deadlines.

  • Partner with the Performance Marketing team to understand channel and campaign performance, using insights to inform future campaign priorities and investment.

  • Align campaigns to the customer journey, ensuring prospects and existing customers receive relevant messaging and offers at each stage.

  • Keep stakeholders informed of progress, identify risks early and resolve competing priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain the processes, calendars and frameworks that enable consistent, reliable campaign delivery at scale.

  • Lead and develop a small team of campaign managers, setting clear expectations and supporting their growth.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on campaign planning and coordination.

  • Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-team digital campaigns, such as seasonal promotions or product launches, accurately and on time.

  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple dependencies and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Good understanding of digital marketing channels and how to interpret their performance; specialist technical knowledge is not required.

  • Clear understanding of the customer journey and how campaigns move prospects and customers through it.

  • High attention to detail, with the ability to spot errors and gaps before they reach the customer.

  • Resilient and composed under pressure, able to adapt when timelines shift or dependencies change.

  • Builds strong working relationships across teams and communicates with credibility at all levels, including senior leadership.

  • Commercially minded, able to translate campaign and channel results into clear decisions.

  • Experience managing or mentoring others.

  • Background in a VC- or PE-backed company is an advantage.

  • Fluent English required, German is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Granicus State Sales Team is a dynamic, results-driven group charged with driving new revenue in a young and energized Cloud Vertical. Ours is a Team that values individual initiative as well as teamwork. What we do makes a difference. Our products and services improve the efficiency of government and the quality of people’s lives. The Enterprise Account Executive generates subscription sales for our SaaS platform and related services in an assigned territory. State Government includes all government functions, including state agencies, and programs under the Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches of government.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

    • Generate a consistent pipeline of net new opportunities through strategic prospecting, territory planning, referrals, events, and executive outreach.
    • Build relationships with senior government leaders and uncover strategic initiatives that align to Granicus solutions.
    • Leverage account research and stakeholder mapping to create opportunities where no active project or budget exists.

    Value Selling & Discovery

    • Lead outcome-based discovery conversations that uncover business challenges, citizen impact goals, operational inefficiencies, and executive priorities.
    • Quantify business value and build compelling business cases that align Granicus solutions to measurable customer outcomes.
    • Connect customer objectives to broader digital transformation, constituent engagement, service delivery, and operational modernization initiatives.

    MEDDPICC & Deal Qualification

    • Drive disciplined opportunity qualification through MEDDPICC principles, maintaining clear understanding of metrics, economic buyers, decision criteria, decision processes, and competitive positioning.
    • Develop and execute account-specific win strategies for complex opportunities with multiple stakeholders and lengthy procurement cycles.
    • Identify and mitigate deal risks early while establishing clear mutual action plans with customers.

    Territory Ownership

    • Own territory planning, account prioritization, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and revenue attainment.
    • Build multi-year growth strategies within assigned accounts while expanding Granicus' footprint across agencies and departments.

    Executive Selling

    • Facilitate executive-level conversations that advance customer buying decisions rather than product evaluations.
    • Engage agency leaders, IT executives, communications teams, program owners, and procurement stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • Prospecting & Hunting

    • You enjoy creating opportunities from scratch and are energized by prospecting, networking, and opening new doors.
    • You have a proven track record of consistently generating your own pipeline, not solely relying on inbound leads.
    • You are comfortable engaging senior executives and initiating strategic business conversations with little prior relationship.

    Solution Selling

    • You excel at uncovering customer challenges, identifying root causes, and aligning solutions to desired business outcomes.
    • You ask thoughtful discovery questions and prefer understanding customer problems before discussing products.
    • You can translate technical capabilities into meaningful business value for executive stakeholders.

    MEDDPICC / Complex Sales

    • You have experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with executive, technical, operational, legal, and procurement participants.
    • You utilize structured qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger, Value Selling, or similar frameworks.
    • You build mutual action plans and proactively manage risks throughout the buying journey.

    Public Sector / Government Specific

    • You understand how government organizations evaluate, purchase, and implement technology solutions.
    • You can navigate committee-driven decisions and balance the priorities of diverse stakeholder groups.
    • You are patient, persistent, and skilled at moving opportunities forward through complex procurement processes.

    Growth Mindset

    • You actively seek coaching and continuously refine your sales skills.
    • You thrive in an accountable, high-performance culture where pipeline creation, forecast accuracy, and customer outcomes matter.
    • You are highly organized and demonstrate strong operating discipline in CRM management and opportunity planning.

Pay Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $150,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.
  • Company-Wide Wellbeing Days – Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health.
  • Work From Home Reimbursement – Support a productive home office environment.
Health & Wellness
  • Multiple Health Plan Options – Including a 100% employer-paid plan.
  • Employer HSA Contributions – When enrolled in a High-Deductible Health Plan.
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program – Stay active, your way.
  • On-Demand Mental Health Support – Access to Headspace and other wellness tools.
Family & Future
  • Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
  • Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
  • Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated AI Engineering Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. You will join our Data Science team and play a key role in designing and building foundational A.I. systems at Sezzle.

What You'll Do:

  • Design A.I. systems from the ground up
  • Generate reliable and accurate training data for our A.I. systems
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, data analysts, and business end users to build effective systems
  • Write accurate and efficient SQL queries

What We Look For:

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Solid understanding of data analysis and database structures
  • Currently enrolled in a postsecondary institution studying MIS, Business
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Analytics/Data Analytics, Computer

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Interview Process:

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • SQL and Python Questions (30 minutes)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the A.I. Engineering Intern is $1,000 USD monthly gross.

Overview

Position Summary:

This individual contributor position is responsible for supporting analytical projects on identifying business opportunities, answering business questions and developing business solutions. The team member will need to be able to understand business needs and create research and implementation plans using data, statistical models and machine learning techniques. The team member needs to have strong data and programming skills and be able to work closely with cross-functional teams of software engineers, data analysts and product leaders on business initiatives.

$101,167 to $204,439 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

Responsibilities

  • Create procedures to streamline analysis procedures.

Through this communication, the employee will be expected to increase the breadth of his/her understanding of the processes associated with these functions, and of the various KPI’s that drive business results in each area and overall.
  • Creates presentations breaking down problems identified, potential solutions.

Preferred:

Experience:

Minimum:

  • At least 2 years of experience in data mining and data/statistical analysis.
  • At least 2 years experience with SQL and statistical software packages (Python, R, SAS) required.
  • At least 1 year experience working as a data scientist or similar role, with proven track record in data processing, predictive modeling, and machine learning techniques
  • At least 1 year of experience in insurance or financial service related fields

Preferred:

  • Experience building and delivering a survival or churn model
  • Experience building refreshable model or analytical pipelines
  • Experience with model orchestration tools (e.g., Metaflow, Airflow)

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Demonstrated solid skills in data mining, machine learning, programming and optimization.
  • Knowledge with cloud-based advanced data and analytics environment.
  • Passion for problem-solving, comfort with ambiguity.
  • Ability to think conceptually, analytically and creatively.
  • Experience using R, Python and other programing languages.
  • Strong data skills and the ability to work with large structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Experience in of predictive modeling, general model building, and validation procedures.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills required.

Air Ocean Customs Coordinator

A & A Customs Brokers has been clearing shipments across the Canada/US border since 1979. We’re looking for an experienced and customer-focused Air Ocean Customs Clearance Coordinator to join our team. The ideal candidate will have previous experience working at a customs brokerage in the U.S. This position is critical to ensuring shipments are handled in a timely and efficient manner, working collaboratively with the Air/Ocean team to deliver exceptional service to our clients.

If you’re the kind of person who enjoys finding smarter, tech-savvy ways to get things done, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Review documentation and prepare customs release entries for processing.
  • Process and manage air and ocean container releases.
  • Analyze documents to determine applicable tariff classifications, duties, and tax rates.
  • Collect supplementary information or documentation as needed from customers, carriers, CBP, and others.
  • Communicate with clients by email - clear, concise, and service-focused.
  • Handle and resolve challenging situations professionally and calmly.
  • Liaise with other teams for entry follow-up as required.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of U.S. ports and warehouses.
  • Enter data into our systems accurately and efficiently.
  • Complete files within required timeframes and in line with A & A and U.S. regulations.
  • Review files for accuracy and errors, ensuring full compliance.
  • Handle phone inquiries.
  • Take on other duties as they come up - we're a team.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of customs clearance coordination, ideally specializing in air/ocean shipments (preferred).
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) or an equivalent industry designation (preferred).
  • A strong understanding of CBP rules and regulations for importing goods.
  • Tech-savviness. You pick up new systems quickly and like finding efficiencies in digital tools. Experience with Descartes OneView is preferred.
  • Confidence with Gmail/Front, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and AI tools.
  • Sharp problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Professional written and verbal communication, including active listening.
  • Effective work habits: punctual, responsive, and comfortable juggling priorities.
  • A highly organized, self-starting, flexible, and independent approach, which is important in a remote role.

The Details

  • Location: Remote - work from home from most locations across the U.S. (Some eligibility and home office requirements apply).
  • Hours: Full-time, 10:00 a.m. - 6:30 p.m. PST, Monday to Friday.
  • Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 per year. Where you land in the range depends on your experience and any relevant professional designations.

Why join A & A Customs Brokers?

  • Work from home. Trade the commute for time back in your day.
  • Teamwork. A collaborative, professional team that genuinely supports each other.
  • Room to grow. Real opportunities and programs to keep learning and growing in your field.
  • Modern and Tech-Focused. A workplace that values innovation, fresh ideas, and client success.
  • Competitive Benefits Plan. This includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), plus a 401(k) with a company contribution, and merit-based increases.

Sound like you? We'd love to meet you. Apply today and tell us more about why this role is a fit.

A & A Customs Brokers is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

Job Title: Senior Director – Software Product Management, LillyDirect International

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


LillyDirect is an innovative, industry-first direct-to-patient e-commerce experience designed to improve access to care, reduce healthcare costs, and provide integrated support to people managing chronic disease. As we scale rapidly, delivering exceptional consumer experiences is central to our mission.


We are seeking a Senior Director, Software Product Management, LillyDirect International to lead the international expansion of our digital product portfolio. This is a rare opportunity to take a proven direct-to-consumer healthcare platform and bring it to new markets, shaping how patients and healthcare professionals around the world access care, medicines, and support through LillyDirect.

As a senior product leader, you will define and own the international product strategy and roadmap, build and lead a team of market-focused product leaders, and decide what we build once, what we localize, and where a market earns dedicated investment. You will partner closely with Design, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Pharmacy, and Operations to launch products that feel native to each market, reduce friction, and build lasting consumer trust and loyalty, all on a scalable, modular platform that gets faster to launch with every new market.


What You Will Do


Team First Mentality

Install and embody a no-ego, team-first mindset in all interactions across your teams. Foster a collaborative culture that prioritizes shared success over individual recognition. Represent the product team with humility and integrity when engaging with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors.


International Product Strategy and Roadmap
Define and lead a bold international product strategy across multiple regions and markets, translating enterprise goals into market-specific roadmaps, timelines, and requirements. Prioritize investments based on local patient and consumer expectations, market maturity, and business impact, and ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across a portfolio of interconnected products and market teams.


Global Platform and Local Market Balance

Decide what to standardize, what to localize, and what to build once and reuse. Establish clear principles for when a market earns dedicated product investment versus being served from shared platform capabilities, and manage competing demands across markets with transparency and sound judgment.


Build and Lead Market Product Teams

Structure, hire, and develop a team of market-focused product leaders, each accountable for the roadmap and outcomes of their country or region. Set clear decision rights between market teams and global platform teams, and create the rhythms (planning, prioritization, shared learning) that keep the whole organization aligned without slowing local teams down.


Partnership Champion

Act as a strategic product partner across the organization, turning goals into a compelling product vision and actionable strategy for each market. Work closely with Design and Engineering to ensure solutions are grounded in local consumer needs, technically scalable, and aligned with the broader LillyDirect experience. Stay current on new technology and third-party solutions that could accelerate market launches. Champion the voice of the consumer in every product decision, using data, satisfaction trends, and qualitative research from each market to inform priorities.


User Experience and Design

Partner with UX and research leadership to understand end-to-end consumer journeys in each market across web, mobile, chat, email, and phone, ensuring what we bring to market reflects local language, culture, and expectations rather than a translated version of the U.S. experience. Advocate for design quality and accessibility throughout the product lifecycle and use data-driven insights to continuously reduce friction and anticipate needs before customers do.


Regulatory, Compliance, and Local Partnerships

Partner closely with Legal, Regulatory, Privacy, Pharmacy, and Operations leaders to design products that meet market-specific requirements for healthcare, data protection, payments, and operations. Build and manage relationships with local partners and vendors and bring regulatory considerations into roadmap planning early so they inform product decisions rather than slow them down.


Technical Collaboration and Standards

Lead your teams alongside engineering leadership to assess architectural trade-offs for platform components that must work across markets. Establish technical standards and ensure scalable, modular solutions that flex with volume, new languages, and new market requirements.


Stakeholder Engagement and Thought Leadership

Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, regional leaders, and local market teams. Serve as the internal subject matter expert on international product strategy, grounded in best practices for e-commerce and direct-to-consumer models. Represent LillyDirect’s product vision in industry forums and contribute to thought leadership.


Operational Excellence and Resource Planning

Lead portfolio-level resource allocation and prioritization across multiple countries, balancing engineering capacity, operational readiness, regulatory timelines, and cross-functional dependencies. Define how success is measured in each market and hold teams accountable to clear outcomes.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 10+ years leading product teams, including 5+ years in leadership roles
  • E-commerce or direct-to-consumer experience
  • US Candidates: Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

What You Should Bring

  • Direct experience leading market-specific product teams, where a team (and its leader) owned the product roadmap, localization, and outcomes for a single country or region
  • Proven experience leading across multiple markets simultaneously, with several market- or region-focused product teams reporting into you (leaders of leaders), not just serving as a single-market owner
  • Demonstrated track record launching and scaling consumer products in new international markets at a high-growth e-commerce or direct-to-consumer company
  • Experience balancing global platform consistency with local market needs, including deciding what to standardize, what to localize, and how to prioritize across competing market demands
  • Experience navigating market-specific regulatory, payment, language, and operational requirements in partnership with Legal, Ops, and local partners
  • Proven record of driving measurable improvements in consumer experience and business outcomes across markets
  • Deep understanding of user experience principles and human-centered design, including how user needs differ across cultures and regions
  • Experience structuring and evolving a multi-market product organization, including when to stand up a dedicated market team versus serve a market from shared platform teams
  • Background building modular platform and shared services architecture that lets new markets launch faster without rebuilding from scratch
  • Experience building and managing market-entry playbooks, launch sequencing, and go/no-go frameworks
  • Experience operating in regulated or complex environments (healthcare, pharmacy, financial services, or similar)
  • Excellent communication and influence skills, including engagement with C-level executives, regional GMs, and local market leaders
  • Resilience and persistence in navigating ambiguity, overcoming obstacles, and driving progress in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Exceptional leadership and strategic thinking, with strong business acumen and consumer empathy

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form () for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.


Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).


Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$163,500 - $275,000

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

You'll work closely with project managers and business leaders across the organization, gaining exposure to a variety of initiatives while building your project management skills.

Keep Projects Moving

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of projects across the organization.
  • Help develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Track deadlines, action items, and project progress to keep teams aligned and accountable.
