raw.excerpt: Summary: The Enterprise Clinical Insights Senior Advisor is a senior individual contributor who independently leads high-priority business insights, measurement, and solution design work for the Enterprise Clinical organization.
raw.description:
Summary: The Enterprise Clinical Insights Senior Advisor is a senior individual contributor who independently leads high-priority business insights, measurement, and solution design work for the Enterprise Clinical organization. The role serves as a trusted consultant to clinical and business leaders, helping them clarify complex problems, identify the right analytical approach, and translate evidence into decisions that improve affordability, quality, health outcomes, customer experience, and operational performance.

This role owns relationships with designated business partners and stewards a portfolio of insights products and capabilities. The Senior Advisor sets direction for complex analyses, KPI and measurement frameworks, executive scorecards, dashboards, decision-support tools, and self-service solutions. The role leads work from problem framing and prioritization through design, delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement, while coordinating Data & Analytics, Technology, Clinical, Finance, Network, and other matrix partners.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior Advisor is expected to apply sound judgment in ambiguous situations, influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and provide clear recommendations to senior leaders. The role also raises the effectiveness of the broader team by establishing standards, coaching colleagues, and building reusable approaches that scale business insights across the enterprise.


Responsibilities:

  • Own relationships with assigned Enterprise Clinical business partners and serve as a trusted consultant on priorities, performance challenges, and decision needs.
  • Consult with leaders to clarify ambiguous business problems, distinguish root causes from symptoms, and determine the appropriate analytical, measurement, product, or process solution.
  • Triage and prioritize business questions based on strategic value, urgency, feasibility, dependencies, and expected impact; communicate recommendations and trade-offs.
  • Independently lead complex, cross-functional analyses that evaluate clinical, operational, and financial performance and identify actionable opportunities.
  • Translate strategic questions into hypotheses, analytical approaches, measurement methodologies, technical requirements, and decision-oriented recommendations.
  • Lead the design of executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, dashboards, decision-support tools, and other scalable business insights capabilities.
  • Act as business owner and steward for assigned insights products, including product vision, roadmap, requirements, metric integrity, governance, adoption, and lifecycle management.
  • Design standardized measures and evaluation frameworks that connect clinical outcomes, operational performance, and financial value.
  • Lead matrix partners across Clinical, Finance, Network, Technology, and Data & Analytics to deliver, implement, and improve insights solutions.
  • Establish standards, coach colleagues, and advance reusable, automated, self-service, and AI-enabled approaches that improve the quality and scalability of business insights.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7 plus years of experience in healthcare business insights, healthcare consulting, business intelligence, population health, clinical operations, managed care, performance measurement, or related work.
  • Demonstrated success independently leading complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
  • Experience owning senior business-partner relationships and influencing decisions without direct authority in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience designing and stewarding dashboards, scorecards, KPI frameworks, decision-support capabilities, or other insights products.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into actionable business recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and modern data, visualization, and productivity tools sufficient to guide solution design and partner effectively with technical teams.
  • Executive-level written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and deliver with limited oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience with clinical operations, care management, utilization management, provider performance, quality measurement, population health, healthcare affordability, or program evaluation.
  • Experience connecting clinical outcomes, operational performance, and financial value in a managed care or health services environment.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, Snowflake, Python, Alteryx, Excel, SharePoint, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience designing self-service solutions, automated workflows, product roadmaps, and governance models.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analysis, research, automation, coding, and content development.
  • Experience with continuous improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, statistical process control, or design thinking; advanced degree preferred.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 112,100 - 186,800 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.


At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.





About The Cigna Group

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.

Teradyne's Defense & Aerospace Division delivers advanced, mission critical test solutions to military and aerospace customers worldwide. Our comprehensive portfolio supports the entire test lifecycle across factory, depot, and field environments, with continued growth driven by next-generation defense programs and modernization initiatives.

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce made up of people from diverse backgrounds united by a shared commitment to excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment where our employees, and the communities around us, can thrive.

Defense and Aerospace Strategic Business Development Manager

Emerging Defense Primes & Commercial Space
Location: Remote, United States (Significant Travel Required)
Business: Teradyne Defense & Aerospace
Reports To: Worldwide Sales Manager

Our Purpose

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team, one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

Opportunity Overview

The Defense and Aerospace Business Development Manager will play a critical role in expanding Teradyne's presence across emerging defense technology companies and the rapidly growing commercial space sector. This position will focus on identifying, qualifying, and creating strategic opportunities with organizations developing next-generation aerospace, defense, autonomy, artificial intelligence, and space systems.
Success in this role is measured by the quality of relationships established, opportunities identified, and strategic market intelligence delivered to the business. Working closely with sales leadership and named account teams, you will help position Teradyne's test solutions within a dynamic and evolving customer landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive market map of emerging defense, aerospace, and commercial space companies, key programs, stakeholders, and funding sources.
  • Monitor Department of Defense funding priorities, innovation initiatives, venture capital investments, and acquisition pathways to identify organizations transitioning into production environments.
  • Develop relationships with engineering, manufacturing, test, operations, and executive leaders within target accounts.
  • Represent Teradyne at industry conferences, trade shows, customer meetings, and networking events to increase awareness and generate new business opportunities.
  • Qualify potential opportunities by assessing program requirements, business drivers, timing, funding, technical challenges, and decision-making processes.
  • Partner closely with regional sales managers and named account representatives to ensure seamless transition of qualified opportunities into the active sales pipeline.
  • Maintain accurate activity, account intelligence, and opportunity data within Salesforce and provide regular market insights to sales and product leadership.
  • Support strategic planning by identifying emerging technology trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving test requirements across defense and space markets.

All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you're ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline OR equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of business development, strategic sales, account development, or related experience within aerospace, defense, space, or defense technology industries.
  • Demonstrated network across defense technology companies, commercial space organizations, venture-backed defense firms, or Department of Defense innovation ecosystems.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. defense acquisition processes, budget cycles, and non-traditional contracting mechanisms including OTAs, SBIR/STTR programs, and rapid acquisition initiatives.
  • Ability to engage in technical discussions related to electronic test, production test, validation, and mission-critical systems.
  • Experience developing new markets, identifying strategic opportunities, and influencing stakeholders across complex organizations.
  • Strong communication, presentation, relationship-building, and collaboration skills.
  • U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for an emerging defense technology company, commercial space organization, or supplier serving these markets.
  • Familiarity with automated test equipment, avionics, RF/microwave technologies, aerospace electronics, or mission-critical systems.
  • Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.
We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.
This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $195,700-$313,200. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

Incentive Plan: Eligible for discretionary bonus based on financial performance.

raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As Human Interest prepares for its next phase of significant growth and public company readiness, we're seeking an Event Marketing Manager to own and drive events at Human Interest. You will be responsible for 20-25 channel (HCM, Payroll, SBO, Advisor, Accountants, Benefits Brokers, etc.) and prospect (Franchise, HR, etc.) events /quarter. Expect to be hands-on, ready to roll up your sleeves and be creative. Given our rapid pace, you'll also need to be comfortable with speed and constant change (i.e., 24,791 mph) while achieving successful, high quality outcomes.

About the team

The channel events marketing team is responsible for planning and executing events that drive revenue and partnership opportunities for our field teams. The majority of events are partner events, along with industry events and some internal events. There are ~150 events/year and growing.

What you get to do every day

  • Plan, manage and execute external high-profile events. Own end-to-end event logistics, comms, and post-event reporting for assigned events.
  • Work in partnership with the brand/content/marketing team to have consistent messaging and positioning to maximize your contributions while supporting cross-functional initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing team members and sales/partnerships on program strategy, target setting, activations and outreach — but ultimately you are in the driver’s seat and own the outcomes of the event.
  • Regularly evaluate event outcomes and successes, share learnings, and optimize and adjust plans based on those learnings.
  • Research event opportunities based on objectives, target audiences, and industries, and make proactive recommendations for adjustments to our strategy— this is across industry, channel and internal.
  • Own the budget for assigned events, handle contract negotiation, vendor sourcing, online swag portal & invoicing for events and sponsorships. Assist in the facilitation of contracts and invoices through the company’s procurement portal.
  • Conceptualize and pitch bold, outside-the-box event activations, booth concepts, and interactive touchpoints that break through the noise and spark genuine attendee engagement.
  • Be creative and unique by testing different event formats to help engage our internal team, partners, and prospects while developing success metrics to ensure positive ROI.
  • Actively contribute to improving systems and processes to support the ongoing success of the department.

In any given month, the type of projects you’ll work on may include:

  • Strategic planning, setting OKRs, and socializing new programs for events and swag.
  • Event planning for partner offsites, partner promotions, or incentive trips.
  • Measurement and reporting, including setting targets, monitoring performance, and sharing pre-and-post-event

What you bring to the role

  • 5+ years of relevant experience (event marketing, field marketing, project management)
  • Proven experience carrying out concurrent event program efforts, including event planning & reporting
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high growth software company where change is a constant – with a bias towards being proactive and self-directed
  • Self-starter, ability to lead innovative, entrepreneurial efforts and drive for excellence
  • Extreme attention to detail and highly organized
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to function independently, as well as collaboratively with other team members
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet a plus

Nice to have

  • Completion of CMP certification

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $80,000 - $95,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws. Employment with Human Interest is at-will, meaning either you or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, except as otherwise provided by law or written agreement.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Own the program execution behind cutting-edge GPU and AI infrastructure deployments.
  • Lead multiple complex GPU cluster deployments from contract signature through customer go-live.
  • Work at the center of data centers, OEM hardware, networking, GPU infrastructure, and enterprise technology.

Location:

Remote nationwide. This role offers the flexibility to work from anywhere in the US while coordinating complex infrastructure deployments across multiple sites and partners. Travel may be required based on deployment needs.

Note:

Must have 7+ years of program or project management experience supporting data center, infrastructure, telecom, or large-scale technology deployments, along with direct GPU cluster deployment experience. Candidates must be US citizens and must have genuine fluency in the GPU cluster deployment lifecycle. Our teams bring together data centers, OEMs, networking providers, hardware partners, and technical specialists to deliver complex infrastructure from initial planning through customer go-live. Confidential Employer.

Qualifications

  • Direct experience managing GPU cluster deployments from planning through implementation or go-live.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, complex infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of GPU cluster architecture and the end-to-end deployment lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating data center readiness, hardware delivery and installation, network turn-up, vendor dependencies, and acceptance testing.
  • Experience working directly with OEM manufacturers, data center operators, and network or connectivity providers.
  • Strong experience with risk, issue, dependency, and critical-path management.
  • Experience producing reporting for enterprise clients and executive or Board-level stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency with complex project management tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work credibly with technical, operational, executive, and customer stakeholders.
  • Must be a US citizen.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.
  • Experience with a neocloud, hyperscaler, GPU infrastructure provider, or similar large-scale compute environment is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Reference Architecture and cluster acceptance testing standards is a plus.

Why You Will Love Working Here

  • Work on some of the most sophisticated GPU and AI infrastructure deployments in the market.
  • Take ownership of complex programs with significant visibility and real business impact.
  • Collaborate with experts across GPU architecture, data centers, supply chain, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.

raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Project Manager leads permitting and approval projects for large-scale network infrastructure builds, keeping the data, dates, and documentation accurate and on schedule from start to finish. Working with engineering, construction, project controls, and external partners, this role keeps each project moving on time and in line with program commitments. As a senior member of the team, this role manages multiple complex projects at once.

This is an opportunity to own your projects through to completion: keeping project records current, forecasting key dates, validating requirements, and raising risks early so leaders can make timely decisions.

Location

This is a work from home position within the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Track open change requests and partner awards daily, and escalate cost, schedule, or scope impacts with options and a recommendation.
  • Serve as the point of contact to customers and partners on permitting status and change requests, providing clear, timely updates and options so decisions are made quickly and timelines stay protected.
  • Record reasons for missed tasks and milestones to improve forecast accuracy and schedule transparency.
  • Validate reporting accuracy before distribution, identify missing or incomplete data, and support monthly business reviews and operational reporting.
  • Prepare progress reports and project documentation in accordance with established project management standards and PMO processes, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency across all assigned projects.
  • Communicate status, risks, and blockers concisely to leaders, leading with the decision needed and the date needed, and respond promptly to leadership questions.
  • Coordinate with engineering, deployment, project controls, and program teams to align priorities and keep projects moving.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Minimum

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, and at least three years of related project coordination, permitting, document control, or administrative experience.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% as business needs require.
  • Experience maintaining data in a project tracking or system-of-record tool with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of document control, records management, and project administration processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects, customers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Experience working within established project management standards, PMO processes, and governance, applying them consistently across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Ability to forecast dates and milestones, identify risks early, and communicate recommendations clearly and concisely to leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a record of ownership, accountability, and follow-through when working with external partners and internal teams.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and experience developing reports and meeting documentation.

Preferred

  • Four or more years of project coordination, project management, permitting, or document control experience.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience with permitting, zoning, jurisdictional processes, or architecture and engineering partner coordination on infrastructure, utility, or construction projects.
  • Experience with SharePoint, OneVision, Procore, ProjectWise or similar document and project management platforms.
  • Experience performing quality reviews of project documentation and reports.

raw.title: Senior Staff AI Security Engineer, AI Platform (AI Native)
raw.excerpt: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
raw.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The AI Native Platform team is a cross-functional engineering organization built to lay the infrastructure foundations for Life360's AI-native transformation. We are not exploring what might be possible, we are building the platform that makes it operational.

The team works across four interconnected areas: how Life360 safely accesses and governs the use of frontier AI models and external integrations; the agent deployment and workflow infrastructure that lets teams build, test, version, and operate autonomous agents with the same rigor applied to any production software; how we safely democratize data, information, and knowledge across the organization, making it queryable and usable by AI systems and humans reliably; and a multiplayer AI workbench that gives every employee a purpose-built environment tuned to their role, with relevant tools, knowledge, and workflows rather than a general-purpose chat interface.

The work is deliberate, high-velocity, and built to last. The bar is high: real use cases, production deployments, measurable outcomes.

Security is not a checkpoint on this team. It is part of how we build. We are looking for engineers who want to be in the room where the architecture is designed and in the codebase where it's being built.

About the Job

We are hiring a Sr. Staff AI Security Engineer to secure Life360's AI infrastructure as it takes shape. You will sit within the AI Native Platform team, reporting directly to the CISO, working alongside the engineers designing and building each layer of the platform.

This role is grounded in execution with real architectural reach. You'll drive delivery across key security domains while contributing to design decisions that shape how the platform is built. The patterns we are securing are still being defined, and part of the work is building and validating those patterns under real conditions. You’ll be active in architecture reviews, own security implementation across your domains, and build the controls that make it safe to move fast with AI. In a domain where the playbooks are still being written, part of the role is writing them. You won't be doing this alone, you'll work alongside additional security engineers and the broader team building the platform, with the expectation that this function grows as the platform does.

The data at stake has real weight. Life360's systems carry real-time location data and family relationship graphs for tens of millions of people, including children. These are crown jewels in the truest sense — irreplaceable to the families who trust us with them. Securing the AI systems that interact with this data is not a compliance exercise. It is a core obligation of the product.

The US-based salary range for this position is $209,000 to $309,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Secure how Life360 accesses frontier models. Design, build, and iterate the access controls, policy enforcement, and authorization patterns that govern how systems interact with the frontier models they rely on.
  • Build secure patterns for MCP access and tool use authorization. Build and own the controls that vet, risk-tier, and govern how we integrate with external tools and services via MCP as adoption expands across engineering teams.
  • Design and build the identity and authorization model for autonomous agents: service identities, scoped credentials, and least-privilege access patterns. Define and enforce the trust boundaries that govern how agents interact across orchestration chains.
  • Design and build agentic observability and adversarial defenses. Build the telemetry pipelines and behavioral monitoring that provide visibility into AI system behavior. Implement architecture-level defenses against prompt injection and related adversarial attack classes.
  • Shape security for the common AI end-user platform. Lead design reviews, build access controls, data boundary enforcement, and abuse detection that keep a shared AI environment safe across users with different privilege levels.
  • Secure the shared knowledge layer. Define access control and data governance for retrieval augmented and reasoning systems, ensuring AI-powered tools don't surface sensitive data to the wrong systems or users.
  • Build AI supply chain integrity into the platform. Develop model provenance practices, service vetting, and dependency controls that keep the AI stack trustworthy as it grows.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Data Platform to ensure the right controls are built into pipelines handling real-time location, family relationship data, and data involving minors.

What We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years in security engineering with depth in application security, cloud security, IAM, or detection — and a track record of building controls that earn adoption, not just approval.
  • Hands on builder shipping security controls that hold up in production. You’re not an advisor but a practitioner who can define patterns that last.
  • Hands-on fluency with LLM and agentic systems. You've built with these tools, broken them, and shipped fixes for prompt pipelines, RAG architectures, and multi-agent orchestration from the inside.
  • Solid grounding in IAM for non-human systems: service identities, OAuth, secrets management, RBAC/ABAC, and least-privilege architecture at scale.
  • Experience with production telemetry and detection — defining detections and building response paths for threat surfaces without established playbooks.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and in-flight builds. You're energized by figuring things out — writing first-draft standards, testing approaches, and scaling what works.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and the ability to push back when it matters. You carry risk, tradeoffs, and technical decisions across engineering, product, and security leadership without losing precision — and can reshape a risky decision clearly and constructively.
  • Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, and adjacent compliance environments for consumer data at scale.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with frontier model API security, tool-use authorization patterns, or access governance for AI systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and their trust, identity, and authorization challenges.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graph architectures, vector stores, or RAG systems — and the access control and data boundary problems they introduce.
  • Red teaming or adversarial testing against AI systems: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data extraction, model inversion, or supply chain attacks.
  • Background in consumer technology or another domain where personal data sensitivity is a core product obligation — not just a legal requirement.
  • Experience designing or reviewing security for internal enterprise AI platforms serving non-technical users.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: Running parallel workstreams instead of hand-holding one agent at a time.
  • Judgment and ownership: Review AI-generated code, analyses, and models as critically as a colleague's pull request. You are accountable for everything you ship, whoever or whatever wrote it.
  • Velocity: Turn AI fluency into output. We expect you to deliver more production ML, faster, than the same work would take without AI.
  • Team leadership: Share your AI workflows with the team and raise the AI fluency of the data scientists and engineers around you.
  • Continuous learning: Keep up with new AI tools and techniques, test them on real team problems, and bring recommendations to the team.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

You will play a key role in building scalable, secure, and high‑performing enterprise solutions while driving engineering excellence, cloud adoption, and AI-enabled innovation.

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise-grade applications and digital services.
  • Build modern frontend solutions using React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and related technologies.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable, and reusable application components aligned with engineering best practices.

Data & Integration Engineering

  • Design, develop, and integrate relational and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Develop and support solutions using Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Redis.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs and enterprise integration services.
  • Support distributed systems and event-driven architectures across enterprise platforms.

Cloud, DevOps & Security Engineering

  • Drive cloud-native engineering initiatives using Azure or AWS.
  • Develop and support containerised solutions using Kubernetes and related technologies.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and monitoring capabilities.
  • Promote secure coding practices, code reviews, vulnerability remediation, and DevSecOps standards.
  • Support infrastructure automation and modern software delivery practices.

AI & Advanced Engineering Solutions

  • Develop AI-enabled applications such as copilots, intelligent search platforms, virtual assistants, and workflow automation solutions.
  • Integrate enterprise AI platforms including Azure OpenAI, GPT, Claude, Gemini, and related technologies.
  • Build solutions leveraging RAG, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, agent-based workflows, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Develop reusable AI services, evaluation frameworks, telemetry solutions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Support responsible AI implementation, governance, monitoring, and compliance requirements.

We'd Love to Hear From You If...

Experience

  • You have a minimum of 8 years of software engineering experience.
  • You have a strong track record delivering enterprise-scale full stack applications.
  • You have experience working across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and DevOps domains.
  • You have experience building and supporting customer-facing and enterprise digital platforms.
  • You have experience implementing modern engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Technical Expertise

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • You have strong expertise in React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • You have strong backend development experience using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, REST APIs, and microservices architectures.
  • You have experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, and distributed data platforms.
  • You have expertise in Azure or AWS cloud platforms, containerisation, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
  • You have experience with automated testing frameworks, source control systems, deployment pipelines, and site reliability engineering practices.
  • You have strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, encryption, secrets management, and secure API design.
  • You have experience integrating Generative AI and Large Language Models such as Azure OpenAI, GPT, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
  • You have hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • You have knowledge of AI lifecycle management, AI security, data governance, privacy, responsible AI, explainability, and compliance requirements.
  • You have familiarity with performance engineering, distributed caching, event streaming, API gateways, service mesh architectures, and production support for high-volume platforms.

Ways of Working

  • You collaborate effectively with business, architecture, engineering, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams.
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You promote engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • You balance innovation, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • You demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and ownership of delivery outcomes.

raw.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Overview

At PrizePicks, we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth—from our consumer-facing app to the services that support millions of members. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Social Experience team and help us continue to build the future of fantasy sports.

Job Summary

The Social Platform team builds backend systems behind profiles, feeds, and other features that help members connect, discover, and share activity on PrizePicks.

You’ll lead design and delivery across mature Rails applications and a growing system of Rails and Go services, evolving existing capabilities and building foundations for new social experiences. We value deep Rails expertise, strong data modeling, sound architectural judgment, and engineers who elevate their teammates.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build backend services: Build scalable, reliable systems primarily in Rails, with Go where appropriate, to support evolving social experiences.
  • Evolve service boundaries: Improve mature Rails applications, define clear service boundaries, and plan incremental migrations that preserve reliability.
  • Connect product and data systems: Build reliable data flows between services and data platforms such as BigQuery and Snowflake without compromising member-facing performance.
  • Own technical delivery: Lead technical design through production, shape architectural decisions, and communicate tradeoffs, risks, and dependencies clearly.
  • Drive cross-team execution: Partner with Product, Design, QA, Data, Platform, and other engineers to align decisions and coordinate delivery.
  • Drive system reliability: Improve database performance, observability, and resilience under load.
  • Mentor and elevate: Mentor engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions, and raise the bar for engineering practices.
  • Participate in on-call rotation: Respond to production incidents, help identify root causes, and drive lasting fixes.

Experience

  • 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building production Ruby on Rails applications
  • Experience leading the design and evolution of scalable backend systems and explaining architectural tradeoffs.
  • Track record of delivering complex work across teams while managing dependencies, risks, and changing requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level Ruby on Rails proficiency, idiomatic Ruby, and sound judgment about when to follow or challenge Rails conventions.
  • Strong relational data modeling and PostgreSQL proficiency, including complex associations, schema evolution, and query performance at scale.
  • Strong API design fundamentals, including REST, serialization, and versioning.
  • Experience with background processing (Sidekiq or similar) and an understanding of asynchronous workflows and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and deployment practices.
  • Working knowledge of Go and a willingness to contribute across our Rails and Go services.

Working Style

  • You translate clear product goals into sound technical plans, working through design options, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
  • You communicate technical decisions clearly, bring others into the process, and build alignment across teams.
  • You balance hands-on engineering with mentorship and technical leadership, working autonomously while keeping partners informed.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience leading the extraction of capabilities from a monolith or evolving systems toward well-defined services
  • Experience building social or relationship-driven systems such as feeds, follows, live chat, reactions, activity streams, or recommendations
  • Experience designing stat-driven profile systems, including aggregations, rollups, and derived metrics at scale
  • Experience building social systems for rapid experimentation through feature flags, ranking experiments, or growth loops
  • Experience designing graph-shaped data models and fan-out strategies at scale
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams and domains while driving shared initiatives to completion
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools across the development lifecycle — coding, planning, scoping, and code review
  • Experience integrating AI tooling into engineering workflows to accelerate team productivity

Where You’ll Live

While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks

The typical salary range for this position is $175,000 to $185,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you’ll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

This application period will remain open for 30 days. We’re committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting.

Date Posted: 11/18, 2026

First Extension: 12/18, 2026

Second Extension: 1/18, 2026

Benefits you’ll receive:

In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Annual bonus
  • Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!)
  • Generous paid leave programs, including 16-week paid parental leave and disability benefits
  • Workplace flexibility and modern work schedules focused on getting the job done, not hours clocked
  • Company-wide in-person events and team outings
  • Lifestyle enhancement program
  • Company equipment provided (Windows & Mac options)
  • Annual performance reviews with opportunities for growth and career development

You must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Job Title: Sr. Quality Auditor, CAPA Center of Excellence - UK

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview

Lead and support effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) management for significant quality issues (QIs) and audit and inspection responses including the assessment and review of investigations, appropriate root cause analysis and corrective and preventative actions. Provide support to management with insights, analyses and assessment and promotion of compliance with regulations, guidelines, and operating procedures through risk identification and mitigation, and improvement initiatives . Manage the quality assurance oversight of quality issues, audit responses, assignments, training and staff. Oversee and lead team management activities.

Essential Functions

  • Lead and mentor members of the CAPA management team, with a focus on driving improvement and compliance, ensuring an aligned approach to CAPA management and adherence to regulations and guidelines and providing support as needed.
  • Lead and support CAPA activities for complex QIs and sponsor audits and inspections: assessing investigations, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis is performed, adequate corrective and preventative actions and effectiveness are implemented and followed up within the agreed timelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify process gaps, areas of improvements and ensure the application of quality processes, principles and strategy to support compliance with relevant regulations, GCP guidelines, procedures and sponsor agreements
  • Ensure proper reporting and documentation of CAPAs in the electronic quality management system (eQMS) and that robust corrective and preventative actions and effectiveness checks are tracked and completed within the required timelines
  • Promote a culture of proactive and continuous process improvement by identifying risks and trends, and optimizing the CAPA system and processes.
  • Lead with a spirit of teamwork and collaboration to ensure effective communication among all department stakeholders and staff.
  • Develop and/or provide training and guidance on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA management, execution, good documentation practices, and compliance adherence
  • Develop and/or improve governing procedures, templates and work instructions, in order to streamline processes and drive compliance
  • Advise Quality Assurance management on system audit needs.
  • Support external and internal audits and inspections of IQVIA including inspections of IQVIA or investigational sites where needed, and ensure a state of inspection readiness at all times

Qualifications

  • 5 years of quality assurance experience within GCP environment is a must
  • Extensive knowledge of CAPA Management, GCP guidelines and relevant regulations for the conduct of clinical trials is a must
  • Background in science, healthcare and/or other relevant discipline and a detailed understanding of the clinical trial process and GCP guidelines
  • Possess strong leadership and organizational skills for prioritizing workload and responsibilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization and successfully liaise with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent problem solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent training and mentoring capabilities.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and work independently and effectively in a fast-paced changing environment
  • Ability to speak effectively one-to-one, in group settings, with clients, vendors and employees of the organization.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel)

This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

The Role

Kasa offers flexible accommodations for guests in dozens of markets nationwide. We partner with multifamily and hospitality property owners to offer various unit types in our portfolio, including short-term rental apartments and traditional hotel rooms across price and luxury tiers. The Regional Sales Manager will report to the Associate Director of Sales and work closely with the Revenue Management, Reservations, and Operations teams. This individual will be laser-focused on prospecting group and preferred corporate leads.

Like any role at a fast-paced start-up, there is no ‘typical day’, but you will be responsible for the execution of a sales strategy for Kasa's portfolio in a defined area, targeting all market segments, including leisure travel, corporate preferred, groups, and others. An exciting part of this is being instrumental in changing the way corporate and group travelers view the flexible accommodations space.

If you are looking to be instrumental in changing the way leisure, corporate and group travelers view the flexible accommodations space - this is the role for you!

Unleash your career potential at Kasa

We're building a tech-enabled global hospitality brand that unleashes the potential of liveable space. Hospitality is at the core of who we are, and we are committed to providing our teams the same care we give our guests, neighbors, and partners.

Required Attributes

  • Metrics-Minded: Ability to breakdown their monthly targets into weekly achievable tasks to help meet or exceed their sales goals
  • Revenue Driver: Self-driven to identify and uncover revenue-generating opportunities through industry knowledge, prospecting and execution of sales strategies
  • Embrace Ambiguity: Experience in the "building the plane while flying it" environment and proven ability to adjust and flex to business demands*;* open to providing feedback to contribute to problem resolutions; updates to processes
  • Lead Investigator: Promptly assesses every inbound lead to create opportunities to expand Kasa's partnerships, profit, and portfolio experience
  • Detail-Oriented: Ability to magnify the big picture whether meticulously organizing inbound leads and executing tasks accordingly through finalizing contracts; the innate mindfulness to details is ever present *pertaining to contracts, organization, prioritization
  • Culture Cultivator: Possesses a genuine passion for being a part of a world-class team; not only succeeding individually, but positively influences team members to engage, grow, and exceed expectations for Kasa
  • Fearless Negotiator: Confidently negotiates and navigates conversations with internal and external stakeholders; resulting in closed deals across accounts that vary in size, scope, and industry
  • Relationship-Centric: Relationship building is in your DNA and rooted in every interaction; consistently providing your peers, manager, and clients clear communication, diligence, and trustworthiness

Experience

  • 3–5+ years of experience in hotel group sales, corporate accounts, or extended-stay property sales
  • Strong background in building, maintaining, and growing key client relationships, particularly with community-based organizations
  • Proven ability to leverage local market connections to drive SMERF business opportunities
  • Skilled at overseeing multiple hotels or geographic regions, with clear territory sales strategies
  • Proficient in hotel CRM systems for pipeline and client management
  • Ability to analyze travel trends, competitor rates, and demand generators to adjust sales tactics
  • Strong experience negotiating group rates, long-term stay agreements, and corporate preferred contracts
  • Proven ability to drive occupancy, ADR (Average Daily Rate), and RevPAR (Revenue per Available Room) through targeted sales efforts
  • Exceptional at presenting hotel services to corporate clients, and travel managers

Plus if…

  • You have experience working at a tech startup

In one year, you will succeed at Kasa by having:

  • Achieved or exceeded sales targets by driving room bookings, group sales, corporate contracts
  • Secured repeat business from corporate accounts, travel agencies, and groups
  • Expanded Kasa’s visibility in target markets through strategic partnerships, networking, and promotions

Curious about the Kasa experience? Save 15% when you book on

  • Remote Work: With flexibility as a core value, and over three-quarters of the team working remotely, Kasa employees can work from anywhere, including our Kasa’s across the country!
  • Kasa Travel Credit: We love to travel! Kasa employees get an allowance of free stays with us in any of our locations, plus a discount on any night for friends and family.
  • The Pay: The starting base pay range for this role is between $82,000 and $100,000 annually and is set based on multiple considerations, including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified. This role may also be eligible for equity, bonus, perks, benefits, and Kasa Travel Credits.

raw.description:
Role Overview

The Account Manager serves as the commercial and strategic relationship leader across a dedicated portfolio of approximately 50 existing public sector accounts. Operating in close partnership with dedicated Solutions Architects and delivery consultants, this individual is directly accountable for maximizing net revenue retention (NRR) through proactive contract renewals and targeted account expansion. Growth opportunities span the complete suite of Conducive's offerings: third-party software licensing and ingest tier upgrades, specialized professional consulting services, and long-term managed services contracts.

Key Responsibilities

1. Account Governance & Portfolio Retention (~50 Accounts)

  • Portfolio Ownership: Own end-to-end commercial retention and health across ~50 public sector accounts, proactively tracking contract expiration dates, funding windows, and fiscal year-end deadlines.
  • Executive Business Reviews: Lead structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to assess system utilization, platform health, SLA metrics, and future architecture roadmaps.
  • Proactive Health Monitoring: Collaborate closely with delivery consultants and engineering teams to identify and remediate operational or adoption blockers well ahead of renewal cycles.

2. Multi-Stream Growth & Quota Execution

  • Software & Licensing Expansion: Identify and close capacity ingest upgrades, additional workload licensing, and module additions across Splunk and associated observability/SIEM ecosystems.
  • Professional Consulting Services: Scope and position technical consulting packages, cloud migrations, architecture modernizations, and bespoke implementation projects.
  • Managed Services Engagements: Pitch and secure multi-year managed operations, continuous administration, monitoring support, and staff augmentation agreements.
  • Commercial Deal Leadership: Shepherd opportunities from identification through technical scoping, proposal and statement-of-work (SOW) drafting, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

3. Technical & Pre-Sales Collaboration

  • Solutions Architecture Alignment: Partner with dedicated Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, architectural reviews, and solution demonstrations.
  • Value Translation: Translate complex agency compliance mandates, logging bottlenecks, and security directives into clear, actionable technical workstreams.

4. Public Sector Procurement & Operational Diligence

  • Procurement Navigation: Navigate government purchasing channels, state term contracts, piggyback mechanisms, GSA schedules, and sole-source justification requirements.
  • CRM Hygiene & Forecasting: Maintain rigorous, audit-ready CRM documentation—tracking renewal pipelines, probability stages, contract values, and delivering highly dependable monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

Role Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Domain Experience: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience directly within enterprise logging, SIEM, or observability domains (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel).
  • Account Management Track Record: Demonstrated success in a dedicated Account Management or Commercial Customer Success role with dual quota accountability for renewals and net-new expansions.
  • Public Sector Acumen: Direct experience managing relationships and contracts within state, local, higher education (SLED), or federal government accounts, including understanding of fiscal budget cycles.
  • Technical Literacy: Solid foundational understanding of SIEM/logging architectures, data onboarding, ingestion volume sizing, and compliance frameworks to independently lead initial qualification conversations.
  • Exceptional Detail Orientation: High standard of organizational diligence, contract tracking rigor, and disciplined pipeline governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Splunk Certifications: Splunk Core Certified Power User, Advanced Power User, or equivalent platform credentials.
  • Blended Solution Selling: Proven background structuring blended deals combining software licenses, advisory consulting SOWs, and recurring managed services.
  • Contract Vehicles: Working knowledge of major public sector contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA Schedule 70/MAS, OMNIA, state-wide master contracts).
